## 2026.11.5


### OpenClaw v2026.11.5

For formatted release notes, [read this release on the docs site](https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.11.5).

OpenClaw 2026.11.5 focuses on making everyday work more reliable. There’s less typing lag while long replies stream, chats recover more reliably after a disconnect, and if the device you started a task on goes offline, you can stop it from another one.

**Release scale:** 11,811 commits, 9,954 pull requests, and 746 contributors.

#### Installation and Onboarding

Run managed services from a standalone build and find clearer recovery and support guidance. Keep a verified pre-upgrade backup and its matching build when you need the option to return to an older release.




##### Standalone Gateway and node services


Run managed Gateway and node services from a [standalone OpenClaw build](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) without a separate Node or Bun executable. Choose the standalone runtime and point it at the executable. Reinstalling or repairing the Gateway service retains that choice. Keep the whole build directory together, and rebuild older artifacts that lack the service runtime check.
[#183838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183838).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Experimental standalone AOT builds


Experimental standalone AOT builds can run fetched CommonJS and TypeScript plugins, Node Code Mode cells and continuations, and QA Lab expressions and lambdas through an interpreter. You can also try compiling OpenClaw’s original TypeScript ahead of time. Both modes offer compiler controls for runtime trimming, locales and string-generated code. Interpreted paths can run more slowly, and JIT remains the default. An AOT-capable Bun build is required; leave strict string-code restrictions off if you rely on host NodeVM. See the [standalone build guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) and [runtime profiles](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/runtime-profiles).
Doctor shows which runtime profile is in use.

[#182818](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182818), [#183224](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183224).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Agent creation and navigation


Administrators can create an agent in the [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui), choose its avatar or generate a Blobster preview from a description using its text model. The description goes to the selected model and its provider if it runs remotely, and the avatar changes when you save the preview. OpenClaw checks that the model can respond before creating the agent. Its greeting stays in chat, and onboarding asks for a role before the goal.

The agent selector puts the newest agent first, opens settings without switching agents and offers **Show all** for sessions across agents. When the connection lacks access to create an agent, the Control UI explains why.
Blobster generation requires admin access and a model that can respond without tools.

Preview generation uses the agent’s text model.

[#175291](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291), [#173762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173762).

Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

The disabled **New agent** button explains the access requirement. A direct Custodian visit shows an access error or asks you to update and reconnect if your Gateway lacks support. See [#173204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173204) and [Control UI access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui.md).

[#173322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173322).

Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@oscarsixsecllc](https://github.com/oscarsixsecllc) for the related report.




##### Agent Templates


Experimental Agent Templates let you browse official and community packages, inspect their publisher and contents, and add one to create an agent. Enable **Templates** in **Settings → Labs** to browse by category or explore Featured when it is available. Applicable trust reviews may ask for your acknowledgement before adding a package. When a Template includes a schedule, OpenClaw waits for the new agent to become available before installing it.

Administrators can choose **Create Template** from an agent’s sidebar, including for pinned agents, to prepare a private draft in its chat and review the contents before publishing to ClawHub. Review the package for personal information before submitting it. Publishing requires a workspace and ClawHub sign-in on the Gateway host, and a submission may be pending security review. See the [Templates guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates) and [creation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates#create-with-an-agent).

If you used Claws, update old commands, links, configuration and Gateway API calls to use Templates. Existing Claws records carry over, but the former status, update, remove, export and migrate commands are no longer available. See the [current CLI commands](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/templates.md).
[#173345](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173345), [#173346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173346), [#173377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173377).

Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

- Contents preview and chat handoff ([#171600](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171600)) and creating an agent with Add ([#171623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171623)). If chat does not open after Add, retry without creating another agent. Adding the same Template again creates another agent without overwriting an existing workspace; shared plugins and MCP servers remain independently managed.
- Featured and category browsing ([#178047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178047)). Category browsing ranks public Templates by installs; category search sorts the matches returned.
- Scheduled Template Add ([#178072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178072)). A partial result is reported if the agent’s availability cannot be confirmed.
- Private drafts and publishing progress ([#178925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178925)) and sidebar creation and draft review ([#179098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179098)). The review lets you inspect included items and edit the display name separately from the package name. Publishing shows progress and links to the Template.

#### Web UI

Organize your conversations in personal Sections, start independent work and manage more of a chat from the sidebar and panels. Keep the tab open until queued changes have been sent after a reconnect.




##### Personal sidebar Sections


Organize conversations in personal Sections below Pinned in the Control UI sidebar. Create a Section from **Filter & sort** or a session’s **Add to section** menu, then choose a source and find conversations by owner or search beyond the loaded sidebar. Drag conversations into a Section and reorder Section headers. Adding a conversation organizes your sidebar without giving anyone access. Child conversations stay with their parent, and removing a Section keeps its conversations.

Sections sync for profiles with general Gateway write access. On restricted or profileless connections, they stay in the current browser. See [Sessions and the sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui).
Personal conversation groups

[#181680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181680).

Thanks [@TheAngryPit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit) for proposing and directing the feature and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for co-authoring and reviewing it.

[#186229](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186229).

Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).




##### Independent sessions


You can ask an authorized agent to start separate work in a persistent session you can open and continue yourself. Give it a first message to start work immediately or have it create the session for later. If the first run fails, check whether the session was created before retrying.
- Independent session creation through the `sessions_create` tool. [Session tool guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session-tool.md) Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). [#164304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164304)




##### Stop across devices


You can use Stop in the [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) on another device to stop work you started, even after the original device disconnects. This covers active runs, queued messages and follow-on work OpenClaw is still tracking. You need to be signed in as the same person with access to the conversation, and this doesn’t let you stop someone else’s work.
[#187408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187408).

Thanks shakkernerd.




##### Session changes during reconnects


Keep organizing conversations while the Control UI reconnects. You can rename a session, change its icon, color or existing category, add or remove message reactions, and archive, unarchive or delete eligible sessions, including bulk archive and delete. Changes appear immediately and are sent after reconnecting to the same Gateway and account with unchanged credentials. Rejected changes are undone and show an error.

Keep the tab open until changes are sent. Closing or reloading it loses unsent changes. The English chat header also identifies a saved conversation while reconnecting or disconnected. See [queued session changes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect#queued-session-changes).
[#177558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177558), [#182292](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182292), [#184075](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184075).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Conversation context


See what is filling a conversation’s context and compact it without clearing your draft. Open the context ring beside the model picker and choose **View context** for an estimate covering messages, workspace memory, tools, skills and the system prompt. You can expand entries, refresh the report and, when a matching prompt budget is available, see the room left. With permission, choose **Compact** while the conversation is idle. [Context breakdown](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md#context-breakdown)
Context estimates, report refresh and draft-preserving compaction

[#173900](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173900).

Thanks steipete.

[#179225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179225).




##### Agent and session navigation


**Show all agents** in the Control UI sidebar now shows one row per agent. Pin an agent above the roster, select its avatar to open its main chat, or use its menu to open **Sessions** or **Settings**. Rows show when an agent is busy and preview its latest available assistant reply.

The **Sessions** page brings search, refresh, filters and **New session** together, with an **Agent** column in the all-agent view and a message when transcript search is unavailable. Sessions and Worktrees share the same title and tab layout. In team mode, the chat header identifies the agent and opens that conversation’s session and workspace actions. [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar)
Agent pins are saved in your browser profile and shared with the agent switcher. Sidebar previews come from visible, non-archived sessions.

[#174984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174984).

Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).




##### Agent avatars


With uploads enabled, the Control UI’s agent Identity editor lets you pick a Blobster preset or upload an image. If you have permission to generate avatars and the agent has a configured model, you can describe a new avatar and preview it before applying it. Avatar selections and changes to the agent’s name or emoji save automatically.

The agent’s avatar also appears in Control UI notices when a background session finishes and in supported browser push notifications, including approval alerts. Private notifications keep the generic icon.
Identity editor and avatar picker.

[#173773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173773).

Avatars in notices and browser push.

[#173774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173774).

Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).




##### Paired-device session folders


Admins can browse folders on a supported paired device when starting a session. In **New Session**, choose **Existing folder on** your device, then select **Use this folder** to set the working folder. If an entered path is missing or isn’t a folder, the picker can open the device’s home folder. Writers enter the path manually, and the device validates the chosen folder when the session starts. [Paired-device session hosting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting)
[#174713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174713).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).




##### Composer predictions


The Control UI can suggest a follow-up after a reply. Turn on **Composer predictions** in **Settings → Labs**, then press **Tab** or choose **Use suggestion** to put an editable draft in the message box. You decide when to send it.

Predictions are off by default and appear only in eligible empty composers. Read-only, imported and incognito conversations are excluded. Each active tab can make an extra model request per completed reply, which can add usage and cost. See the [Control UI chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat).
Adds opt-in follow-up drafts in the Control UI.

[#172543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172543).

Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) for the contribution and Json for the request and design input.




##### Plugin guidance in Control UI chat


Expand a guidance notice in Control UI chat or history to see what was recorded during an active run, which plugin added it and when. The notice shows the original guidance by default. Plugins can supply separate wording with `displayText`. See [prompt and session hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session).
Attributed guidance notices in live chat and history.

[#173456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173456).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

- Fixes pending Control UI messages getting stuck after a disconnect. Eligible first prompts and supported attachment sends retry in order, and queued messages and Steer sends wait through a Gateway pause. Retrying the same message with its original key in the same session can confirm an already accepted send without sending it twice. Sends that cannot safely retry may need review; rejected sends offer **Retry** and **Discard**, which removes only the browser copy. If browser storage is blocked or full, eligible sends can retry and remain visible when you reopen the conversation in the same account and tab, but closing or manually reloading the tab can lose unsaved messages. [Offline and reconnect](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect)
  See the [session control protocol](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control) for chat admission and the [Control UI Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) for pending sends.

  [#182334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182334), [#182436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182436), [#182639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182639), [#182795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182795).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

- Keeps pending Settings edits available after an agent identity update or brief Gateway disconnect. Unrelated edits can save and same-field conflicts stay in the draft; unsent form changes resume autosaving only when the saved settings still match and no earlier save is unconfirmed. Drafts can still be lost on reload or tab close. See [offline and reconnect](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect).
  Channels no longer appears empty just because the connection dropped. Failed model-default and account-order saves leave edits available, device approval edits detect competing changes on save, and restricted settings clear when access is revoked. The sources cover the identity update and settings reconnect.

##### Boards, dashboards and activity

  For dashboards and dashboard app loading, see [Control UI reconnect behavior](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect.md) and the [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui).

##### Conversation and session controls


- Fixes forced replies in external chats when an agent chooses silence and removes a standalone trailing `NO_REPLY` line from an otherwise useful answer or displayed history. When an owed answer is still missing after recovery, users see a system notice.
  Quoted or punctuated mentions of the marker stay visible, and unbuffered previews can briefly show the trailing line. A retry for an undelivered message can end silently when no reply is needed. Silent replies · missing replies · trailing marker.

  [#170534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170534), [#170972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170972), [#171990](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171990).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@richardmqq](https://github.com/richardmqq), [@Irish-Joseph](https://github.com/Irish-Joseph) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@cipp-ashe](https://github.com/cipp-ashe) and [@eonicman](https://github.com/eonicman) for reports.
- Fixes nested sessions ignoring the selected sidebar sort order and expands the parent to show newly added persistent child sessions, with a child count and collapse control.
  [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar) · Child sorting · Child reveal.

  [#172189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172189), [#172362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172362).

  Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes delays while streaming long replies containing internal model markers or lots of HTML or JSX. OpenClaw removes markers from ordinary text while keeping them in code examples, and the HTML or JSX reply text stays unchanged.
  Model markers · [issue #175444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175444) · HTML and JSX · [issue #175439](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175439).

  [#175448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175448), [#175472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175472).

  Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the merge contribution.
- Fixes session catalog copies and imports hanging on faulty pagination, retaining the history already read and warning when the copy is incomplete.

  [#133459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133459).

  [#145604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145604).

  Thanks [@zyz619963502zyz](https://github.com/zyz619963502zyz) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the fix and [@ikenraf](https://github.com/ikenraf) for the report.
- Fixes delegated and recovered work using the wrong requester permissions. Collaborative steering defaults to enabled, so admitted participants can steer an active turn under its original requester’s permissions, including permissions they may not have themselves. Set `messages.queue.allowCollaborativeSteering` to `false` to put another participant’s message in a separate turn under their own permissions. With steering disabled, set `messages.queue.collaborativeSteeringFallback` to `reject` to require `/followup <message>`. Resubmit older pending sends if their requester details cannot be recovered.
  Supported session tools can select an admitted participant. Channel plugin authors should migrate configuration-derived tool policies to the documented policy resolvers. [Queue settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/queue.md) · [Session tools](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session-tool.md) · [Audit receipts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/audit.md) · [Channel plugin migration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-migration/compatibility-policy.md). Quiet steering fallback · Steering defaults and fallback retained.

  [#157806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157806), [#185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477), [#186381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186381).

- Removes blank assistant replies after tool-only turns while keeping tool activity and other visible results in chat. - Fixes public conversation links leaving out saved inline widgets or showing their markup as text. With Canvas hosting enabled, signed-out readers can interact with eligible widgets. Unchanged widgets stay in place during live updates while their URLs remain valid, and an invalid widget reference no longer blocks the conversation from opening. Supported external embeds such as YouTube appear as plain links without loading an external player, page or thumbnail. Review your existing public links, since previously omitted widgets may now be visible. [Public conversation links](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls#public-session-transcripts)

- Fixes busy chat sessions falling behind when saved-message notifications pile up. Clients can catch up by refreshing the conversation, and saved messages stay in the transcript. [Gateway events guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events)

If the disk is full, free space on the computer running OpenClaw. If there is no known storage cause, wait for current work to finish, reopen the conversation and restart OpenClaw if the problem persists. [Storage error troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/troubleshooting/agent-replies-and-control-ui#agent-run-failed-with-a-storage-error)
  First-message storage · [Session control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control) · Unconfirmed-save guidance

- Fixes personal sidebar pins staying visible after you lose access to a session. The stale pin clears on the current connection, and the saved shortcut can reappear if access returns. Pins outside the current session list also pick up session updates.
  [#185067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185067).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes session archive retention skipping cleanup when cron is off or has no sessions to remove. With age-based retention enforced, eligible reset and deletion archives that are already overdue can now be removed. [Session maintenance and retention](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance).
  [#182053](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182053).

  Thanks [@yuaneen](https://github.com/Yuaneen), steipete, indra622, and card4philippe.
- Reduces memory left in use after archived-session lists or searches, queued follow-ups and steering messages, and session deletion. Background maintenance also releases data from its first request.
  **Archive reads**, **queued messages** and **session cleanup**

  [#182836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182836), [#184981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184981), [#186060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186060).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session reads stalling when routine database cleanup overlaps a health check, and session creation or edits failing when two requests open the same agent database at once.
  **Session reads** and **session creation and edits**

  [#185877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185877), [#185891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185891).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session lists failing while a model provider reloads. The list waits for current results, and if you disconnect, other clients can keep waiting.
  Original contribution.

  [#186296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186296), [#182783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182783).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) (original contribution and co-author).
- Fixes active child sessions disappearing from their controller’s session list, and stops conversations appearing busy solely because a child has moved to the top level. Activity stays with the moved conversation and its actual controllers.
  **Conversation activity**

  [#183418](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183418).

  Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) in [#183389](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183389).

  **Child session lists**

  [#183440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183440).

  Thanks [@zongzuoscc](https://github.com/zongzuoscc) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Sessions transcript search open and focused when Escape cancels text composition or is part of a keyboard shortcut. A plain Escape outside text composition closes the search.
  [#181991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181991).

  Thanks [@AmelioMansour](https://github.com/AmelioMansour) and obviyus.
- Fixes typing in the open **Assign to** menu triggering other shortcuts or sending text to chat. Start typing in the sidebar or chat header menu to filter people and agents without clicking the search field first. [Session assignment guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
  [#182016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182016).

  Thanks steipete.
- Keeps your highlighted slash command when suggestions refresh, as long as the command is still available.
  [#184530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184530).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a delayed session list response from reverting the Access setting shown in the Control UI after you save it. Newer session changes still appear.
  [#184725](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184725).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the session sidebar from jumping as rows settle or a saved scroll position is restored.
  [#185137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185137).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session drags being ignored when the sidebar shows categories in place of your saved **Person** grouping. Move sessions between categories or drag an eligible categorized group conversation back to **Groups** while keeping that preference.
  [#185134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185134).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the mobile archive notice layout so the icon sits beside the title or text, with Unarchive alongside.
  [#184767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184767).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes the filled hover background behind the **New session** plus button in sidebar group headers while keeping the icon highlight.
  [#185122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185122).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the extra blank space above error messages in Control UI session hovercards.
  [#185182](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185182).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Replaces generic person IDs in the mention picker with linked, verified GitHub handles when offline recipients have no saved name and a handle is available.
  [#186651](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186651).
- Replaces the retry prompt for unsupported generated files with recovery instructions. Download the original from Files if it was saved to the session and you have access, or ask your agent for a ZIP. Supported attachments in the reply remain available.
  [#186670](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186670).

  Thanks shakkernerd.
- Corrects the [Control UI Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) to explain that starting a Draft session opens it and sends your first message. Draft controls who can see the session, and background submission is not available for Drafts.
  [#186402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186402).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the blank project picker in New Session when projects fail to load. You can see the error and select **Retry** without losing your draft. A failed refresh keeps the projects that already loaded, and a failed first load keeps your saved project selected.
  [#187062](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187062).

  Thanks [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@rtfcv](https://github.com/rtfcv).
- Fixes the terminal UI waiting too long to send messages or giving up on chat history too soon when the system clock changes during startup.
  [#183635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183635).

  Thanks [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw resume` staying open after Ctrl-C before the terminal UI opens. Canceling at that point also closes its Gateway connection.
  [#187225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187225).

  Thanks yy19971996, obviyus and alix-007.
- Prevents OpenClaw from dropping words or trying to switch models when you mention `/model` mid-sentence and the next word doesn’t resolve to a model. The message reaches your current model intact instead of risking an unwanted switch or rejection.
  [#187416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187416).

  Thanks wyf027, obviyus, felixboenkost-droid and holny.
- Fixes long streamed replies slowing down around inline code, comparisons, links or filtered tool-call text. It also fixes missing line breaks or code examples and stray tool-call text appearing in replies.
  Inline code and comparisons, line breaks and double brackets

  [#187433](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187433), [#187434](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187434), [#187656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187656).

  Thanks ericcaiwx-star, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI), wyf027 and wbxl2000 for the earlier fixes.

  Filtered traces and invisible-only replies, tool-call filtering, and HTML and comparisons. See [Streaming](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming).

  [#174313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174313), [#174353](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174353), [#174833](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174833).

  Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Final answers and citations. See [Issue #175264](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175264).

  [#175328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175328).

  Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) for the report.
- Prevents an unsent New Session draft from reverting an explicit execution permission such as Read Only to Default when you reload the Control UI. The choice stays with that draft and does not carry over after you create the session.
  [#187569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187569).

  Thanks shakkernerd.
- Fixes follow-ups from the same authorized writer in sandboxed chat and web chat corrections to Codex starting or waiting for another turn instead of steering the reply in progress.
  Sandboxed follow-ups · Codex web steering.

  [#187633](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187633), [#175810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175810).

  Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) for the sandbox fix and [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the Codex fix.
- Stops unchanged text requests from being fed back to the agent as recent chat history after a confirmed local reply from the message tool. Fixes progress updates being counted as answers when the run treats sends as progress by default.
  [#187795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187795), [#186081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186081).

  Thanks [@MertBasar0](https://github.com/MertBasar0), and to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the #187795 release backport.
- Removes stray Markdown quote marks from plain-text message previews, including quotes without a space after the marker and nested quotes.
  [#187853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187853).

  Thanks [@coaimax](https://github.com/coaiMax), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Removes blank rows left in chat history by completed assistant replies that had nothing to show.
  [#188111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188111).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes archived PostgreSQL conversations failing to resume after a period of inactivity. Restoring the conversation keeps its earlier messages and lets the conversation view refresh with that history.
  [#189991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189991).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (b6cb943).
- Fixes session subscriptions, shared-session updates and artifact downloads being refused when bulk session reads fill the Gateway queue.
  Session capacity and plugin priority reads

  [#199564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199564), [commit de8696fb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/de8696fb87a06dbe4147e3ad8d3dd9b8b404e123).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes oversized conversation previews keeping later sessions out of the [Codex session list](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness). When the details of an affected interactive session can be recovered, it shows an error status that survives restarts and clears when Codex returns it normally.
  [openclaw/openclaw@f76d912f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f76d912f5d79f9f22330c92bd9c9c8e761dbf508), [#173789](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173789).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves earlier tool calls and results as text when resuming an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions conversation after those tools become unavailable.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed711106a5dcceef7be27cb094bb44481d235f44).
- Avoids repeat downloads of unchanged managed outgoing chat image thumbnails when an authorized app checks for a newer copy.

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes New Session suggesting a retry when it lacks permission to look for a Git repository. It shows the missing permission when known and points you to the person who manages OpenClaw. Starting a worktree session still requires access, but your selected worktree and unsent draft are kept.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f0973e37405d683e242e217f4d7c30a1efc4118).

  Thanks [@ylcn91](https://github.com/ylcn91) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes progress labels and reasoning drafts dropping complete words that still fit or cutting text with characters such as emoji shorter than necessary.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21f0262a8883e02054ca05e9509a7249e470cb64).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes announcements in shared conversations picking up messages already accepted for another active request. Those messages stay with the original request even when [Collect mode](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue) combines them or the request reuses its saved input.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a823a52f080634f24fd90826ea7603d9618466db).

  Thanks [@chuanleiguo](https://github.com/chuanleiguo).
- Keeps eligible assistant progress in refreshed history when a stopped or length-limited reply has no visible answer, while respecting silent replies and display settings.
  [commit c4f6b26](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4f6b267b390aeb0fae16e50e103102326f8556b).
- Keeps older chat history reachable across hidden rows and preserves continuation after large pages. The UI no longer offers earlier history without an anchor, and a pending refill survives rejection of an outdated snapshot.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Bounds expansion when opening compressed session archives to their stored size plus 1 MiB. If a valid archive exceeds the limit, the original stays unchanged and you can export it as uncompressed JSONL to read it.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Prevents a retry of an already committed message from creating another turn, while refusing conflicting content or sender identity.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps a limited amount of an unfinished request through repeated conversation compactions without replacing it with internal updates or reviving completed work.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps a queued message from sending while its inline edit is still in progress.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Gives a prior writer a limited time to release a conversation before a Codex fork or resume handoff.
  [commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Repairs eligible saved titles showing `[OpenClaw session event]`. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to derive a title from the conversation or clear the marker; user-set names are preserved.
  [commit 7ca4c3c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ca4c3c69590766003d7a6ae10951efa5f15650e).
- Reduces history held in memory during manual and budget-driven compaction. Compaction stops if the selected history is incomplete or mismatched.
  [commit 590f76b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/590f76bb72cfe7a0b0b30536caa3fd79a36c4718).
- Processes large sessions as a stream during manual trimming, keeping the header and requested tail. The trim is rejected if the transcript changes before it is saved.
  [commit 62bb192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/62bb192d22f949d3db0e5d12078fca8a60f9c303).
- Redacts recognized credentials from quoted compaction excerpts before shortening them. The original transcript is unchanged, and pattern matching does not cover every secret.
  [commit 21bb4e7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21bb4e7b236a68de5554b3f69c291b20a51cd207).
- Keeps eligible completed Claude CLI replies in saved chat history and prevents internal instructions from finished background commands appearing as messages you sent when viewing or importing that history.
  Saved replies and background instructions

  [Saved replies](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cfd37ff97525dd35d816735b6aaf8ae1e5a98de), [#174780](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174780).

  Thanks [@maliv2](https://github.com/maliv2) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@AlwaysTwig](https://github.com/AlwaysTwig) and [@Induj1](https://github.com/Induj1) for the reports.
- Fixes later CLI turns getting stuck after cleanup fails for a previous session.
  [Commit 33e52df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33e52df4cd03e9e6a7d30849c702b45196aa5883).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@zeroaltitude](https://github.com/zeroaltitude).
- Fixes Doctor being unable to repair session history in cold storage, including history kept after an agent rename.
  [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [Commit 4ae9adf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4ae9adfae09fc63d302b38d4b06156fb7ffff132).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#173767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173767).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Shows a sign-in prompt instead of a misleading connection error when a signed-out visitor opens a conversation link behind a sign-in proxy such as Cloudflare Access.
  [#173820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173820).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automatic session titles staying provisional when a failed title fallback uses the same model as the conversation. OpenClaw can retry the model through the conversation’s own runtime instead of giving up.
  [#174164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174164).

  Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes session list and history requests being rejected when clients reconnect during recovery of a large subagent backlog after a Gateway restart.
  [subagent operations guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/operations.md).

  [#174248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174248).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174278).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174282](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174282).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#174435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174435).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174462).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174509).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174579).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#174808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174808).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#174871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174871).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes OpenAI Responses replacing the history chosen by Lossless and similar context engines when you connect with an API key, including when you reopen a session. Existing sessions don’t need a reset, and you can still opt in to OpenAI managing the history. Memory extraction no longer uses OpenAI’s compacted history even if you opt in. See [context engines](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/context-engine.md).
  [#174881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174881).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

  [#175090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175090).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@hermod-asgard](https://github.com/hermod-asgard) for the related report. See [CLI backend history boundaries](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#history-account-boundaries).

  [#175219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175219).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#175721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175721).

##### Starting and writing conversations

- Opens the composer directly from **New conversation** in team mode, using the agent you last selected for that Gateway in this browser. You can choose another agent in the composer or use the **+** beside an agent. A compact layout keeps setup and the draft together on phones and short landscape screens, with a scrolling writing area for longer drafts. See the [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui).
  New conversation.

  [#173824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173824).

  Thanks steipete.
- Adds file and image attachments to the Control UI command palette, so you can prepare a background session while keeping your current conversation open. The first attachment selects **New session**; submit when ready. Closing the palette keeps its draft for the same Gateway and account until you reload.
  [Command palette guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui#command-palette-file-attachments)

  [#178842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178842).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Groups repository and checkout controls together in **New Session**.
  Repository and checkout controls [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c96ef749f451f534f341a53d5da96d477fb4140).
- Reduces repeated work when preparing a first session. Preparing draft conversation titles also takes less work, especially in workspaces with many skills.
  The changes cover first-session preparation and draft title preparation.

  [#176462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176462), [#187092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187092).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes duplicate workspace setup when you attach files in a sandboxed chat.
  [#184985](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184985).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less temporary memory to prepare inline PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF attachments while preserving their display dimensions.
  [#186136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186136), [#186178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186178).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets compatible human input steer a visible background completion in a supporting embedded runtime, where acceptance makes a reply required. Hidden work and unsupported backends, including native Codex for these completions, handle the input in a follow-up turn; another person’s pending question stays open.
  [Queue and steering](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/queue-steering.md). The change also preserves accepted human replies in native Codex steering transcripts.

  [#176245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176245).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Queues a message for a separate turn under the sender’s permissions when a shared conversation is busy and collaborative steering is off, without a routine queue notice. Explicit `/followup` requests still get an acknowledgment, and you are told if a full queue drops your message. Set `messages.queue.collaborativeSteeringFallback` to `reject` to refuse these messages. When collaboration is on, other participants can steer the active turn under the permissions it started with. See the [queue and steering guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering).
  [#185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).

  Related queue proposal by [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

  [#184846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184846).
- Adds **Dismiss** for individual canceled inputs in regular Control UI chats where you have permission to send. The input stays hidden across devices while its content and attachments remain stored. [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  [#134887](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/134887)

  [#180871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180871).

  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Moves paging for saved unsent messages from the composer to the top of scrolling chat history. If you have multiple pages of unsent messages, scroll to the start of the conversation to find **Show earlier unsent messages** and **Show latest unsent messages**.
  [Control UI chat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md)

  [#179687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179687).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for co-authoring.
- Shows whether the agent, storage key, or storage source changed when a session storage conflict prevents a chat message from sending.
  [#181959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181959).

  Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b) and steipete.
- Saves the final prompt and its matching history entry together on supported durable embedded-agent turns, so an interrupted save can’t leave the entry without its prompt. This takes less work and records the prompt before the model request starts. Your original message stays saved if the paired save fails. [Database worker access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/worker-access.md)
  [#178088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178088).

  [#185601](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185601), [#185613](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185613), [#186087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186087).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  These changes cover pending message lookup, dispatch of new messages and recovery of operator messages.

  [#182883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182883), [#182971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182971), [#183880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183880).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Session controls and navigation

- Records you as the creator by default when you ask an agent to start a session or schedule work, so you can find and manage eligible sessions you started even when they are assigned to someone else. [Creator attribution](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session#creators-and-assigned-owners) does not change the permissions the work runs with or publish anything, and existing records keep their original attribution.
  [#178493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178493).

  Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Groups devices, the Gateway and cloud profiles in the session destination picker. When moving a session, you can see its current location if known, choose a different destination and retry if destinations fail to load. Unavailable choices explain why they cannot be selected. You cannot move to the same known destination, though changing the machine or operating system on the same cloud profile counts as a different destination where available.
  Destination picker

  [#176437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176437).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds a choice to archive a parent or its eligible session tree, with **Archive all (N)** as the main choice, Undo for the tree and a warning about active work.
  - Adds a choice to archive a parent session alone or archive its whole nested tree, with **Undo** for the tree. Archiving only the parent moves its nested sessions to the top level. The dialog warns about active work. See [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).

    Sessions already moved out of the tree stay outside its archive.

    [#172489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172489).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Makes **Archive all (N)** the main choice when the eligible session tree is available, with a count that includes the parent and all eligible nested sessions. Choose **Archive only this session** to move its direct children to the top level without archiving them. Deeper sessions stay nested beneath those children. On narrow screens, both archive choices stay together above **Cancel** when there’s room. [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar)

    [#180738](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180738).

    Thanks jacobtomlinson.
- Speeds up transcript archive preparation when deleting a session and reduces work to preserve local changes in a safety snapshot when deleting an archived session with a managed worktree. ##### Archived conversations

- Reduces memory and repeated work when opening archived answers and histories, including when several archived conversations are reopened together. Older transcript locations also require fewer repeated file checks.
  The changes cover archived results, history pages and storage lookups; reopening multiple [archived conversation histories](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes); archived answers and history pages; and older and moved transcript locations.

  [#183110](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183110), [#183201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183201), [#183294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183294), [#184055](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184055), [#184082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184082).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Speeds up large archived transcript restores, reducing the time other updates to the same agent’s sessions may wait. Retrieving final answers from archives with long quoted text also requires less scanning.
  The changes cover archived transcript restores and archived answer retrieval.

  [#186315](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186315), [#178475](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178475).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#185618](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185618).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work to prepare and archive older session transcripts. Raw exports and read-only checks can also use cold transcripts without restoring them, and archive or unarchive operations skip a reload when the activity recap is current.
  [Session maintenance guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance.md).

  [#184280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184280), [#185881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185881), [#185955](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185955).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work during automatic transcript archiving and cleanup, and when deleting SQLite-backed sessions with retained transcript history.
  The changes cover SQLite session deletion, automatic transcript archiving, repeated maintenance checks and archive cleanup.

  [#186199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186199), [#187046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187046), [#187093](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187093), [#174390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174390).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  The changes cover cleanup with retained subagent runs, worker session-store cleanup, SQLite turn and empty-index maintenance, and turn maintenance when indexing progress is unchanged.

  [#181324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181324), [#183027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183027), [#183127](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183127), [#183234](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183234), [#183388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183388), [#183481](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183481).

##### Live updates and replies

- Reduces work and temporary memory for session snapshots and live updates to connected clients, including shared sessions and chat progress after reconnecting.
  - Reduces Gateway work for session and transcript updates, shared-session typing and suggestions, streaming, and Activity recaps. Sending updates to many subscribed tabs also uses less temporary memory.

    The changes cover session and transcript broadcasts, shared-session typing and suggestions, streaming disk checks, Activity recaps, and active session and subscriber updates. For Activity recaps, see [Gateway events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces repeated work sending session updates to compatible clients and refreshing shared sessions. It also reduces work showing chat progress after reconnecting and tool progress from cloud workers, saving streaming tool progress for reconnects, and streaming replies in the Control UI and terminal chat.

    These changes cover incremental updates across tabs and full parent details when needed, updates to compatible clients, chat progress after reconnecting and tool progress from cloud workers, partial updates, reconnect progress, streaming chat, and shared-session broadcasts when details change.

    [#181327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181327), [#183877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183877), [#183914](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183914), [#183920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183920), [#184097](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184097), [#184178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184178), [#184196](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184196), [#184201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184201), [#184309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184309), [#184310](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184310).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces CPU work and temporary memory for preparing and sending session snapshots and live updates to connected clients, including repeated updates for the same viewers, clients with different earlier updates, compact updates and updates without visible parent sessions.

    [#184565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184565), [#184608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184608), [#184665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184665), [#184729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184729), [#184829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184829), [#184902](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184902), [#184935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184935), [#185073](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185073), [#185049](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185049), [#185104](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185104), [#185179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185179), [#185507](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185507).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Uses less temporary memory for session history snapshots and cuts CPU and temporary memory when preparing session updates for recipients who see the same information.

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

    [#185222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185222).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Session storage and processing

- Reduces database work and temporary memory when saving conversation history, including replies and tool results in SQLite-backed sessions.
  - Reduces database work for regular and some active transcript saves, SQLite session operations and retained writes.

    For regular session turns on SQLite and PostgreSQL, see [Issue #182810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182810).

    [#183034](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183034).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).

    These changes cover SQLite write bookkeeping, unlabeled session creation, attaching runs without starting a turn, active transcript saves and PostgreSQL round trips. See the [remaining routing work identified by etzelm in #182810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182810).

    [#183050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183050), [#183156](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183156), [#183139](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183139), [#183204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183204).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces CPU, copying and temporary memory when saving changed agent prompts whose tool definitions are already stored with the session, eligible transcript and tool-result appends, streamed tool turns and entries in long transcripts.

    [#184235](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184235), [#184322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184322), [#185185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185185), [#185735](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185735).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces work when saving replies and tool results in SQLite-backed sessions and appending messages to conversation history, including large tool results. Saving new tool results with many lists also uses less temporary memory.

    The changes cover SQLite reply and tool-result saves, transcript appends and tool-result memory.

    [#186213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186213), [#186268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186268), [#186800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186800).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database and disk work when saving sessions, reading and preparing history, compacting conversations and cleaning up old data. Automatic capacity cleanup also lets foreground writes proceed between batches.
  The changes cover appending and recording replies ([Session database workers](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/worker-access.md)), retention and cleanup batches ([Session maintenance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session.md)), cold history reads, model changes and retained history, unchanged session checks ([Session history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session)), and legacy and queued compaction.

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#179164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179164), [#179171](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179171), [#179179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179179).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeat reads, copying and memory allocation when updating saved or already-loaded sessions, including activity updates from messages and tool results. Plugins still receive editable results that do not change the saved session.

##### Files and panels beside chat


##### Files and outputs

- Adds **Toggle file tree** to the desktop Files reader in [chat panels](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/panels), so you can show a folder list beside the file you’re reading and pick the next file without switching back. On mobile, tap the chat title to open [Details](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#session-details) and switch between Details and panels without clearing your chat draft.
  Files keeps your place as you browse and tells you when search results or attachment coverage are incomplete.

  - Desktop Files ([#176326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176326)) · Mobile Files ([#176329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176329)). Filter by file activity or retry a failed listing.
  - File reader ([#176339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176339)) and resizable file list ([#176343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176343)). Temporary previews with unsaved edits stay open when you open another file, and pinning keeps those edits in place.
  - Panel layout ([#176356](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176356)), mobile Details ([#176527](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176527)) and panel navigation ([#176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653)) let you move between session information and available tools.
  - Review ([#176349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176349)) offers diff layout and reading controls. On mobile, **Sync details** can show a command to mirror committed changes locally; uncommitted edits remain in the session checkout. Revealed unchanged lines can be folded again with [#176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds **Download** to the Files list and preview toolbar in the [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui), including for files too large to preview. Individual downloads use the saved file on supported session workspaces and require the Control UI and Gateway to share an origin.
  [#172042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172042).

  Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson). Downloads are unavailable on node workspaces whose bridges only support whole-file reads.
- Adds **Attach to session** to an open file’s menu in [Control UI chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui). The attachment includes unsaved text edits without saving the file, and goes out when you send the message.
  Attach eligible files, images and PDFs from the viewer. The composer applies its usual upload permissions and size limits.

  [#179609](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179609).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Keeps loaded files browsable and searchable on desktop and in the legacy Files view through a refresh failure or retry, with folders still open. Desktop and mobile Outputs retain their rows and keyboard focus. A newer preview of the same file can appear while an older request is still pending.
  [#180031](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180031).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Collapses the Files tree when you open a reader from the file list and remembers your choice as you switch between open tabs.
  [#181903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181903).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Makes searching and filtering the desktop Files panel more responsive in large folders that contain only files. Browser Find and screen-reader browsing cover only rendered filenames in these folders. Use Files search to look across the whole workspace.
  [#184230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184230).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the wait to open folders or search Files in large managed guest workspaces, while still showing up-to-date files.
  [#186616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186616).

  Thanks shakkernerd.
- Reduces unnecessary browser CPU work when you expand folders in large Control UI workspaces.
  [#185338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185338).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids a redundant disk check when you open the top level of a local session’s Files view.
  [#185550](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185550).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work needed to open or refresh files and diffs in a conversation’s current workspace.
  [#184621](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184621).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the processing needed to list session and conversation artifacts.
  The changes cover session and conversation artifacts.

  [#182205](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182205), [#186159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186159).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Changes and pull requests

- Adds automatic retries when session checkout changes take a while to load, keeping the loading view or the previous diff in place while **Review** is visible. API clients can opt in with `poll: true` on `sessions.diff`. Retry a `computing: true` response to get the diff when it’s ready.
  [#179091](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179091).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
- Cuts extra Git work when opening uncommitted session diffs that need no starting comparison and uncached diffs in checkouts without a branch.
  - Reduces Git work when opening uncommitted session diffs that do not need comparison with the starting changes, and when Review hides edits that predate the session. It also cuts extra Git work when looking up a fallback comparison branch.

    [#176842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176842), [#181918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181918).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Cuts unnecessary Git work when opening an uncached session diff in a checkout that isn’t on a branch, without changing what the diff shows.

    [#185967](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185967).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work when refreshing session diffs and sharing them with multiple viewers, and can make an eligible file’s patch visible again after an extra hard link is removed.
  - Reduces work and memory use when refreshing session diffs, including checkouts with many untracked files. Eligible non-Windows checkouts can reuse an unchanged result while still checking for real edits. Removing an extra hard link can also make an eligible file’s patch visible again.

    Repeat-read reuse for session diff previews applies to eligible non-Windows checkouts. See [Prometheus metrics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) for cache reuse and miss reasons. Other changes cover untracked-file memory use, unchanged diff polls and checks for outside edits.

    [#177195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177195), [#177762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177762), [#184284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184284), [#185684](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185684), [#186222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186222).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces the work of serving a session diff to several viewers, refreshing diff summaries in very large local checkouts, and waiting for the Changes summary while other Git reads are busy. Reopening full diffs in large non-sparse checkouts and refreshing oversized diffs without patch previews also takes less work.

    In the [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui), these changes cover shared diff reads, the Changes summary, large checkout summaries, oversized diffs and reopening full diffs.

    [#177329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177329), [#177386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177386), [#177476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177476), [#185831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185831), [#186170](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186170).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated Git work in the Changes panel for clean checkouts and for checkouts with nested repositories or submodules.
  - Cuts repeat scans for clean Git checkouts in the Changes panel, including when opening **All changes**. Committed branch changes remain visible and later edits are picked up.

    [#185087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185087), [#186210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186210).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Reduces repeated Git work in the [Changes panel](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui) by reusing unchanged diffs for checkouts with nested repositories, submodules or an external ignore file, and by cutting checks when a large checkout can only show a summary. Changes to the ignore file or a submodule commit still refresh the diff. Automatic checks of folders that are not Git checkouts wait briefly before trying again, while manual refresh checks immediately.

    [#178400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178400), [#178574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178574).

    Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets the shared Git read finish in the background after you cancel your view and stop waiting for the result.
  [#173523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173523).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows additions and deletions in desktop chat Details → Environment, with a control to open the uncommitted diff.
  Desktop Environment line counts · [11.5 Details implementation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-details-environment.tsx)

  [#171794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171794).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a mobile pull request publication review for sessions with an eligible branch or retained publication. It shows available repository, branch, account and publication status before you act. Opening the review does not publish the pull request.
  [#176416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176416).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Puts pull request status and a checks badge beside the title in compact session Details. The actions menu brings together repository and change information, checks, CI monitoring, and options to open, copy or hide the pull request. Hidden checks and monitoring views stop refreshing. If details fail to load, you can retry, and an out-of-date page offers a reload when it will not interrupt your work.
  [#176424](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176424).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

##### Chat Details and activity

Open a subagent or process for a closer look, use **View all** on desktop to open Files, or choose **Show in chat** to put the saved plan back in the conversation.

The panels also refresh when a session moves, resets or changes access, and share updates when both views show the same conversation. Refreshes pause when neither view is visible or the browser tab is hidden.
  Process views — [Control UI guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui.md) Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176417); Background processes in chat — Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). - Hides empty sections in desktop chat Details. Environment, Outputs and Progress appear when there’s something to show, and Processes appears while work is running. Output errors still appear, and you can choose **Retry** if the process list fails to load.
  [#179558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179558), [#179560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179560).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Reorganizes the Context panel so you can see usage, refresh the report or compact when permitted without scrolling through every category. Choose **View context** from the composer to open one category at a time and search or expand long lists. Focusing a category highlights its share of usage, and **Escape** closes it and returns focus to its button. Background refresh keeps your open category and search. [Chat context guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)

##### Chat and Side chat

- Adds photo attachments, microphone dictation and emoji suggestions to [Side chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#session-rail-and-side-chat), along with its own model, reasoning and speed choices. **Default** uses the agent’s utility model and fallbacks; an explicitly selected model handles the question on its own, and photo questions need an image-capable model.
