#### Updates and Maintenance

This section covers Gateway maintenance, backups and recovery, database storage, and updates to managed workspaces.




##### Installing, updating and recovery


- Fixes Doctor repeatedly deferring unindexed legacy conversations whose repeated session headers differ only by timestamp. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to import affected conversations while preserving the original transcript bytes. See the [Doctor session guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions).
  [#172360](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172360).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor blocking retries of interrupted legacy session imports when the stored history matches. Rerun `openclaw doctor --fix` on the same state directory. Doctor can append a verified missing suffix and archive matching originals. For conflicts or unsafe gaps, it reports the blocking finding and keeps the originals.
  Earlier PR · [Issue #172866](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172866).

  [#173380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173380), [#172875](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172875).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@wangxiajun68](https://github.com/wangxiajun68) (earlier implementation).
- Fixes update repair failing immediately when a known short-lived OpenClaw process holds shared state.
  Update-time Doctor shows progress while it waits for an identified non-Gateway process to release shared state. It waits up to 20 minutes by default, with a shorter budget when time has already elapsed or needs to be reserved for rehearsal.

  [#172636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172636).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).

  [Doctor recovery documentation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/recovery.md#L119-L129).
- Fixes updates failing when another OpenClaw process briefly holds an agent database open while the Gateway is stopped. Update-time Doctor waits for it to close within the update deadline.
  If the deadline expires, Doctor defers maintenance and reports the process ID holding the database. See [update troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ec38f535d3d5de9e087d834fe58e6190852fcb2a/docs/install/update-troubleshooting.md).

  [#172772](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172772).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Reports incomplete Linux systemd checks in Doctor and human-readable Gateway status when service files or backups are unreadable. Skips legacy cleanup after incomplete discovery and stops service owner lookup on inspection errors. If Doctor names a path it could not inspect, restore access and rerun Doctor before retrying cleanup. [Doctor service checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  [#175012](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175012).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Linux Gateway service checks hiding cleanup or ownership errors behind an unknown status or a fallback command. Installation also reports these errors during its final check instead of reporting success. If that check fails, inspect the service before retrying because it may already be running.
  [#175709](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175709).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes package updates getting blocked by permission changes on Linux when recovery can safely use the updater’s own files or an otherwise verified saved package. The updater makes its own eligible recovery files private and removes extra write access from verified saved packages where possible, preserving read and execute access there. The updater running the update needs these fixes.
  Exactly matching older recovery records still work with their original permissions. See [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) and [Issue #170032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170032).

  [#175423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175423), [#175449](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175449), [Follow-up permission repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/812e50f37809).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@council10-kera](https://github.com/council10-kera) for the original report and [@ceo633](https://github.com/ceo633) for the ACL follow-up.
- Fixes package updates failing during permission repairs on files shared through hard links.
  [#175626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175626).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes managed updates getting stuck while saving progress during the state snapshot. If an optional progress entry still cannot be saved, the update warns and continues. If it cannot save information needed for recovery or record the final result, it reports a failure. The fix takes effect when the installed updater that starts the update includes it.
  [Report #176813](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176813) · [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)

  [#176968](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176968).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@yoyo837](https://github.com/yoyo837).
- Fixes managed update snapshot timeouts that lost the last progress details. When the installed updater has the fix, the saved error and `openclaw update status` show where the snapshot stopped and how far it got. The size estimate covers the whole snapshot, including plugins. [Update status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update)
  [issue #177225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177225).

  [#177300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177300).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@unim0trix](https://github.com/unim0trix).
- Fixes migrated updates reporting a result before cleanup and recovery finish. The change applies when the installed updater already contains this fix.
  <span>Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#159644](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159644)</span>
- Stops extended-stable update checks from continuing after the Gateway shuts down.
  <span>Thanks [@adenzhou1350](https://github.com/adenzhou1350), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#161067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161067)</span>
- Fixes the Unix installer claiming OpenClaw is on PATH when it may not be. If your shell can’t find OpenClaw, use the command printed by the installer.
  <span>Thanks [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii), [@romneyda](https://github.com/RomneyDa). [#164038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164038)</span>
- Fixed source installs rejecting valid linked Git worktrees. Bash and PowerShell installers reject incomplete checkouts and nonempty destinations without a valid checkout at that path, and the Bash installers avoid moving a branch already checked out in another worktree.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172934](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172934) · [Installer guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/installer.md)
- Fixed updates run with the 11.5 updater failing after activation when a deleted agent has an intentionally retained database on an older schema.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the report. [#172975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172975) · [Managed updates](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/updating.md)
- Fixes Docker release-image preparation failing package validation when a sealed worker refers to a native helper missing from the package.
  [#173173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173173).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Feishu Doctor recovery backups that could miss committed database changes. Doctor takes a verified snapshot before deleting an affected session.
  [#173200](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173200).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates being rejected for insufficient snapshot space when enough space is available for current SQLite snapshots. The running updater and the candidate snapshot worker must both support the revised estimate. An older installed updater can still reject the first hop under its earlier reservation.
  Later migrations can require additional space.

  [#173284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173284).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes updates launched through a node waiting for the wrong Gateway, and fixes Gateway status identifying the node service as the Gateway. Restart the updated node to apply the fix. A handoff already stalled under an older node process needs separate recovery.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), coauthor [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), and reporter [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini). [#173304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173304) · [#171542](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171542) · [Node execution guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/node-exec.md)
- Fixes the Updates page showing **Update status unavailable** for an up-to-date package after a cached startup check when automatic updates are off.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), coauthors [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), and reporter [@stevenjj33](https://github.com/stevenjj33). [#173330](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173330) · [#173199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173199) · [Update status and history](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/status-and-history.md)
- Fixes Team deployment verification failing on a temporary readiness dip or a successful configured fallback model. Use provider-qualified fallback names, and settle existing transactions with their original controller before adopting the updated controller.
  The controller waits for readiness within the deployment deadline and verifies the fallback against the deployment’s configured models.

  [Team deployment controller](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md)

  [#173329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173329).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex replies and tool hooks failing on standalone installs without a separate CLI script. The same launch fix covers ACP, the terminal UI, completion refresh after updates, and live Gateway CLI checks. [Standalone install guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone)
  [#173473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173473).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a team-server deployment from being deferred prematurely when its drain deadline expires just before a status check starts. The controller applies the configured deadline policy and checks that it can safely interrupt before doing so.
  [#173525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173525).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw migrate codex` previews missing installed plugins and rejecting `--plugin` selection in a fresh process.
  [#173665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173665).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes read-only Doctor plugin checks writing temporary capture files into your OpenClaw state directory.
  [#174639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174639).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Crabbox trying to download a replacement when it can’t inspect its managed executable. `openclaw sandbox list` reports a failed lease check as an inspection error. Resolve the reported error before retrying. [Crabbox sandboxes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/crabbox-backend)
  [#174935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174935).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` hanging if you press Ctrl+C or send SIGTERM while it is preparing maintenance archives, before it stops the Gateway or starts repairs.
  [#174898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174898).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a false Gateway ownership error that could block startup or Doctor maintenance in PRoot Ubuntu.
  [Issue #171385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171385)

  [#174974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174974).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@caozhongbin](https://github.com/caozhongbin).
- Fixes automatic and managed-service update reports that showed only a generic handoff error. When the 11.5 updater runs the update, the report includes the underlying refusal if available.
  [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · [Issue #170032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170032).

  [#175423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175423).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates failing when a leftover setting keeps Doctor from saving an otherwise valid configuration repair. Doctor backs up the original, removes settings that no longer belong to OpenClaw or a plugin, and keeps settings that a plugin still needs to migrate.
  [Doctor configuration migrations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/doctor/config-migrations.md) · [Issue #174618](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174618).

  [#175404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175404).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@klausleopold](https://github.com/klausleopold) for the report.
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` skipping a required database migration for a stopped systemd Gateway when its service settings were already current or couldn’t be refreshed. With the Gateway and other state writers stopped, Doctor can continue the migration and warn about service settings it couldn’t refresh. Doctor rechecks which unit owns the Gateway, so a removed system unit can no longer block the repair.
  [Doctor recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/recovery) · [Issue #175400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175400).

  [#175492](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175492).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@halachung](https://github.com/halachung) for the report.
- Fixes offline Doctor repairs on Btrfs appearing to hang while copying unrelated agent files. Doctor now repairs only the affected SQLite files, shows its progress and skips files it already repaired if you rerun it after an interruption. If Doctor can’t confirm which files were put in place, inspect the recovery files before retrying.
  [Offline Btrfs repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#btrfs-and-nocow) · [Issue #175373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175373).

  [#175474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175474).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@asidko](https://github.com/asidko) for the report.
- Removes a redundant verification pass when Doctor creates a full or table-scoped SQLite migration backup. Doctor still checks backup integrity.
  [#175548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175548).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes backup cancellation errors leaving out how far the archive write got. The error includes the last recorded step and byte counts, plus the last file name when available.
  [#175636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175636).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes long SQLite agent database upgrades stopping when Doctor mistakenly reports losing exclusive maintenance access. Doctor warns when that database step runs long. The fix applies when the new version runs Doctor. [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)
  [#175588](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175588).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes older SQLite migrations and routine Doctor repairs running repeated full-database checks in quick mode. Quick mode checks changed tables in full and can miss an index mismatch in an untouched table. Use `--full-integrity-check` in 11.5 to check every table and index. This starts when the new version runs its checks. Recovery and restore verification still use full checks. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#175662](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175662).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes updates running past `--timeout` while saving the files the updater needs to keep working. That step reports progress, stops if dependency checks cannot make headway, and leaves the running installation untouched if the deadline expires. This protection starts once the updater containing the fix is installed. [Update command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update)
  [issue #171446](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171446).

  [#175626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175626).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), dibuyo.
- Prevents `openclaw onboard --reset` from changing files when configuration is unreadable or a reset would strand PostgreSQL data. For PostgreSQL, rerun without `--reset` or port supported stores to SQLite first. Use `openclaw reset --scope config` for a file-only reset. Interactive setup can offer to repair malformed configuration before opening a database. [Onboarding guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/onboard)
  [#175655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175655).

  Thanks steipete.
- Makes setup wait for its temporary Gateway before opening the terminal UI, even with `--skip-health`. If the Gateway cannot start, setup stops it before falling back to local mode. Leaving the terminal UI or pressing Ctrl+C also stops the temporary Gateway.
  [#175655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175655).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Doctor stopping an update because it could not check for pending Codex assignments while maintenance writes continued. The fix applies when the new version runs Doctor against a database it has already accepted. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#175659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175659).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Linux node service uninstall reporting success when it can’t read an existing service credentials file to clean it up. If you see this error, credential cleanup and the user systemd reload can still be pending after unit removal. [Node service commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)
  [#175669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175669).

  Thanks steipete.
- Keeps the file path and parse error visible when the CLI stops at startup because its configuration file or an included file is malformed, including during the new database selection step.
  [#175677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175677).

  Thanks steipete.
- Prevents interactive configure and onboarding from silently starting and re-enabling a Linux Gateway service you stopped and disabled. Choose **Skip** to leave it stopped and disabled, **Restart** to start it with autostart still disabled, or **Reinstall** to enable and start it. [Configure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/configure) · [Onboarding](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/onboard)
  [Issue #83354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83354).

  [#175680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175680).

  Thanks [@yxshee](https://github.com/yxshee), JamieJ5926, obviyus, cdeyoung67.
- Fixes stale success messages, restart notices and diagnostic writes in the 11.5 updater when it loses control of the installation before finishing. Recovery reports keep the original failure, and a refused update can report why without changing a newer update’s records.
  [#176125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176125).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents managed Git updates from immediately giving up when another process is maintaining the state database. The 11.5 updater waits before stopping the Gateway and leaves it running if maintenance is still busy. If the conflict persists after shutdown, recovery can restore the previous build. The diagnostic names the process to wait for before retrying. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#176131](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176131).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Stops the 11.5 updater from downloading unrelated branches just to find an update on stable Git installs. It fetches release tags during that check and avoids failures caused by conflicting branch mappings. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#176155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176155).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Fixes bundled plugin discovery holding up other OpenClaw work during some Doctor checks and configuration loads.
  [#176291](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176291).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Avoids reading the live state database a second time when Doctor runs plugin checks that need a writable copy and already has a usable snapshot. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor)
  [#176334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176334).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the live updater refusing managed macOS Gateway updates when the service uses supported Node heap options or the current OpenClaw-generated LaunchAgent wrapper. This applies when the updated driver runs the update. It preserves the heap options during service control.
  [#176333](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176333), [#176346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176346).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes live updates failing before the build when catching up an older checkout with a large list of changed files. The updated driver accepts change lists up to 32 MiB.
  [#176351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176351).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes the managed macOS live updater waiting indefinitely for a compatible Gateway to go idle. The updated driver gives work time to finish, then can interrupt work that is still running. It refuses to stop the Gateway while protected writes are pending.
  [#176365](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176365).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes OpenClaw’s version checks rejecting well-formed Node 27 HEAD, nightly, and other prerelease builds during installation, updates, and startup. Node 26 remains recommended, and SQLite safety checks and package manager requirements still apply. See the [Node compatibility guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node-compatibility).
  [#176568](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176568).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xiaopinpin-music](https://github.com/xiaopinpin-music).
- Fixes Doctor rejecting a writable state check when a report snapshot from a different state directory is still open. That refusal could roll back an update.
  [#176665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176665).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor skipping its optional SQLite NOCOW repair on supported btrfs mounts in official Docker containers. Use a current official image when running the [SQLite repair procedure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#btrfs-and-nocow).
  [#176595](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176595).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kitiyeung](https://github.com/kitiyeung).
- Fixes database status reports listing deleted Doctor inspection copies and their outdated schemas.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176825](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176825) · [Doctor inspection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
- Fixes Gateway shutdown hanging after an agent finishes its work but OpenClaw cannot send the final reply because the requester lost access.
  [#176912](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176912).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an unresponsive node worker from holding up a Gateway restart for the full cancellation timeout. If the worker never confirms that it stopped, OpenClaw keeps the information needed to recover its work.
  [Restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)

  [#177009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177009).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents one slow database check at startup from holding up healthy agents’ database opens and cron maintenance. Cron skips stores that are still being checked and returns to them when they become available.
  [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)

  [#176916](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176916).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor silently skipping the legacy outgoing-image migration when its records directory is invalid or unreadable. Doctor now reports the problem.
  [#176987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes misleading advice to stop a healthy Gateway when a Git update fails without changing the running installation. The new guidance reports the failure and offers a retry for the selected profile instead. When recovery is needed, the instructions keep details of failed or unattempted rollbacks visible.
  [#177129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177129).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Restores workspace memory in npm installs so missing memory support no longer cuts short onboarding or agent turns. It also restores workspace skills operations that couldn’t run without the missing files.
  [#177130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177130).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown and restart cutting off interrupted turns before they can finish cleaning up pending input.
  [#177223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177223).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents new worker cleanup and discovery from holding up a Gateway restart after shutdown interrupts worker recovery. Work already accepted can finish, and recovery picks up on the next start. Adds periodic shutdown logs that show what the Gateway is still waiting for and for how long. [Gateway restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)
  [#177304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177304).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops unnecessary file watches from interfering when Doctor resumes database maintenance.
  [#177300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177300).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving stale copies of generated provider catalogs in `models.json` files with line comments or trailing commas. Doctor leaves custom entries alone and backs up the original, including comments, before rewriting the repaired file as plain JSON.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. [#177346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177346) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions">Doctor state and sessions</a>
- Fixes update repair timing out before it reaches the plugin step on installations with large session migration histories.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jonstarry-oc">@jonstarry-oc</a>. [#177392](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177392) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance">SQLite maintenance</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177352">Issue #177352</a>
- Fixes updater and Doctor cleanup leaving unused runtimes behind when it can verify that a Node process without a package manifest is unrelated to OpenClaw. A process using one runtime no longer blocks cleanup of another runtime that can be confirmed unused.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DonnieFi">@DonnieFi</a>, <a href="https://github.com/angeliti999">@angeliti999</a>, <a href="https://github.com/woshicby">@woshicby</a>. [#177407](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177407) · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173082">Issue #173082</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks">Doctor checks</a>
- Fixes Git source installs giving up on certain temporary connection errors while looking up a release tag. When lookup fails, the installer shows Git’s error with sensitive details redacted.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. [#177502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177502) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer">Installer guide</a>
- Improves systemd service inspection timeout errors with the phase that timed out. Long Doctor warnings keep complete sentences and paths or indicate that details were omitted. [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery)
  [Reported in #177442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177442).

  [#177560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177560).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sdamian](https://github.com/sdamian).
- Fixes Gateway startup errors that report a corrupt state database without saying which file is affected. The error now includes the path alongside the original reason.
  [Reported in #177440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177440).

  [#177590](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177590).

  Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@patelmm79](https://github.com/patelmm79).
- Fixes an update recovery capture being left unsealed for a PostgreSQL Workboard store when the updater can obtain exclusive access. The fix applies when the installed updater contains it.
  Before Doctor runs, the updater observes its recorded database writes. Update status reads history and recovery outcomes from the configured database engine. PostgreSQL update recovery · [Report #187155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187155) · [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).

  [#187217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187217).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the report.
- Stops Gateway restarts waiting on worker pairing and presence checks, applies the shutdown deadline to remote computer sessions, and clears finished agent work even if its final reply cannot be delivered and cleanup reports an error after completing. Background checks pause while the Gateway is suspended and resume at the next scheduled check. [Gateway restart and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)
  [#177756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177756).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Doctor’s Gateway health and heartbeat checks from creating a primary device identity on an empty or node-only store. Doctor also reports when the Gateway is reachable but the current connection lacks read access. [Doctor recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/doctor/recovery.md)
  [#177843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177843).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates that need SQLite schema repair stopping because Doctor rejected its own earlier maintenance writes. The repair preserves rollback eligibility for those writes and still checks for unrelated changes.
  [#177844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177844).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents source-checkout updates from failing a validation check just because pnpm installs dependencies in a different location. Also fixes updates refusing a checkout with a verified nested Git worktree, which is left out of the update without touching its files.
  [#177934](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177934).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps dependency patches in candidate installs and refreshes bundled plugin links after the final install in a source checkout. Preflight warns and continues when a declared optional dependency’s link target is missing. These changes take effect once the installed updater includes them. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#177936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177936).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Reports the affected launcher and any retained backup path when a package update cannot restore a launcher during rollback. The diagnostic is available when 11.5 drives the update. [Rollback and recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/rollback-and-recovery)
  [#177991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177991).

On local SQLite, if the lock remains after you’ve confirmed the previous Gateway is stopped, run `openclaw gateway recover-lock` in the same state and profile context and follow the confirmation it prints.   [#174895](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174895).

- Fixes the immutable updater holding a valid update for recovery when an automatic settings migration has no audit record. The updater checks for additive changes that preserve protected policy. This check no longer uses audit records to identify who made each addition. [Immutable updates](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/team-immutable-update-design.md)

  [#178100](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178100).

- Fixes Gateway startup failing on a read-only SQLite state database when the account running it owns the file and can make it writable.   [#178107](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178107).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#178286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178286).

- Fixes confirmed abandoned update repairs still showing as active after a retry starts maintenance, even if that maintenance later fails. `openclaw update status` also shows `repairing` while a standalone repair is running maintenance.

  [Gateway startup troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/running) · [issue #178255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178255).

- Fixes historical conversations staying unavailable to search after an unchanged archive registry is copied back to its original location. [SQLite maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance)
  [#178668](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178668).

Doctor can clear and report a legacy lock recorded more than five minutes before the current boot. If the database still appears busy, stop the Gateway and other OpenClaw processes or reboot, then retry `openclaw doctor --fix`. Warnings still identify misspelled settings and settings in the wrong section. When the service manager is unavailable, the fallback health check reads settings from the relevant unit sections. [Gateway service checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  Systemd settings · [issue and corroborating report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161977) · Service metadata.

  [issue #157010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/157010).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint), [@Olli0103](https://github.com/Olli0103).
- Stops Doctor from passing malformed direct-message policies or allowlists to channel plugins when checking your configuration.
  [#180072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180072).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a credential migration that could stop Doctor during repairs or updates when an older SQLite database contains statistics the current SQLite version can’t recreate. On retry, Doctor keeps the original rollback backup and refuses to use it if the saved credentials no longer match. [Database migrations and backups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning)
  [issue #178584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178584).

  [#179969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179969).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z), [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes a case where `openclaw doctor --fix` kept warning about older session media after a database version upgrade without completing the repair. Doctor can also finish repairs on readable databases when another database still cannot be read.
  [#180005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180005).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes successful package updates deleting database recovery copies after Doctor has said they need to be kept for manual recovery. The updater that starts the update must already include the fix.
  [issue #170335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170335).

  [#180010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180010).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes updates and repairs that could fail at the end or stay marked as running when another process temporarily held the state database. OpenClaw honors the full wait it allowed for finishing them.
  [#180047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180047).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization).
- Fixes the Android and Termux updater mistaking unchanged plugin files for modified ones and refusing the update. If an older updater reports “Plugin entry changed after snapshot inventory” for unchanged files, use the [manual update method](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods) for your installation, with a verified backup and the Gateway stopped during replacement.
  [#179983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179983).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@yxshee](https://github.com/yxshee).
- Fixes Gateway restart diagnostics incorrectly ruling out the Gateway as the owner of a port just because SSH appears in a folder name or command argument.
  [#180033](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180033).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Doctor checking the wrong model and tool rules when your primary model is set with an alias. Doctor also stops flagging a scheduled job as using a different model when its setting and the default resolve to the same model through global aliases. [Doctor model checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks)
  [#180234](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180234).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@KrasimirKralev](https://github.com/KrasimirKralev).
- Stops Doctor’s workspace check from throwing “No agents configured” when the agent list is explicitly empty. Configuration validation still requires at least one agent. [Doctor workspace checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks)
  [#180284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180284).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee).
- Prevents Doctor from importing garbled legacy auth profiles, configuration health records, retired runtime data or cron job stores containing invalid UTF-8. It warns about unreadable data and keeps the original or a recovery copy. If Doctor names a damaged JSON file, restore it from a verified backup before retrying `openclaw doctor --fix`. [Doctor state recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  Legacy JSON · Legacy imports · [Doctor state migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations).

  [#180281](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180281), [#180861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180861).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen).
- Fixes named-profile node installs targeting the default service and commands started by a node service falling back to the default profile. Use the same `--profile` for node status and service commands. Nodes already installed under the default service name stay under default-profile management. [Node host service commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/node-host)
  Node installs · Node service commands.

  [#180288](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180288), [#180951](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180951).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@MertBasar0](https://github.com/MertBasar0) for node installs, and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for the command fix.
- Fixes memory migrations that could make little progress during an update or a Doctor run when maintenance checks took too long. The fix applies when the update candidate or installed Doctor contains it. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  Earlier contribution.

  [#180469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180469), [#166066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166066).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@keenranger](https://github.com/keenranger).
- Separates the Mac app’s **Check for Updates…** button from **Update Gateway…**. When no Gateway update is known, Settings warns that continuing can reinstall the current version and restart the Gateway, which can interrupt sessions and disconnect the Control UI. [Settings → Updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings#updates)
  [Issue #169383](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169383) · Earlier contribution.

  [#180479](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180479), [#171129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171129).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@chelsealong](https://github.com/chelsealong) and [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen) for the report.
- Prevents Doctor repair runs from repeating a finished legacy-state scan when the configuration and plugin inventory haven’t changed. If Doctor needs to scan again, it avoids repeating the notices and warnings it already printed. [Doctor state migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations)
  [#180576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180576).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and MertBasar0.
- Changes how the 11.5 updater handles a registry package whose Node requirement the Gateway service’s selected Node cannot meet. It refuses before installation, even if a compatible Node is installed elsewhere. If you see this refusal, update the Node selected by the service before retrying. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#180636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180636) · [#180701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180701) · [#180707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180707)

  [#180769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180769).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and reporters [@sglion777](https://github.com/sglion777), [@Almost-Certified-ops](https://github.com/Almost-Certified-ops) and [@billpang1-sketch](https://github.com/billpang1-sketch).
- Fixes managed-update reports saying recovery was unknown after a refused update even when the result was recorded. The report keeps the result, whether the existing Gateway was healthy or recovery failed.
  [#180739](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180739)

  [#180777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180777).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Stops repeated standalone `openclaw doctor --fix` runs from leaving duplicate recovery copies when Doctor can verify that your state hasn’t changed. It still takes a fresh copy if it can’t verify a match or you request a full integrity check.
  [Doctor recovery copies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations).

  [#181025](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181025).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@jsy](https://github.com/jsy), [@8bitsforge](https://github.com/8bitsforge), [@BjoernSchotte](https://github.com/BjoernSchotte).
- Adds a warning when the updater proceeds without an original-state snapshot because there wasn’t enough disk space. The warning shows how much space was needed and how much was available. The warning appears when the update is run from an updater that already includes this change.
  [#181195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181195).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes [managed update reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) that said the update couldn’t start without telling you why. When startup error details are available, the report shows them with sensitive values removed. This depends on the updater you’re already running.
  [Report #181337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181337)

  [#181402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181402).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@Chengmun58](https://github.com/Chengmun58) for the report.
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving obsolete usage-cost cache entries behind and showing database ownership warnings even for clean stores. Current usage data and session history are preserved.
  [Report #181361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181361)

  [#181415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181415).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@beru-ant-king](https://github.com/beru-ant-king) for the report.
- Prevents Claude migrations from hanging on named pipes. Migration skips unreadable optional settings and rejects special-file instruction or command inputs before writing or backing up the affected item’s destination. Restore a regular source file and retry the migration. [Claude migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/migrating-claude)
  [#181752](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181752).

  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the `openclaw` command not being found in a fresh zsh after a [Unix install](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer) when you’ve exported a custom `ZDOTDIR` inside your home directory. The standalone CLI installer also fixes npm’s install path in the right zsh profile when that profile already exists.
  See the original report in [Issue #163569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/163569) and the proposed fix in [#163570](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163570).

  [#186157](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186157).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) for the report and original fix proposal.
- Fixes npm installations that appeared to succeed but left the Gateway unable to start because a required Anthropic SDK dependency was missing.
  [#182168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182168).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes selected external plugins such as `memory-lancedb` failing to load their dependencies in [source-built Docker images](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker). The build now stops and reports conflicting dependency versions.
  [#183080](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183080).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/shakkernerd">@shakkernerd</a>.
- Corrects the Nix installation guide for macOS. The Gateway service doesn’t search your Nix profiles automatically, and the guide explains how to make Nix-installed tools available through a service wrapper, absolute executable paths where supported, or Home Manager’s `runtimePackages`.
  [Nix installation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/nix)

  [#185048](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185048).

  Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).
- Fixes a build error that could stop OpenClaw builds or updates from source. CI now checks the affected build step before building the runtime so it can catch similar errors earlier.
  [#185050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185050).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes onboarding giving up on opening the dashboard after one temporary timeout. Onboarding and `openclaw dashboard` show a waiting message while retrying within the usual time limit.
  [#183713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183713).

  Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183682). Thanks to [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes updates stopping during SQLite migration when a read-only check is mistaken for a database write. The repair is in the version being installed, and migration can still stop if SQLite records a write. [How updates preserve SQLite state](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).
  [#182032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182032).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git and package updates getting partway through before reporting too little room for database backups or rollback. Once the fixed updater is installed, it stops before staging when it detects a shortfall and tells you how much space is needed and available.
  [Update methods](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods), [Issue #183091](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183091).

  [#183177](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183177).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes native updates where Doctor could stop after the plugin stage and leave deferred plugin migrations or model retirement unfinished. Both the installed updater and the version being installed need the fix. Avoid direct writes outside OpenClaw to databases the update touches. Automatic rollback can discard those writes. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#185789](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185789).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates aborting on some failures to save a copy of the running updater. When the native recovery helper is safely in place and the update can continue, the updater warns that it could not keep a verified copy for rollback. If your installed updater still stops at this step, the failure occurs before 11.5 can take over. Follow [update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update#runtime-retention-failures) before retrying.
  [#185178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185178).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes a verification error that could block [updates from the Control UI or chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run) for a foreground Gateway in Termux. Android still needs to let OpenClaw verify the running process, and unattended updates still require a managed service.
  [Issue #165296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/165296)

  [#186223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186223).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@tei8206](https://github.com/tei8206) for the report.
- Fixes [native updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) timing out on a healthy check when a slow snapshot or Doctor check left too little time to finish. The fix has to be in the OpenClaw installation running the update, and an explicit `--timeout` still limits the whole update.
  [#186139](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186139).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps a short-lived file lock from immediately rolling back a Windows npm-global update. If the lock persists, the update still stops and tells you to close processes using the installation. This applies once the installed updater includes the fix.
  [Issue #178004](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178004)

  [#186221](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186221).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Sigma711](https://github.com/Sigma711) for the report.
- Fixes Git updates aborting during the recovery database backup when `.artifacts` is symlinked, including to another volume. This backup runs before the new version is installed, so the updater already on your machine needs the fix.
  [Updating Git installs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)

  [#185680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185680).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a hidden Corepack prompt during pnpm detection from stalling `openclaw update` on npm-global installations when using the 11.5 updater.
  [Issue #185807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185807)

  [#185828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185828).

  Thanks [@Yuaneen](https://github.com/Yuaneen) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) for reporting the issue.
- Fixes `openclaw update` failing on npm-global installs when your shell uses an older Node version even though the managed Gateway service has a compatible one. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  [#185966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185966).

  Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar), [@donniefi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a native update failure that could stop the final Doctor check and leave model retirement unfinished. This applies when the updater running the update includes the fix.
  [#185977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185977).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an update failure while preserving very large dependency trees, such as those in some pnpm global virtual store installations. This applies to updates run with the 11.5 updater.
  [#184958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184958).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents system clock changes from cutting short a healthy state snapshot or inspection, or making a stalled one wait longer than intended, when updating with the 11.5 updater.

  [#184288](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184288).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).

  [#184905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184905).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes native updates reporting failure after a healthy Gateway restart when the old and new versions use different protocols. The installed updater must already contain this fix, and a successful update can still show a protocol warning. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#182399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182399).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes update history and failure reports hiding why OpenClaw refused an update repair. If the repair was refused because it started inside the Gateway, run `openclaw update repair` from a terminal outside it. [Repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@coygeek](https://github.com/coygeek).
- Fixes Doctor and update repair on Windows warning that the Gateway was not ready while it was still starting. Restoring the Gateway now allows the same default startup time as starting or restarting it normally.
  [How updates run](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run).

  [#182146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182146).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Rene-F](https://github.com/Rene-F).
- Fixes cancelled macOS updates that could leave later updates blocked even after repair reported success. On versions with the fix, `openclaw update repair` can clear abandoned updates while newer, unrelated OpenClaw processes stay running. Repair refuses to clear an update if its work might still be active.
  [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery)

  [#185002](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185002).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes failed updates leaving recovery copies protected indefinitely when OpenClaw can verify the update never reached repair or activation. OpenClaw tries to remove those copies automatically. If an eligible copy remains, `openclaw update status` flags it as stale and points you to `openclaw update cleanup`.
  [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).

  [#185223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185223).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).

Adopt both components of the updated controller to get cleanup of eligible earlier backups during release pruning. Backup cleanup runs only when there is no activation journal and keeps backups that may still be needed for recovery. The next eligible prune ends the saved retry window for a failed `update finish`.

  [#185600](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185600).

- Fixes overlapping recovery buttons after a failed update in Control UI Settings. On narrow screens, the labels stay readable and Retry update gets its own row.
  [#185980](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185980).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes valid Kubernetes reseeds and hand-edited `openclaw.json` files being replaced with older settings just because OpenClaw metadata was missing. When backup recovery does replace a config, the warning tells you where the original was saved and how to restore it.
  [#183703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183703).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Kubernetes reseed guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/kubernetes). [Kubernetes report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183641). Thanks to [@csabatatrai](https://github.com/csabatatrai). [hand-edited config report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/126806). Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval).
- Fixes an agent database warning that called even an index rebuild an identity migration. The [PostgreSQL upgrade guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) explains the normal updater and the `openclaw doctor --fix` path with writers stopped.
  [#183155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183155).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Replaces Doctor’s generic plugin migration conflict error with the step that failed, the plugins involved, and the names of the fields that changed. Doctor keeps the migration inputs available for retry. If another repair is still running, let it finish before retrying.
  [Migration guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/doctor/config-migrations.md), [Issue #180350 reported by RomneyDa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180350), [Linux fleet evidence from 609NFT](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180350#issuecomment-6343165911).

  [#183222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183222).

  Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor warnings that hid why a shared-state or agent database migration was refused. The warning shows the cause and any SQLite error code, with steps for recovering and retrying.
  [#183762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183762).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [migration recovery steps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183731). Thanks to [@ausvald](https://github.com/ausvald).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --non-interactive` refusing to check healthy transcript history while another agent is active. Transcript repairs still require stopping active writers.
  [#185838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185838).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies update errors when a SQLite migration cannot be verified. The error names the database if it changed, and the restore warning explains what went wrong.
  [#184399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184399).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor failing to clean up its temporary copy of session data during an update.
  [#184405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184405).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor stopping before it can upgrade an outdated PostgreSQL agent database and asking you to run the same repair again.
  [#182456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182456).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes package update checks returning a missing-table error when inspecting legacy heartbeat tasks on a PostgreSQL-backed installation. Incomplete legacy tasks still block activation.
  [#183645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183645).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Windows Scheduled Task stops that could force-close a PostgreSQL-backed Gateway without asking it to shut down cleanly first. The service can request a clean stop even if PostgreSQL is unreachable. The [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql#native-windows-qualification) records the tested service lifecycle, from installation through restart and data-preserving uninstall.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183632) · [#183634](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183634)
- Fixes a misleading database connection error at startup on PostgreSQL-backed Gateways with existing state. The error now identifies the invalid settings. If the message points to retired heartbeat settings, run `openclaw doctor --fix` before restarting.
  [#183000](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183000).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert).

  [PostgreSQL startup guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) · [Issue #180686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180686)
- Fixes startup errors that misleadingly said an older agent database needed a session-identity migration. The error now shows the database version and the version OpenClaw needs. Warnings about skipped agent databases identify the path and the agent when known.
  [#182288](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182288).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>.
- Fixes agents staying unavailable when a brief SQLite database lock during startup clears in time for a retry. If the retries run out, OpenClaw tells you to close competing processes and [restart the Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/running).
  [#182446](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182446).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- Fixes multi-agent Gateways preparing a second copy of unchanged global plugins for agent workspaces at startup, reducing peak memory in setups that hit this duplication.
  [#184246](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184246).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes failures when verifying or restoring gzip backups or creating Claw, feature-plugin, and worker archives on runtimes with read-only built-ins. Existing archives remain compatible.
  [#182432](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182432).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes ahead-of-time standalone builds failing to validate structured results from MCP tools. The repair also covers checks on plugin settings and the arguments models send to tools.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182856) · [MCP tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp)
- Fixes failures when publishing or restoring repositories, listing workspace files, reading workspace Git history, or capturing the shell environment in [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) and relocated installs. Fixes failures in runtime checks and package recovery in packaged installs.
  [#183120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183120).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes standalone startup incorrectly rejecting a supported SQLite runtime.
  [#183120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183120).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes standalone build IDs changing between builds with identical prepared inputs, even across different build directories. To verify byte-for-byte reproducibility, [compare executable hashes before timestamped signing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  [#183179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183179).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Prevents experimental standalone builds compiled from TypeScript from reusing stale bundled-plugin caches when tracked source inputs change, even when the generated JavaScript stays the same.
  [#183290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183290).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) failing when a bundled plugin uses a supported default index file without a package manifest or an explicit entry.
  [#183326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183326).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops standalone builds from producing an incomplete executable when a required worker or helper module is missing. The build error names the missing entries.
  [#183337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183337).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a pre-compilation failure in experimental standalone AOT builds caused by an obsolete capture requirement.
  [#183377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183377).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the standalone post-upgrade check incorrectly reporting healthy bundled plugins as missing.
  [Doctor lint](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint).

  [#183468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183468).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes worker bundle delivery from standalone Gateways to paired nodes and a separate startup failure for downloaded workers on standalone installations.
  [Standalone installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).

  [#183473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183473).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes SQLite startup failures for portable workers in hardened macOS standalone builds. The startup check looks for bundled SQLite first and runs without loading project preloads or `.env` files.
  [Bun compatibility](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/bun-compatibility.md).

  [#183486](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183486).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes command execution failing with a JIT error in portable standalone AOT workers. On macOS, the fix requires a [compatible worker bundle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  [#183626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183626).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes startup failures in experimental Bun standalone builds that couldn’t load bundled functions. Fixes external CommonJS plugins in those builds seeing only the SDK’s default export and missing its named exports.
  [#184314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184314).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes experimental standalone builds from source stopping with a duplicate-entry error for the Codex catalog and session history workers.
  [#184381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184381).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes standalone update checks, Doctor, recovery and database backups failing to start. It also restores managed MCP bridge launches, paired-node folder listings and archive downloads, and retired worktree cleanup. Standalone builds include browser MCP and remote repository setup scripts and background helpers for selected bundled plugins.
  Standalone maintenance, certificates and helper programs · MCP, paired-node files and worktree cleanup · [Standalone installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).

  [#182405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182405), [#182982](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182982).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes downloaded plugins installing but failing to load in experimental standalone AOT builds, including after moving the installation. For builds compiled directly from TypeScript, the fixes cover on-demand dependencies and the bundled SDK. Strict code-generation policies can still block interpreted plugins. Build checks also find required parser dependencies, and Playwright workers compile in this mode.
  Plugin loading · On-demand dependencies · Bundled SDK · SDK and build checks · [Standalone installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).

  [#183472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183472), [#183756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183756), [#183822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183822), [#184155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184155).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes command-palette keyboard shortcuts failing inside embedded widgets in standalone builds compiled ahead of time.
  [#184134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184134).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a macOS hostname change blocking Gateway restarts, update preparation and read-only database checks on the same boot. It also fixes startup after a reboot with a different hostname when an earlier successful start recorded the Mac’s identity. If an older lock still blocks startup, use `openclaw gateway recover-lock` to inspect it and confirm recovery if appropriate. Gateway status and macOS readiness checks give clearer recovery guidance, and update messages distinguish ownership problems from configuration errors.
  Same-boot maintenance · Lock recovery and diagnostics · [Gateway lock recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/gateway-lock.md) · [Update troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update.md).

  [#182271](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182271), [#184277](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184277).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for both fixes and [@coygeek](https://github.com/coygeek) for #182271.
- Fixes later updates getting blocked by a leftover record from an interrupted package update after the previous package and its launchers have been replaced. A dry run can check whether that record still blocks the update without changing the installation. If an older updater is already stuck on “Package publication journal does not match its installation,” manually install a package that includes the fix.
  [issue #186314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186314) · [Manual package updating](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).

  [#186355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186355).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ichbinnishan](https://github.com/ichbinnishan) (report).
- Warns when your shell is using a different or older CLI than the Gateway installation, and extends Doctor’s protection against a newer CLI upgrading an older Gateway’s agent databases. Database-too-new errors also identify the version that wrote the data as newer than your Gateway when known. If the warning appears, use `openclaw update` or the CLI named for the Gateway installation.
  [#186971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186971), [#196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@tomdailey55](https://github.com/tomdailey55), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes managed Node Gateway updates leaving the command-line installation behind when service overrides contain only named environment variables, and keeps [managed Gateway updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) pointed at the new installation after Doctor migrates runtime settings. Settings are preserved when the service moves or is restored after a failed update, and timed updates distinguish the service installation from the update target. The updater running the update must already include these fixes.
  These changes cover the service environment and Doctor migration.

  [#196371](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196371), [commit 7ac7a5ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ac7a5ea14ab59ea9b534ac9d3a62fd1fd671f33), [#196474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196474), [commit d8fe3b88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8fe3b88a1a95682a011f00452be47da28929ae0).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the service environment release backport, and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) for related split-installation and systemd override reports.
- Stops the [CLI status commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) from recommending another update for an old failure once the Gateway is serving a different build than the one recorded with that failure. The Control UI keeps the attempt in history and clears its current failure alert and retry action.
  [Issue #169950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169950)

  [#186150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186150).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@amittell](https://github.com/amittell) for the report.
- Catches Git updates that would fail under the managed Gateway’s Node or Bun runtime before stopping the service, when OpenClaw can verify that runtime. The check runs in the installed updater.
  [#186539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186539).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Adds the wait time, stalled step and any recorded lock holder to managed update timeout messages. [Update history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) retains the failed step and reason for recorded runs. The updater also clears certain stale locks and avoids self-blocking across path aliases.
  [#186551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186551).

  Thanks steipete and n572770.
- Keeps the original error when a Git or package update fails before it makes changes, instead of replacing it with a misleading rollback error after the previous Gateway restarts. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  [#186977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186977).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes unnecessary low-disk-space refusals when a SQLite-only installation has an agent database larger than its shared database. The updater running the check must include this fix.
  [#186980](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186980).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Avoids delays during Windows updates caused by repeated checks on a Gateway that has already stopped. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  [#187005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187005).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes `openclaw update` asking you to stop the Gateway or rejecting its database when the registry package is already current. If the updater cannot verify that the Gateway is stopped before a replacement, the [stop instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update) name the right service manager for your OS and show how to check what went wrong. The updater running the check must include this fix.
  [#187020](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187020).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@BFG508](https://github.com/BFG508).
- Fixes systemd-managed updates staying marked as running after the updater and its helper have disappeared. OpenClaw records the failure and the last phase it reached, even if the Gateway is still running. It also removes unused npm staging files when it can verify that the update never reached activation and no work is still using them. These changes require the installed updater, not just the version it downloads.
  [#187215](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187215).

  Thanks steipete, masterdevill and joy-digital-healer.
- Fixes updates going quiet while Doctor runs during activation and before or after plugin updates. Doctor’s progress appears on standard error as it happens, even with `openclaw update --json`, so standard output still contains only the final JSON result.
  [#187372](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187372).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes `openclaw update --dry-run` creating reports, support bundles or package cache files when configuration cannot be read. The preview still explains why an update would be refused, though the package target may remain unknown until the configuration is readable.
  [#187498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187498), [#187515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187515).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes a missing warning when the update succeeds but Doctor can’t finish post-update plugin repair. The summary shows `openclaw update repair` so you can retry.
  [#192942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192942).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and, for the release backport 7a5ec45163, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes update rehearsals failing when an installed plugin reads a supported data file linked from outside its package. Repair can replace missing files without overwriting a plugin’s existing private changes. The fix needs to be in the updater you run, not just in the version it installs.
