  [#196301](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196301).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes a pnpm version check that could rewrite your lockfile and derail [updates from a Git checkout](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). The updater you are running must already include this fix.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ecb4591e6e271e8f33f7687c525153e67daedd18).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible recovery copies piling up after interruptions or being left behind after OpenClaw saves session data. [Cleanup sweeps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) reclaim eligible copies while keeping protected ones.
  The changes cover interrupted snapshot cleanup, recovery copy cleanup and the cleanup follow-up. See [Issue #186144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186144) for the interrupted snapshot report.

  [#186201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186201), [#189628](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189628), [#191275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191275).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for the report, [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) for a parallel draft, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the #191275 release backport.
- Fixes [update cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup) refusing to remove eligible recovery copies after harmless timestamp changes, and update or recovery checks rejecting an unchanged SQLite database when connections open or close.
  Cleanup checks · [Issue #185145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185145) · Connection changes.

  [#186411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186411), [#193134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193134).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kaguranananana](https://github.com/kaguranananana), [@thatsrue](https://github.com/thatsrue), [@TameTheGame](https://github.com/TameTheGame), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport of #193134).
- Fixes `openclaw update repair` rejecting an intact installation after a filesystem remount when the package has a copied launcher. Repair can finish an already installed update without reinstalling it or restarting the service.
  [#186557](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186557).

  Thanks ericcaiwx-star and sennyhoney.
- Fixes [`openclaw update repair`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) getting stuck on abandoned updates recorded under an old hostname when using SQLite. Repair warns about the abandoned runs it clears and continues, but still stops if another updater may be active.
  [#187638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187638).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@bondskin](https://github.com/bondskin).
- Fixes the update progress display blocking Doctor’s database maintenance and leaving automatic database restoration unavailable after an otherwise successful update.
  [#192083](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192083).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport c6e3f0e79e).
- Prevents rollback of a root-owned global npm install from removing the access a non-root service needs to start. It preserves existing access rather than restoring permissions an earlier rollback already removed.
  [#193272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193272).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents a briefly busy Windows file from immediately stopping a backup, including a backup taken during an update. If a source file still can’t be read, the error names it and no partial backup is published. The backup or updater performing the capture must contain the fix.
  [#193685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193685).

  Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (bf0dd347).
- Fixes update checks stopping after a successful database read because a temporary copy could not be removed. A failed read keeps its original error. It also prevents busy temporary files on NFS from making Doctor or Gateway startup fail after successful snapshot work, while warning if cleanup still needs to finish.
  These changes cover update candidate cleanup and NFS snapshot cleanup.

  [#193702](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193702), [#195409](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195409).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backports.
- Restores owner-only access to package update recovery files and folders when the running updater can safely repair them, so overly broad permissions alone do not stop recovery.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f50415ef21515fba2bb23114ab573abd5068b92).
- Finds saved database recovery copies through state-folder aliases and preserves the first refusal reason when restoration is refused more than once.
  [Recovery copy lookup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc983d036c6312dc9de2e7cf51b7a849661c3bd9).
- Fixes Update Doctor refusing a database migration because an earlier step in the same run already changed a database it needs.
  [#186251](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186251).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor and upgrade preparation stopping when a shared database reports the expected version but is missing columns OpenClaw knows how to restore. Repairs finish before agent databases change.
  [#186567](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186567).

  Thanks galiniliev.
- Adds warnings and recovery guidance for held agent databases that `openclaw doctor --json` and lint used to leave out. Update lint includes the warnings without blocking the update. Doctor also flags missing or unreadable deletion history even if it cannot name a held database.
  [issue #185843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185843).

  [#186535](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186535).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@4140leal-cw](https://github.com/4140leal-cw).
- Gives scripts a distinct exit code when [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) cannot parse your configuration or determine which database to inspect. It exits with code `2` and tells you why no migrations ran. `openclaw doctor --json` also marks the inspection as blocked.
  [#187192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187192).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@JordanNewell](https://github.com/JordanNewell).
- Fixes update results and Doctor history still saying model retirement is pending after the same update has finished that repair.
  [#187208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187208).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Doctor reporting a pending schema upgrade when database porting only needs to prepare its own copy. Doctor no longer recommends ownership or backup maintenance based on facts it has not checked, and status no longer promises backup checks that Doctor does not provide.
  [#187213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187213).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Doctor reporting a lost lock on local state during an update without keeping the reason. Doctor errors and refused media migrations retain the first known reason, such as an expired lock or a storage failure. This improves diagnosis without preventing the failure.
  [#187477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187477).

  Thanks steipete and vincentkoc.
- Stops Doctor from repeatedly treating an update as unfinished because of an inactive, unavailable plugin with no settings that need to migrate. Existing plugin data stays in place, and migrations that are still needed can wait until the plugin is enabled.
  [#187592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187592), [#187641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187641).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), jenswollenweber, mlobo2012 and coccoinomane.
- Makes [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) report which installation, configuration or Tailscale startup check timed out instead of waiting silently. Fixes Doctor staying open when you stop it during one of those waits.
  [#187936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187936).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), to [@JordanNewell](https://github.com/JordanNewell) for the report, and to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport 258063a302.
- Fixes Doctor checks from the setup assistant copying large live databases and competing with active sessions. The live check covers configuration, runtime and installation, and reports that database, plugin, credential and workspace inspections were deferred. It stops and reports interrupted checks and applies a two-minute deadline. For a full report, stop the Gateway and run `openclaw doctor --lint` on the same host. Use `openclaw doctor --fix` for repairs. [Doctor guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
  [#191125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191125).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (f6b66118).
- Fixes Status and Doctor guidance for custom Gateway launchers that need manual correction instead of recommending a reinstall that leaves them in place.
  [#196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Makes systemd permission errors name the blocked path, and makes Doctor report a healthy restart separately from repairs it couldn’t finish.
  [#196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes updates running out of disk space during Doctor’s inspection of fully settled SQLite session databases. [Doctor reads those databases in place](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) instead of making a second copy.
  [#196346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196346), [commit 0fed0517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fed0517474ab015b1b140698a4890eb5a2ce749).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes a Doctor repair failure that could leave settings unchanged and omit the repair from the results.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d80482379b376f9ad921b6acff0df9bc2ce8c80).
- Fixes the opt-in [Doctor disk-space check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) looking at the wrong volume when run alongside plugin checks.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cf4e6531e751cdd42d331844ad3d26c478b709d1).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor imports of recognized older SQLite stores with unfinished worker setup or legacy image snapshots while preserving their records. Older queued inputs are marked interrupted without replay. Keep [stores with retained historical fields](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#historical-import-evidence) on SQLite.
  [Historical import fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/85e0295f35e67b0f65db84aafe5e64000bb1bbf9).
- Clears an obsolete SQLite preparation warning with `openclaw doctor --fix` after affected upgrades from 2026.10.10.
  [SQLite preparation warning](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74f838a0fd8360617c9be953ada5513ec6c44fea).
- Fixes Bash and PowerShell installers accepting an unsupported Node version for a hosted npm package or upgrading Node unnecessarily for a [Git installation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer). They keep a compatible version and install a suitable one when needed.
  Hosted npm installs · Git installs.

  [#187564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187564), [#187635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187635).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), RomneyDa and [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom).
- Keeps `openclaw update` from rejecting an otherwise compatible Node runtime found during recovery just because it cannot check the security patch level again. Node 24.22.1 or newer on 24.x, or Node 26.12.1 or newer, is still strongly recommended.
  [#186589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186589).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes standalone setup and conversational onboarding failing before reaching a configured model. [`openclaw setup --message`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/setup) can run with the Gateway stopped when the model allows local execution. Required worker profiles still need a Gateway.
  [#186608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186608).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes fresh macOS setup failures after onboarding where OpenClaw could leave database work unfinished or fail to record where a plugin came from.
  [#189533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189533).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Codex plugin installation failing during first-run setup when you run the macOS shell installer through a pipe and a controlling terminal is available.
  See the report in [issue #200244](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/200244).

  [#200247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200247), [commit 98f3d07c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98f3d07ccad7c15d1000d9f8a8d3b38914b7ee77).

  Thanks [@miguelbranco80](https://github.com/miguelbranco80) for the report and fix, and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes installed plugins failing to start their workers or load their own modules in [experimental standalone AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) made with a compatible compiler.
  [#186463](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186463).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Docker builds with bundled diagnostics failing package checks because required tracing dependencies were missing.
  [#187363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187363).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Docker and release packaging rejecting bundles that contain hard-linked dependency assets.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/368b5ec115535a1b3ac966b2f521df33639a69bd).
- Fixes eligible sessions being left idle when an older Gateway interrupts them during the upgrade to the new [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). OpenClaw makes one attempt to continue them. If the Gateway was stopped for more than six hours before upgrading, send a new message to continue.
  [#187867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187867).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps standalone Gateway shutdowns from waiting past their cleanup deadline for background services and names what is still holding up shutdown when cleanup times out.
  [#187090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187090).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the Team Gateway from accepting new work again between the maintenance handoff and service stop.
  [#187090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187090).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway stops and restarts reporting a cleanup failure after a command was refused before it ever started. You still see why the command was refused.
  [#187137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187137).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes `openclaw dashboard` continuing to wait for the Control UI or printing browser instructions after you press Ctrl-C. Cancelling the browser step in guided onboarding no longer triggers fallback instructions. Setup also stops the browser handoff when you cancel.
  [#187220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187220).

  Thanks yy19971996, obviyus and Alix-007.
- Fixes the CLI continuing to wait for the Gateway to become healthy after you press Ctrl-C or send SIGTERM during a start or restart. Interrupting the wait doesn’t stop a restart that’s already underway.
  [#187335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187335).

  Thanks SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Keeps late chat saves within the [original restart wait](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/external-apps) instead of starting a separate wait. If saves are still pending when time runs out, the restart is refused and the deployment log keeps the reason.
  [#196493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196493), [commit b4d4ed88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4d4ed88d11cd48a7747a92b8a5a6e9d9fbfbac0).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the Control UI staying unavailable after a restart interrupts its first build on a Gateway running from source on POSIX. The next build can start once OpenClaw confirms the interrupted build has stopped.
  [#200338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200338), [openclaw/openclaw@eea92fb2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eea92fb271dc579e3d76e0eb8df4208e85bbe6f1).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Lets Gateway startup wait within the SQLite busy timeout for a transient schema lock held by another OpenClaw command. Offline maintenance still blocks startup.
  [SQLite startup wait](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc73f133baaa806b82aa0b1c10c41d54cf026dd1).
- Fixes first launch after a Mac app upgrade choosing an older Gateway runtime after state migration. Explicit runtime choices remain respected.
  [Mac runtime selection](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Reports the observed Gateway startup failure instead of a generic timeout and gives a partially started service a bounded opportunity to shut down.
  [Startup failure and cleanup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Stops an eligible older app-managed Gateway before preparing the updated service and attempts to restore it if preparation fails. Service ownership and update-policy checks still apply.
  [Mac service update](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Prevents `openclaw doctor --fix` from putting a systemd system Gateway into maintenance when it cannot stop the service. [Doctor shows the stop command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) for the service owner before repair is retried as the state-owning account.
  [#186648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186648).

  Thanks steipete and cryptoninja1stat.
- Reports the last database snapshot check that failed and how many tries were made when an update candidate cannot get a consistent copy.
  [issue #177482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177482).

  [#186386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186386).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jfrancis21](https://github.com/jfrancis21).
- Requires a verified pre-upgrade backup and its matching OpenClaw build to [roll back](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/state-schema-history) after the shared-state database has been upgraded. Reinstalling the older build alone will not work.
  [#173873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173873).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Unblocks upgrades that got stuck on retired JSON files from before July 2026. If these files are blocking your update, run `openclaw doctor --fix` with v2026.11.5’s Doctor, then retry. For these files, Doctor replaces the broken detour through 2026.9.7. It recovers supported cron jobs, referenced OAuth sign-ins, Voice Wake settings, conversation bindings and default-home plugin approvals without overwriting existing data. It archives retired files without replaying old queued deliveries. You may still need to sign in again if an old OAuth key is unavailable; missing referenced OAuth files need repair, and some other retired formats still need a bridge release. See the [state migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations).
  [#174489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174489).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@StarGazer1995](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174343) for the report.
- Stops Doctor from importing or archiving old sessions when the shared-state database is missing but its SQLite recovery files remain. If Doctor reports this, [restore the matching database](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) and keep those files intact before retrying.
  [#175300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175300).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git updates losing SQLite diagnostic catalogs after activation. If an older updater reports a catalog `tables` error, keep its recovery files and follow the [manual source update procedure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) before retrying. The fix must already be in the updater running the update.
  [Commit 8bedc56](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8bedc5686c42e892a985f93627066f0e022a7ad4).
- Restores [automatic updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/automatic-updates) for installed headless node services. If an older service warns that it can’t start automatic updates, run `openclaw doctor --fix` on that node. The repair restarts running services, leaves stopped services stopped, and skips custom or externally managed definitions. On Windows, the fix also prevents startup failures with `openclaw.cmd` and restores the previous Scheduled Task if registration fails after changing it.
  [Issue #175831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175831).

  [#175860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175860).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report.
- Prevents unfinished Gateway update drains from blocking new work for minutes. A drain that hasn’t handed off to shutdown expires after 45 seconds, and the Gateway accepts new work again without interrupting work already underway. The update CLI and bundled deployment controller limit how long they wait for work to finish, and Gateway logs show who started the drain and why it ended. If you run an [external drain controller](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/external-apps), complete the shutdown handoff within 45 seconds or defer the update.
  Deploying the bundled controller revision is separate from updating the Gateway.

  [#173788](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173788).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes the Team server release controller to wait up to three minutes for maintenance or another deployment to finish instead of reporting a skipped deployment as a success. If the wait expires, it reports a deferral. Existing installations need to adopt the matching [controller pair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md) separately.
  [#173869](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173869).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Windows update repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) mistaking unrelated processes for unfinished update work. Run `openclaw update repair` from the Windows account that started the update. Repair can still refuse to proceed on older update attempts or when it can’t rule out unfinished work.
  [issue #173430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173430).

  [#173783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173783).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@karljamoralin](https://github.com/karljamoralin).
- Fixes `openclaw update migrate` accepting the new version before all live agent databases pass validation, and keeps the recovery backup if validation fails.
  [Commit 5d93d5e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d93d5e29c4a5071b2af5dd8b8ea253cc046f524).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes update migration failing to recognize a supervised Gateway between service restarts and attribute its own stop record. Unrelated database writes still block migration.
  [Commit 4d1b585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Fixes managed updates for a foreground PostgreSQL Gateway failing to verify the owner and adopt the configured update ledger. It also restores missing restart and failure notices, and prevents update processes from staying open unnecessarily after handoff or cancellation. If a notice cannot be recorded, OpenClaw logs the failure without stopping service recovery.
  See [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines).

  [Foreground handoff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70914560023817b44cc9c98417c33f5a3aa76521), [#174505](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174505).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps restart tied to the installed service and reports when the new database settings can’t be resolved.
  [#175069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175069).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes adopted immutable Linux updates failing during preparation on slow or interrupted connections and builds being rejected because Plugin SDK files were missing. The updater downloads missing source history and retries a failed download once; default builds include the required SDK files, which can add build time. The download fix applies when the running updater already includes it.
  Download preparation · Plugin SDK files.

  [#175071](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175071), [#175087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175087).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fixes and [@potterdigital](https://github.com/potterdigital) for reporting.
- Fixes [update preparation on adopted immutable Linux installs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update#immutable-release-installations) failing when no separate build account is configured. The updater warns before building as a non-root operator, and update status and Doctor show that the build ran without a separate account. This fallback uses the operator’s account without separate build-account isolation. If the updater can’t identify an eligible non-root account, it stops before changing the installation.
  [#176532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176532).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed Linux updates waiting indefinitely for a systemd Gateway service to stop. If the stop times out, the update moves on to recovery. Failure notices explain what failed and any recorded next step, and name the version still running when verified. If maintenance is already in progress, the error keeps any known details about what is holding it. The stop fix applies only when your installed updater includes it.
  [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)

  [#186792](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186792).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ndirazar](https://github.com/ndirazar).
- Fixes Linux updates rolling back during a state migration when the native process check is unavailable but Linux can still verify the updater. If neither check works, Doctor explains why the update stopped and [how to retry](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). When available, it also shows the system’s glibc version to help diagnose why the native check could not load.
  [issue #186817](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186817).

  [#186871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186871).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Prevents package updates from replacing files when service checks are unavailable and the updater cannot rule out a running Gateway using that installation. This guard applies once the installed updater includes the fix, so it may not protect the first update from an older version.
  [#176038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176038).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes confirmed abandoned updates staying active until a timeout. `openclaw update status` points you to [repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery), and repair or the next actual update can mark the abandoned run as failed without waiting. Check that generated guidance matches your platform and profile.
  [#176038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176038).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes idle CLI and plugin commands holding up updates or update repair long after they finish using an agent database. If [update maintenance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting) reports that a command started on an older release is still holding the database, stop that command so maintenance can continue. Plugin authors holding a deprecated unborrowed database handle across work should use the supported borrowing API, because an idle handle may close.
  [#175986](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175986).

  Thanks [@romneyda](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes the updater relying on an outdated database compatibility check after Doctor runs, so OpenClaw checks the database again before using it even if Doctor exits with an error.
  [#175300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175300).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents oversized recovery file lists from causing updates to fail on large installations. The fix applies to updates run by the new updater.
  [#175824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175824), [#184958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184958).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes scheduled update checks getting stuck on a previous installation-detection error. The next check tries again.
  [Commit 525d41b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/525d41b11a8aa3ede5aecdf529044859c4a5f619).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents Windows update checks from listing the same database twice under different paths when OpenClaw uses an extended-length state path. Rollback checks keep the original path, and newly discovered plugin databases still count.
  [#174471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174471).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw config validate` and plugin update checks failing because a running OpenClaw instance was still writing to its SQLite database.
  [#175774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175774).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) for the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160483).
- Fixes migrated updates looking stuck near the end when run by the 11.5 updater. Finalization messages appear as they arrive.
  [#175777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175777).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `openclaw update status` hanging when a check stalls, and update inspection errors pointing to process or storage trouble when a worker reached its output limit. Status returns the results it has and names incomplete checks, including in JSON. Redacted update snapshots keep the output-limit reason. Doctor warns if it cannot read Gateway replacement history.
  For status checks, see [Status and history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history).

  [#174060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174060).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the status fix and [@jsf9789](https://github.com/jsf9789) for the report.

  This change covers output limits.

  [#175997](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175997).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the output-limit fix.
- Makes [OpenClaw update](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) warnings explain why an old package backup was left in place, such as a locked file or a denied rename.
  [#175890](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175890).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the failed systemd check and any available error details to `openclaw update` diagnostics when OpenClaw cannot inspect the managed Gateway service on Linux.
  [#175928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175928).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops `openclaw update` warning about missing optional package managers, such as `pacman` on Debian. Other failed package-manager checks warn only once per update for the same search path. The fix takes effect on [updates run by the new updater](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).
  [issue #186814](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186814) · [issue #173084](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173084).

  [#186839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186839).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jb168](https://github.com/jb168), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Corrects inflated reclaimable space in `openclaw update cleanup` reports. Qualifying recovery originals that are already gone are counted separately in text and JSON instead of being listed as files you can remove.
  [issue #174153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174153) · [repair and recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/repair-and-recovery.md).

  [#174241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174241).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Navras98](https://github.com/Navras98).
- Limits the buildup of standalone Doctor recovery copies after repeated Docker rollouts. Doctor always keeps the newest completed copy and retires other eligible copies outside the newest three or older than 30 days. Copies needed for recovery stay protected and can bring the total above three. [`openclaw update cleanup`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup) shows copy sizes and lets you review and remove eligible copies.
  [#174415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174415).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@BjoernSchotte](https://github.com/BjoernSchotte).
- Warns when Git backup creation, verification or restore may have left private files behind and names the temporary location to check. Fixes cleanup errors masking the real result, including when the backup succeeded. If you see the warning, check the named location for private files; cleanup is not retried. See the [backup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup).
  [#175339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175339).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rejects a mismatched database in a recovery copy even when SQLite’s companion files match.
  [#175776](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175776).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the original copy of ordinary files for manual update recovery if they change after copying, while rejecting changes during the copy. Each capture keeps the plugin file list it started with.
  [#178511](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178511).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [session cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sessions) from deleting files still needed by pending plugin migrations. Fixes [Doctor import and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance) getting stuck on a missing transcript when its original contents can be verified in session history. Doctor clears that conflict without losing newer messages. If Doctor cannot verify the contents, restore the named transcript from a verified backup before retrying recovery.
  [#175274](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175274).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@cbremer](https://github.com/cbremer) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175245).
- Fixes Doctor undoing a completed import of outgoing image records when it cannot clean up the old files. Fixes Doctor undoing an import of meeting transcripts when it cannot archive the originals. In both cases, a later Doctor run can retry the unfinished step without starting the import over.
  Changed source files are preserved with a warning, and conflicting image records still need explicit recovery.

  [#178452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178452).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor stopping during session repair when differently capitalized agent IDs refer to the same database. The repair preserves conversation history and lets later migrations run, including the one that updates where Telegram picks up incoming messages.
  [issue #174089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174089) · [state migrations guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/state-migrations.md).

  [#174243](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174243).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@keirmodon](https://github.com/keirmodon) and [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar).
- Recognizes completed runtime-pin migrations for the same profile when [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running) checks a running Gateway, and fixes Doctor asking you to stop the Gateway on a fresh SQLite profile with no old pins to move. For pending legacy pins, stop the Gateway and other owners of the profile, run `openclaw doctor --fix` against the same state and config, and restart the Gateway.
  Completed migrations · Fresh profiles · [Doctor guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running).

  [#174147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174147), [#174228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174228).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor omitting the SQLite library it uses when it skips the Gateway service check.
  [#174147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174147).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor silently skipping legacy skill-upload files it cannot inspect, in both preview and repair. During repair, Doctor also warns if it cannot inspect an agent database for legacy usage-cache cleanup and continues checking the other agents.
  [#174218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174218).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents `openclaw doctor --lint` from treating missing optional databases as errors on healthy installations. Doctor still checks the databases that are present.
  [#175169](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175169).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [read-only Doctor database checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) from leaving plugin build files in your profile’s state directory.
  [#175173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175173).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [selected Doctor lint reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) from repeatedly copying the SQLite state database for ordinary reads. Each report uses one private copy if it needs to read state, and checks that don’t need state skip the copy.
  [#176014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176014).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Doctor stopping early when its output is temporarily slow to print.
  [#175777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175777).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `/openclaw rescue` dropping a completed command’s findings when it exits with an error status. The reply includes the findings and exit status instead of treating the completed command as a failed message that may be retried.
  [Commit f6c8beb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6c8bebd933e66d2934633a8a847e116c5443a81).

  Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents Gateway startup from staying blocked by offline maintenance after the launcher for `openclaw doctor --fix` is killed. The Gateway can start again once the interrupted repair has shut down, without deleting locks or the database.
  [#174219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174219).

  [#174268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174268).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@chrislro](https://github.com/chrislro).
- Fixes Gateway startup failing immediately while offline maintenance is still running on the same database. The Gateway waits up to five minutes and logs which process is holding it. If the wait expires, let that process finish before retrying startup. See the [Gateway lock guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock).
  See the related [issue #175730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175730).

  [#176548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176548).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault) for the related report and [@kesslerio](https://github.com/kesslerio) for reporting related Docker behavior.
- Fixes startup checks for older webhook installations failing immediately during a transient SQLite schema lease. The check can wait within the busy timeout; offline maintenance still refuses immediately.
  [Commit 4e89349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e89349b53b051778ce65fcf910fb742d2b64cc4).
- Fixes agent database cleanup warnings during long-running native updates or Doctor maintenance, so the databases can close cleanly when maintenance finishes.
  [#186783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186783).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session restart markers running out of time during shutdown cleanup. Marker persistence can use the remaining cleanup budget, and idle agent stores stay open until it settles or times out. The one-second limit remains when there is no cleanup budget.
  [Shutdown budget](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcd0ec9940b991f92d298da4a3d7b1bd4efd113a), [Agent stores](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86597179b87acbba6b0b96edc7a1079dc5de9df0).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown getting stuck behind a command still running on a worker. A remote worker that doesn’t confirm it stopped remains eligible for cleanup when it reconnects. Shutdown diagnostics also show which cleanup steps took time.
  [Restart and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).

  [#174312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174312).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown hanging after an agent database lock is removed or replaced. The Gateway warns about the lost lock, stops accepting new writes when it detects the loss, and leaves any replacement lock alone. If cleanup fails, the Gateway keeps its exit deadline so a managed update can move on to recovery. The running Gateway must already have the fix.
  [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)

  [#186811](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186811).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Rene-F](https://github.com/Rene-F).
- Fixes the Gateway appearing ready when a Node.js upgrade or removal leaves it unable to start new workers. The Gateway reports the runtime failure, and eligible managed services try one graceful restart after active work has drained. If the Gateway only reports the problem, follow the [recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health) to repair Node.js and restart through your service or process manager.
  [#175206](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175206).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an unnecessary [agent database integrity scan](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#integrity-checks) on restart when a late request is turned away before opening the database during an otherwise clean shutdown.
  [#175232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175232).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes the Gateway skipping startup checks or session preparation for existing `openclaw` and `crestodian` databases when those built-in agents aren’t listed in your configuration. You no longer need to add roster entries for them as a workaround.
  [Issue #176355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176355).

  [#176508](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176508).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@yozakura-ava](https://github.com/yozakura-ava) and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- Fixes agents staying unavailable after Gateway startup when a last-minute change invalidates their database readiness check. The Gateway retries that step automatically.
  [#178577](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178577).

  Thanks [@hez2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@609nft](https://github.com/609NFT) for the report.
- Fixes Windows agents staying unavailable after `openclaw doctor --fix` successfully migrates their database, blocking access to sessions, chat history and model listings. If OpenClaw still reports a serialization error, the [recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#a-migrated-agent-remains-unavailable-with-a-serialization-error) points you to updating OpenClaw and restarting the Gateway instead of repeating the migration.
  [#175929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175929).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Thanks [@rspires1952](https://github.com/rspires1952) for the report.
- Fixes Linux Gateway discovery failing when any loaded systemd service has a multiline startup argument, even if the service is unrelated to OpenClaw. Discovery through a private systemd manager, including the default root system route, requires native inspection support.
  [#176469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176469).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes service setup and recovery when ownership changes and keeps older builds while a running Gateway still uses them.
  [Commit a20c18d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a20c18dd0f1be13d939ea6ee3f2ff085607d1b17).
- Fixes uninstall and Doctor leaving an unloaded LaunchAgent file behind when Trash access is denied. In that case the file is deleted without a Trash copy. The cleanup candidate must already include the fix.
  [Commit 1833a1d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1833a1d1442482eb947dbf4348761d4110b3d9ca).
- Prevents system clock changes from cutting macOS Gateway startup retries short or stretching them out while the previous service is still stopping.
  [#175204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175204).

  Thanks [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/sunnyshu0925).
- Fixes macOS Gateway service checks reporting the service as missing when an inspection command couldn’t be cleaned up. A restart that hits a cleanup failure during inspection stops before changing the service and reports what went wrong.
  [#175716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175716).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a startup error in affected [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) that could stop agent turns, Doctor commands such as `openclaw doctor --fix`, and plugin installs before they began.
  [#174545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174545).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes source native resources, including SQLite, failing to load through a compiled process broker.
  [Commit 26048d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/26048d73fc952ebd44a84ac14cfdc3564c00fc70).
- Fixes missing-export errors in npm and Docker installations, including Doctor and PostgreSQL Gateway recovery.
  [Commit a8a974d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a8a974d3f9991bc5e4abd2ac5bacc6cb7a9fcd36).
- Fixes npm installs losing the patched Bonjour dependency that OpenClaw needs for local network discovery.
  [Commit 8878714](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/887871495550a9f1a869bd5dbca41d2e4591830a).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@ava-perry](https://github.com/ava-perry).
- Reduces the number of files in npm installs so the package fits within existing updater limits, without changing how you set up or use Mistral chat.
  [#175296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175296).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the previous Crabbox installation in a reported recovery directory if replacement fails after it has been moved. A later ensure starts a fresh managed install if neither the preferred nor managed binary is supported.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an oversized launcher that could make managed Node worker bundle checks run out of memory.
  [#176502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176502).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Fixes onboarding recommending LINE for Linear while keeping each integration eligible for the app it matches.
  [Commit bb674d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb674d1d10dcba2cde7936ed46c2888c523ca822).
- Fixes long waits in `openclaw doctor --fix` when it recovers many older plugin sessions on large installations. Doctor still keeps the recovery records from interrupted runs, so you don’t need to delete them before retrying.
  [issue #186824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186824) · [issue #172809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172809).

  [#186880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186880).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@oiGaDio](https://github.com/oiGaDio).
- Fixes Gateway startup failing when a brief database lock interrupts cleanup of leftover worker workspace records. The Gateway retries the cleanup before giving up.
  [#186920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186920).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@bianyuxia-commits](https://github.com/bianyuxia-commits) for [the report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186875), and [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed updates failing their initial checks. On managed updates driven by a supporting updater, automatic rollback remains available if the update fails after migrating state or agent data, including restoring the previous schema and data. If other database writes or uncertain ownership make rollback unsafe, OpenClaw keeps the [recovery copies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines) rather than restoring automatically.
  [#174360](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174360).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw update repair` reporting success without warning when it finds your managed Gateway still stopped. The warning points you to `openclaw gateway start` and `openclaw gateway status --deep`.
  [#186312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186312).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@chamber32](https://github.com/chamber32) and [@mmhzlrj](https://github.com/mmhzlrj). [Repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).
- Adds a backed-up migration path in Doctor for supported PostgreSQL shared-state schemas while the Gateway is offline. Doctor reports eligible older schemas as pending and leaves them untouched during inspection. It backs up the existing data before migrating and keeps the backup available for recovery if the migration rolls back.
  [#173981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173981).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Windows Gateway startup and updates getting blocked by a stale lock left by an older OpenClaw process. Automatic and confirmed recovery clear these legacy locks only when Windows can verify the old process has stopped.
  [#182031](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182031).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@asswwwsa](https://github.com/asswwwsa) for the report.
- Fixes managed updates aborting and leaving the Gateway stopped when retained plugin data, such as Voice Call’s, is mistaken for agent data. [Update backups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) still cover those plugin stores.
  [#174973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174973).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vishnusenthil-16](https://github.com/vishnusenthil-16).
- Fixes global npm updates rolling back because of a recovery record left by an earlier successful update. The repaired updater prevents new occurrences and can clear the blockage while keeping the existing record. If an older updater reports `nlink=2` or higher, follow the [Doctor recovery steps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting#node-and-global-install-permissions) before retrying.
  [report #187468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187468).

  [#187549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187549).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@zigit](https://github.com/zigit).
- Fixes Doctor refusing to migrate a database because the Gateway wrote to it during a startup check on an update that skips the service restart. Those startup changes also no longer cause the updater to refuse an otherwise eligible database restore if the update fails.
  The released commit backports the canonical fix in [#200260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200260).

  [Released backport](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee283073849efe6bd080fef53328a3a3ec72a6bf).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the backport.

  This change provides the helper.

  [#198268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198268).

  Thanks Ayaan Zaidi for the helper.
- Fixes an update check that could reject a supported older PostgreSQL agent database even with the Gateway stopped. This clears the early check, not later migration or restart failures.
  [#186972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186972).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes update checks and repair failing on installations that use PostgreSQL for state, agents and the workboard. It also fixes a related failure that could keep the Gateway from starting after an update.
  [#187064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187064).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes updates on [PostgreSQL-backed installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) rolling back when Doctor is denied database access while activating the new version.
  [#187160](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187160).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes `openclaw update` reporting a missing backup provider instead of the real error when it cannot check a PostgreSQL store. If the error says `unaccent` is missing, have a database administrator run the SQL shown before retrying. See the [PostgreSQL database guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines).
  [#187178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187178).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown getting held up by a stalled check for an idle worker.
  [#177081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177081).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway shutdown failure where stalled restart details could force an exit before OpenClaw saved the information needed to resume running sessions. Keeps locally authorized Gateway restarts from getting stuck waiting for saved restart details, which may be lost if they time out.
  [#188047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188047).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport ad1886f5dd).
- Restores [direct upgrades](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) from extended-stable 2026.9.33 and 2026.9.34 without first replacing the installed updater. Read-only Doctor checks no longer change database files and cause an update to reject an unchanged database. It also fixes a rollback when the 2026.10.5 updater lost track of the original task schedule during rehearsal.
  Update compatibility · Doctor checks · [Update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting).

  [#184547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184547), [#185561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185561).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible active built-in Goals stopping after the first successful recovered reply following a graceful Gateway restart. It also keeps an interrupted turn eligible to resume while its managed workspace is still being prepared, even if another graceful restart interrupts the wait. See [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).
  Goal continuation · Restart recovery · Workspace wait.

  [#186599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186599), [#185730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185730), [#196423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196423).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the #196423 release backport (ab01422).
- Fixes standalone profile commands failing after a restart during startup. It also fixes Doctor hiding native snapshot failures or remaining open after one. Sandboxed Doctor requires local broker IPC.
  [Doctor guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/running.md).

  [#173154](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173154).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds recovery-copy counts and sizes to local [status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) and [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor), and lets you preview eligible migration backups and orphaned update copies for [cleanup by exact path](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#explicitly-retire-an-unmanifested-original). Incomplete size estimates are marked. Stop the Gateway before confirming removal. Deletion is permanent.
  [#181195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181195).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Lets some active main conversations pick up after a graceful Gateway restart. Built-in Goals that qualify can continue after the recovered reply succeeds. Subagents and background commands stop instead of restarting on their own. If startup fails before the continuation begins, automatic resumption can be lost. Clients using `sessions.recover` need to account for its removal. See [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).
  Queued messages follow in order under each sender’s current permissions, and the Control UI returns to the normal composer. The Gateway process limits its wait for shutdown cleanup; embedded Gateways still wait for cleanup they own. Restart recovery · Goal continuation · [Tagged restart recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/restart-recovery.md)

Confirmation requires an OpenClaw build that expects the database’s current schema version.

If you need an older rollback copy, keep an independent backup before updating, since cleanup permanently removes eligible copies.

##### Cold storage for large conversation histories


Large inactive histories can move to cold storage, and PostgreSQL storage and offline porting have expanded. To roll back the upgraded agent database, restore a verified pre-upgrade backup with its matching OpenClaw version. If an affected unpinned system agent loses its persona or memory after upgrading, run openclaw doctor --fix to restore eligible files.

Cold storage can now archive inactive conversation history that used to stay in the active database because it was too large for one archive file. An entry that is too large to fit on its own stays in the active database. Existing archives still restore, and a missing or damaged piece of a new archive stops the restore before any history is brought back.

The upgraded database requires OpenClaw 11.5 or a compatible newer version. To roll back, restore a verified pre-upgrade backup with its matching OpenClaw version. [Agent database compatibility](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/database-schemas/agent-schema-history.md)
Supported backups include the new archives, and a full-history reset removes them.

[#183827](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183827).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

[session maintenance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance.md).




##### PostgreSQL storage


You can choose SQLite or PostgreSQL separately for shared state, agents, Workboard, Logbook and Team Reports. SQLite remains the default. Qualified PostgreSQL 16–18 configurations with UTF8 server and client encoding are supported for all five stores. Agent data includes transcripts, text search and shared authentication profiles. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)

Changing a setting does not move existing data. You can [port database families](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#mixed-engines) between SQLite and PostgreSQL while the Gateway and embedded agents are stopped, and make matched backups of supported mixed-engine installations. Matrix account and encryption data, including retained data from disabled accounts, are included while the Matrix plugin is installed. Moving or restoring Team Reports requires its matching plugin and excludes temporary collected activity. Keep Logbook frame images and their referenced paths when moving or restoring them. If you already use global PostgreSQL with SQLite Team Reports, set the Reports storage choice to match its existing data before use.

[Backup recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup) supports PostgreSQL stores, including retained Matrix data. PostgreSQL backups require the Gateway to be stopped, and restores run offline with the archived configuration and recovery server connection secret. If you rely on an older archive, make a fresh backup on the source installation for automatic recovery of plugin stores. Exact backups contain secrets. If a port reports pending or uncheckable legacy SQLite repairs, enable any named disabled plugin and run `openclaw doctor --fix` while the affected stores still use SQLite before retrying. A completed SQLite-to-PostgreSQL move keeps existing local client credentials usable. See [database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines), [porting existing stores](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#port-existing-stores) and [TLS and exec connection setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql#tls-and-exec-connection-qualification).
Git backups can select plugin or additional-root stores and verify PostgreSQL exports locally. The last two references cover backup recovery and the operator guide.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Skips an extra file-size scan when copying ignored files into a managed worktree with `.worktreeinclude`. [Provision ignored files](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/managed-worktrees.md#provision-ignored-files).
  [#185213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185213).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps [worktree](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) slot checks and template listings from waiting behind writes, skips saving unchanged records, and cuts background work when cleanup checks find nothing to remove.
  [#175079](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175079), [#186204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186204).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the time OpenClaw spends preparing, inspecting and cleaning up source-only Git worktrees when it needs to preserve repository layout settings.
  [#186214](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186214).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the processing needed to show checkout choices in New Session.
  [#186163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186163).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids recalculating unchanged local session and checkout diffs when ignored build files change or Git refreshes its index without changing what is staged. A [Prometheus counter](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) shows why a diff was not reused.
  The change originated in [#177762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177762).

  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2376391e2266d93390c08ff9739f5041e6b7bd93).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops automatically retrying a Git fetch blocked by a ref lock or a competing ref update, so you may need to retry the fetch.
  [#175944](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175944).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes automatic retries for failures setting up a backup’s temporary directory before any data is written. If setup fails, the [backup command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup) reports what went wrong, and you can rerun it.
  [#175983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175983).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces disk reads when saving verified SQLite backups without skipping verification. PostgreSQL backups, including portable exports, avoid redundant capture work; migration and recovery between SQLite and PostgreSQL also avoid recapturing prepared files while still verifying the result.
  [#174416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174416), [#175812](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175812).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU work and memory allocations when SQLite workers first get ready to accept writes and when handing jobs to them.
  [#186422](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186422), [#185096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185096).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces worker memory used to validate session archives and reclaim transcript storage. Archive validation also used less worker startup CPU in testing. SQLite transcript entries are also saved in groups instead of individually.
  This change covers archive workers.

  [#185150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185150).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the archive work.

  The separate commit covers transcript batching.

  [Transcript batching commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed711106a5dcceef7be27cb094bb44481d235f44).
- Reduces the work PostgreSQL does to save chat transcripts, especially when there’s no navigation metadata to check. Existing PostgreSQL agent stores receive the change during the [normal schema upgrade](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes) without rewriting transcript rows.
  [#175207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175207).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts unnecessary database reads when preparing another turn in an active SQLite-backed conversation or an already loaded PostgreSQL-backed session.
  [#175770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175770), [#175863](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175863).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes an unnecessary wait when OpenClaw looks up [session stores](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access#session-target-discovery) in their standard per-agent locations. Shared stores still need their ownership checked.
  [#175129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175129).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the number of new database connections needed for repeated operations on existing [PostgreSQL state](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql), including during Memory indexing.
  [#175146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175146).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database resources the Gateway keeps open after startup checks. Eligible saved sessions stay readable during checks, while writes wait for checks and cleanup.
  [#186675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186675).

  Thanks steipete.
- Avoids repeating a valid [SQLite integrity check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) after a clean shutdown when only the other database type’s schema changed within the same version. That applies to unchanged agent databases after a shared-state schema change and to unchanged shared state after an agent schema change.
  [#174409](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174409).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated checks when reopening the same SQLite database and avoids reading the same information twice when checking an unchanged agent database schema.
  [#172676](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172676), [#175163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175163).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds agent names to database close messages and explains why a restart needed a [full integrity check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) instead of relying on the previous clean close.
  [#177081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177081).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the type of owner holding the state database when offline maintenance is blocked.
  [Commit 016bcbe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/016bcbe5f2c98b0d9d7960077fc0337fa08b34fa).
- Reduces memory allocation during repeated reads of OpenClaw’s shared state.
  [#185506](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185506).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the database work needed to move retained plugin data and clean up GitHub session publication receipts. OpenClaw also does less background work when pruning old audit records.
  [#174041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174041).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes generated build and test caches causing conflicts that block local sandbox and cloud-worker workspace sync or recovery of saved results, including older pending changes. Real conflicts in your edits still stop the sync.
  [Sandbox workspace access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access.md) · [Cloud-worker session lifecycle](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle.md) · [Workspace sync and excluded paths](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) · [Issue #175503](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175503) · [Issue #176778](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176778)

  [#175538](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175538), [#176802](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176802).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes workspace sync removing a folder you meant to keep when you deleted its last file, then reporting a false conflict when you added a file back.
  [Issue #176808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176808)

  [#176819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176819).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes replies failing in already-provisioned agent workspaces when packaged templates are missing.
  Creating a missing bootstrap file still requires its template. [Agent workspace guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-workspace)

  [#120943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/120943).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes profiles selected through `OPENCLAW_PROFILE` using the default profile data and skills. If you use a tilde-relative `OPENCLAW_HOME` with a named profile and rely on an implicit memory-host workspace, set `HOME` to your home directory when neither `HOME` nor `USERPROFILE` is set. Otherwise the workspace path can repeat part of the home path.
  If you relied on the old default-profile paths, you may see different data or skills after updating.

  [#133252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133252).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unfinished workspace onboarding being marked complete after a starter template update, skipping the identity conversation.
  The fix applies to unchanged starter files with matching recorded hashes. [Workspace bootstrapping](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/start/bootstrapping.md).

  [#149817](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149817).

  Thanks [@Dreamer-HIT](https://github.com/Dreamer-HIT) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes new SQLite work being rejected when capacity is occupied by reclaimable idle shared-state handles.
  <span>Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Jeehut](https://github.com/Jeehut). [#164477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164477)</span>
- Fixes affected unpinned system agents losing access to their persona and memory after an upgrade. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to restore eligible files and pin the workspace, preserving originals and customized destination files. If the agent roster is in an included config file, pin the workspace there manually.

- Fixes recursive `openclaw path find` searches missing direct matches, returning duplicates, and producing unusable deep paths. Repeated wildcards also avoid redundant traversal.

  Thanks [@fransqaas](https://github.com/fransqaas), [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization).

  This change covers timestamp keys.

  [#169266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169266).

Quoted string escapes also decode correctly. [Path CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path)
  This change covers frontmatter quotes.

  Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

- Reduces premature managed worktree cleanup timeouts on large repositories and avoids repeated pack indexing.
