  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes cleanup failures when a managed Docker or Podman command stops or times out during a workspace checkpoint. Preserves final workspace writes from processes started by the command and reports the command’s original result.
  [Report #176960](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176960) · [Sandbox workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)

  [#176989](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176989).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Changes Git repair for a missing tip on Linux to leave certain tracking-ref locks from a previous boot in place. If repair reports a stale lock, follow the warning to resolve it before retrying.
  [#176987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a concurrent setup completion from being mistaken for proof that an agent’s workspace files survived. If OpenClaw cannot verify the files are still there, it preserves the completed setup state and refuses to recreate the files.
  [#176987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes commands failing to finish in local managed guest workspaces because disposable build caches could not be read. Changes to those caches no longer cause conflicts when recovering pending workspace results, and original project inputs are still preserved. [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
  The exclusions apply to disposable files under `.artifacts/build-all-cache/` and `.artifacts/build-cache-inputs/`.

  [#177076](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177076).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents new SQLite database opens from waiting indefinitely when all healthy workers are busy. The open reports overload if no worker becomes available in time.
  [#177194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177194).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps later OpenShell operations from jumping ahead of waiting work that shares their workspace or sandbox.
  [#177606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177606).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes temporary media cleanup silently ignoring permission and disk errors. Failures while checking or removing those folders now appear in the Gateway maintenance log.
  [#177615](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177615).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a missing warning when a Git backup restore cannot remove its temporary files. The warning names the folder so you can inspect it and remove it when safe.
  [#177784](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177784).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an issue where cancelling a read of shared state could leave later reads unavailable if the first shutdown attempt failed.
  [#177841](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177841).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed-worktree sessions failing to start or retry from a remote base that is missing locally when the repository has many refs. If the repository is still too large to refresh safely, OpenClaw suggests choosing a base already in the checkout or asking your Gateway administrator for help. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#177893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177893).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes managed worktree creation failing when you leave the base unspecified in a repository with no `origin` remote. The worktree starts from the main checkout’s current commit, even if it isn’t on a branch. [Managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#178129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178129).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes directory transfers rejecting highly compressible folders before checking whether the compressed archive actually fits the transfer limit.
  [#178201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178201).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops SQLite-to-PostgreSQL adoption when legacy Incognito session records need repair. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` on the SQLite installation before retrying. If you already adopted PostgreSQL with those records, re-adopt from the repaired SQLite source. [PostgreSQL adoption guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#179377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179377).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes `openclaw database port` stopping at an empty retired `fleet_cells` table. It records the skip in dry-run output and recovery records. If the table contains rows, the port stops. Keep the SQLite store and archive those rows before retrying. New PostgreSQL ports also use your configured schema prefix. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#181857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181857), [#181858](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181858).

  [#181882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181882).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for reporting both issues.
- Fixes database ports to PostgreSQL rejecting valid agent or shared-state SQLite stores because some features hadn’t been used yet. The port fills in what’s missing on a copy and leaves your original database unchanged. It still refuses stores with unknown columns. [Port existing stores](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#port-existing-stores).
  [#181931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181931).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and etzelm.
- Fixes the generic error from `openclaw database port` when a copied state database no longer matches its credential record. The command explains why it refused the copy and points you to `openclaw backup restore` before you retry.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the fix. [#182830](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182830) · [Issue #182773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182773) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)
- Keeps local client credentials with each OpenClaw state directory when moving between SQLite and PostgreSQL, including when resuming or rolling back a move.
  [#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes PostgreSQL ports and backup restores leaving the database without fresh query statistics. OpenClaw refreshes them after copying the data and again after a port rebuilds agent memory. If the refresh fails, OpenClaw warns and keeps the verified copy.
  [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines).

  [#183447](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183447).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb) and [@goutamadwant](https://github.com/goutamadwant) for the earlier fixes.

  Reported by @etzelm in [#183307](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183307).
- Fixes offline edits to database settings being refused on installations with plugin state. When the Gateway is running, the error also explains that database settings must be edited offline.
  Offline edit guidance · [Report #179153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179153) · Offline settings fix · [Issue #182769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182769) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)

  [#179299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179299), [#182822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182822).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jlapenna](https://github.com/jlapenna) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes the first chat failing when OpenClaw initializes memory or standing-intent search after a SQLite-to-PostgreSQL port. You can chat without manually rebuilding the memory index. [Database engine guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-engines.md)
  [#178774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178774).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL agent databases reporting a checkpoint failure in the logs after a clean close. If you filter for these closes, use `postgres-closed`.
  [#178781](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178781).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new chat turns and update progress writes continuing to fail after PostgreSQL comes back online, and gives clearer errors when a connection is lost or a query is canceled. Interrupted writes are not replayed. If a chat write might have been saved, wait and check conversation history before retrying; a confirmed rollback can be retried. The agent stops after a canceled or uncertain operation to avoid repeating work automatically. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#179128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179128), [#181576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181576).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed preference saves reporting an error after the change was already saved. Keeps later, unrelated database writes from overwriting a previous save confirmation or mixing unrelated results into startup of the shared authentication store. [Database engine reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)
  [#179114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179114), [#179230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179230).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors when saving profile roles, linked GitHub or GitHub Enterprise accounts, channel identities and Git coauthor preferences. Restores reads of saved channel permissions and policies.
  [#179239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179239).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL reads of backup history, earlier Goal results, scheduled Template job ownership and Doctor’s shared-state and update history.
  [#179239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179239).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session deletion failing on PostgreSQL when transcript archiving is enabled, so you can delete the session and keep its archived transcript.
  [#179274](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179274).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Stops recurring missing-table warnings during Linux Gateway maintenance when you use PostgreSQL. SQLite maintenance still runs for any stores that use SQLite, including on mixed setups.
  [#179327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179327).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes PostgreSQL cleanup failures for ACP replay history, the incoming channel message queue, and resolved session suggestions. Also fixes errors updating ACP replay storage usage after trimming.
  [#183044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183044).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes inconsistent ordering on PostgreSQL. Participants who haven’t been prompted appear first, unused runtimes appear last in filtered sandbox lists, and windows without transcripts appear last when history includes all windows, matching SQLite.
  [#183114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183114).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed Gateway startup failing while state tables are being set up or a worker is catching up with a newly created schema.
  [#181837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181837), [#182082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182082).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unnecessary full-table sorts on PostgreSQL for some small reads, including recent sessions, transcript pages and event lookups. Trimming a full memory embedding cache also avoids the extra sort. Existing PostgreSQL stores rebuild affected indexes during the normal schema upgrade, which can take longer on large databases.
  [#183015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183015).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).

  [PostgreSQL index ordering migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes#postgresql-index-ordering-migrations) · [Issue #182808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182808) · Predecessor fix

  [#182821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182821).
- Avoids reprocessing an entire PostgreSQL conversation when an agent repeatedly loads only part of its history.
  [#183398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183398).

  Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt).

  Reported by @etzelm in [#183363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183363).
- Avoids unnecessary PostgreSQL sorts on affected archived-session and approval lists, latest-message reads, and worker-record cleanup. Existing PostgreSQL state, agent, and Logbook stores rebuild the affected indexes during migration, which can take time.
  [PostgreSQL index ordering migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes#postgresql-index-ordering-migrations).

  [#183443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183443).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces unnecessary database scanning for PostgreSQL-backed session, transcript, and Workboard lookups that match a short list of IDs.
  [#183480](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183480).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors in skill usage tracking, proxy captures, MCP sign-in, voice session lookups, and transcript searches and duplicate handling.
  [#183296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183296).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops `openclaw doctor --lint` from leaving empty PostgreSQL schemas behind when it inspects Workboard tools. Schemas left by earlier runs remain in the database.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the fix. [#182827](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182827) · [Issue #182771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182771) · [Doctor lint](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
- Fixes older Gateways being unable to save restart options in an already compatible state database. During Doctor or schema maintenance, background checkpoints defer and new database writers wait for maintenance to finish.
  [Gateway state ownership](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock).

  [#178280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178280).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes retries that could leave a required state table missing after a failed database write. Skips an unnecessary write transaction when SQLite already has the tables and indexes the feature needs.
  [#181171](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181171).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the first message in a new chat failing before the agent can reply when OpenClaw reaches its state directory through a symlink or a macOS path alias.
  [#181472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181472).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Extends [symlinked state-folder support](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session) to PostgreSQL-backed sessions. You can delete sessions and archive their transcripts, remove cron sessions, and read retained cron history through a symlinked state folder.
  [#181554](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181554).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw looking in the wrong state folder when both `OPENCLAW_HOME` and `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` start with `~` and neither `HOME` nor `USERPROFILE` is set. [Environment variables](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/environment#openclaw_home)
  [#179276](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179276).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Rejects malformed numbers in saved or imported sessions with a repair message. If you see that message, stop the Gateway before running `openclaw doctor --fix` to repair supported legacy values. Values Doctor cannot convert need offline repair or restoration. [Storage repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes)
  [#182311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182311).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Session Storage dropping its last loaded inventory during a temporary Gateway disconnect when you reconnect with the same client.
  [#179419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179419).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes OpenClaw holding on to cached SQLite conversation history on Bun when it detects critical memory pressure. The cache clears and saved conversations stay intact.
  [#179399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179399).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/sobolevbel">@sobolevbel</a>.
- Fixes idle session readers staying in memory longer than intended after unrelated database cleanup or a late-finishing usage request.
  [#182316](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182316).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Frees memory that session archiving used to hold onto after it finished. OpenClaw releases it after five idle minutes and picks up the next archive request as usual.
  [Storage changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes.md).

  [#183410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183410).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw keeping completed SQLite session deletion data in memory longer than needed.
  [#183533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183533).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes temporary SQLite copies being left on disk when you cancel a read-only inspection while the copy is being made.
  [#185443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185443).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents shared-state saves, session watches and event updates waiting to start from holding up unrelated SQLite writes. It also fixes slow storage holding up Gateway requests while changing MCP settings, updating a personal GitHub connection or exporting a transcript, and during recovery cleanup and database maintenance.
  [#181604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181604), [#184510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184510), [#184586](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184586).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes slow SQLite write-ahead log checks and routine database ownership checks holding up unrelated Gateway requests. Idle databases close once any active inspection finishes.
  [Database worker access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access)

  [#184275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184275).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes local managed sandbox sessions staying blocked by an eligible file over the 64 MiB sync limit. The error confirms pending workspace changes are saved and shows a recovery command. Have a Gateway administrator run it on the Gateway host, then retry. The file is preserved outside automatic cleanup. [Sandbox recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox#openclaw-sandbox-recover).
  Offline recovery requires exclusive state ownership. Recovery command · Recovery guidance

  [#181143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181143), [#182039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182039).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and TheAngryPit.
- Prevents large tool or browser downloads in `.openclaw/tmp/` at the checkout root from blocking sandbox workspace sync or restart recovery, including results already waiting to sync. That folder stays with the runtime that created it, so save files you want to keep somewhere else in the workspace.
  [#182974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182974).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
- Fixes edits to previously included build inputs being missed after an older workspace archive is restored. Complete archives and publications keep those inputs, including ones in nested paths that would otherwise be ignored.
  [#180149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180149).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes edits from native-node and SSH workers failing to sync back from Git workspaces because a newly generated build-cache file could not be read. The worker skips those disposable files while keeping tracked inputs and ordinary build reports in scope.
  See [Report #177057](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177057), the earlier PR [#178917](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178917), the original PR [#181889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181889), and [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access).

  [#185563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185563).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and co-author [@grootbro](https://github.com/grootbro), with earlier work by [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and reporting by [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes managed sandbox worktrees getting stuck during sync or cleanup when they contain nested Git metadata. Edits blocked for this reason can sync again, and snapshot recovery leaves that metadata local to the sandbox.
  [Report #185616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185616) · [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)

  [#185669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185669).

  Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), with reporting by [@rywhventures](https://github.com/rywhventures).
- Fixes managed sandbox workspace eviction reporting that a checkout was kept after it had already been removed and saved for recovery.
  See [Report #185631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185631).

  [#185650](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185650).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for the report and fix.
- Stops settled local workspace writes from holding on to write data and earlier workspace state in memory, including after failures. A committed write can still be recovered if its reply was lost.
  [Workspace write recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access).

  [#185354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185354).

- Fixes missing error messages when an agent’s workspace file list fails to refresh while a file is open. The editor stays open, and an initial list failure stays visible until you choose **Refresh**. The agent and file lists show when a refresh is still running without clearing an open draft.
  [#179532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179532).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents replies from attaching workspace files that global or per-agent tool policies forbid reading. If you use a restrictive allowlist and intend to permit workspace attachments, make sure it includes `read`.
  [#184964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184964).

  Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Reduces Gateway stalls while OpenClaw prepares a fresh baseline for a large local workspace. Saving a checkpoint also does less work that can hold up other Gateway activity.
  [#180862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180862).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a managed worktree creation failing because another request fetching the same default branch is canceled or loses access. The remaining request can continue once the interrupted fetch has safely stopped, within the original wait limit. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). [#184121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184121) · [issue #184111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184111)
- Fixes a busy registered project holding up new workspaces for unrelated repositories. The request for the busy project remains subject to its usual wait limit.
  [#184138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184138).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes managed workspace setup failing early when a registered project’s repository is temporarily busy. The request stays pending and cancellable, and it can continue within the remaining wait time without redoing completed checkout or setup. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [Issue #184272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184272).

  [#184672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184672).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for reporting and fixing this.
- Fixes child worktree sessions failing to start when a dedicated worker’s default workspace isn’t available to the Gateway, even though the parent already has a managed repository.
  [#179876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179876).

  Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Fixes the Worktrees page showing an empty list while it’s still loading. If the first load fails, select **Retry** to load the list again.
  [#180404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180404).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#182120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182120).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops managed worktree cleanup from taking the repository’s Git lock for pack maintenance when the pack directory is empty or missing. [Managed worktree guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [Issue #168452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168452).

##### Gateway maintenance from chat


Ask your agent to restart its Gateway and inspect heap pressure and worker diagnostics. Preview eligible recovery copies before explicitly deleting them, since deletion is permanent.

Owners can ask their agent to restart the Gateway it’s running on. The restart can wait for active work to finish, and OpenClaw sends a notice when the Gateway comes back. Restarts requested from external chat honor `commands.restart`. [Gateway restart guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/running)

You can also ask the agent to preview old update recovery copies eligible for cleanup. You can explicitly ask to delete those copies while the Gateway stays online. Deletion is permanent. Both actions are available in the minimal, coding, and messaging tool profiles, subject to owner permissions and tool restrictions. [Update recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
Owner-requested Gateway restarts and cleanup of eligible update recovery copies.

[#182762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182762).

Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).




##### Heap monitoring


[Prometheus heap monitoring](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus#heap-headroom-and-a-sustained-pressure-alert) for OpenClaw on Node shows how close the Gateway and the most pressured sampled workers are to their heap limits, and how much old-generation memory remains after the last major garbage collection. Diagnostic memory bundles include heap limits and post-collection readings when available. The guide includes a sustained-pressure alert you can add yourself.
[#178599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178599).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Code Mode worker diagnostics


OpenClaw automatically attempts to capture local CPU and heap allocation profiles during qualifying garbage collection storms in Node Code Mode workers. The completion warning lists the files in your diagnostics directory. The profiles stay out of automatic support exports.
The diagnostics guide explains how to find the sanitized, access-restricted files and how capture and retention work.

[Gateway diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/diagnostics.md)

[#173306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173306).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#175394](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175394), [#175399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175399).

- Reduces peak memory when preparing a cloud node runtime.
  [#184348](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184348).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps [Cloud Workers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers) profile controls disabled together while saving or deleting, and clears old feedback when the connection changes or administrator access is lost, so a late response cannot reopen the editor or show a success notice.
  [#180437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180437).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Separates loading and errors for execution approvals and node bindings from the device list, and adds **Retry** when binding settings fail to load. Approval errors clear when you switch Gateways or approval targets. A binding form that remains available after a failed refresh or reconnect keeps its unsaved edits.
  [#180285](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180285).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces storage writes for paired node statistics while keeping live readings current. Pairing and access changes are saved immediately. See [pairing and status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/pairing-and-status).
  [#184099](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184099).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces delays in [session catalogs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs) after a paired device is renamed or its access is revoked.
  [#184408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184408).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Status or location requests sent just after re-pairing a node can be dropped if a request from the old pairing is still finishing. Send the new request again if that happens.
  [#175877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175877).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies that [node container isolation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting#isolate-hosted-worker-sessions-in-containers) covers sessions placed on the node. If placement is refused, a session can run on the Gateway instead. Set a [required device worker profile](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-cloud-workers#required-worker-profile) to prevent that.
  [#166351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166351)

  [#175134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175134).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@travismeyers](https://github.com/TravisMeyers).
- Clarifies that a Gateway can be reachable on a container network without a published host port. The [network exposure guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/security/network-exposure) covers loopback with Tailscale Serve or Funnel and authentication for non-loopback binds. The [EasyRunner example](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/easyrunner) sets `gateway.publicOrigin` to match the Caddy hostname when using the default browser-origin allowlist.
  [#178826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178826).

  Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal), [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Leaves a canceled deferred Gateway restart pending instead of retrying it on an unrelated configuration edit. Reapply the original configuration or restart the Gateway to finish applying it. If an older hot reload fails after a newer edit takes over, OpenClaw warns instead of automatically retrying recovery; reapply the configuration or restart if the newer reload does not recover it.
  [#175911](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175911).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

Accepted provider changes may still take longer, and checks for a worker environment can resume after its inventory reopens.   [#179299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179299).

  [#180431](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180431).

Newly installed named-profile node services on macOS also use separate supervisor logs. To switch an existing service to its own log, reinstall it with `openclaw --profile <profile> node install --force`. [Node service guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)

##### Update and installation reports

- Adds reports of update outcomes, such as success, failure or rollback, that may be sent by default when the update service supports them. These reports use categories and release versions without user or installation identifiers. They are separate from feature statistics, and turning off automatic update checks also turns off the reports. See the [telemetry guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/telemetry.md).
  [#154067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154067).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds an installation-count report that may be sent by default during update checks when the service supports it, separately from feature statistics. The report contains no installation ID or feature inventory. To stop it, turn off telemetry, decline it or set `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`. The telemetry CLI shows whether your installation is eligible to report. See the [telemetry guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/telemetry).
  [#186569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186569).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

- Fixes configuration saves reporting success when an external edit has already overwritten them. Reread the configuration and reapply the intended change. See the [configuration reload guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload).

##### Managed sandbox base refresh


Before publishing to GitHub, you can ask your agent to update a [writable local managed sandbox](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access#managed-project-workspaces) from the selected repository base while keeping your saved work and Git history. Resolve any reported conflicts and confirm the returned base commit, then run tests and Auto Review against the refreshed base. You can then update the same draft if you already have one. Refreshing does not publish anything. Finish any pending refresh and conflict resolution before downgrading.
[#174532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174532).

Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).




##### Cloud worker Git history


Stop and reclaim can bring Git commits from a cloud worker back to a Gateway-managed worktree. OpenClaw adds the commits to the local branch when it can fast-forward safely. If histories diverge, the branch moves or staged changes conflict, OpenClaw brings back the files and leaves a note in the conversation explaining why it left out the commits.

Commit recovery needs a transfer that supports Git history. Large histories can still prevent reclaim over SSH. See the [cloud worker session lifecycle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle).
Reclaim preserves unpushed worker commits while keeping local edits and unrelated staged changes. Older native transfers return files only. [Report #110498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110498)

[#182140](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182140).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Cloud workers


- Adds background worker downloads on supported persistent paired nodes after a Gateway update or reconnect. If the download finishes before you open a session, the first session can reuse it. A session that arrives sooner takes priority and installs as usual. See [session hosting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting).
  [#182115](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182115).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens the wait for **Stop cloud worker** when the provider confirms it has accepted cleanup. With Crabbox, the environment stays marked as destroying until the machine is released, and charges can continue in the meantime. Worker-provider plugins can opt in to the earlier return and remain responsible for confirming teardown. See [cloud workers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers).
  [#182138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182138).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated work when applying a source overlay to a worker workspace, and reduces temporary memory use when comparing workspace changes for sync.
  [#185525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185525).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Raises the minimum Crabbox version from 0.77.0 to 0.79.2 for workers, sandboxes and proof commands. OpenClaw downloads a compatible copy when the selected CLI is missing or too old. If your host cannot reach the managed download, supply Crabbox 0.79.2 or later. Legacy direct Azure checkpoints without a recorded snapshot identity require manual reconciliation. See [Crabbox troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting).
  Static SSH uses the explicitly configured port. Coordinator connections use Crabbox’s native TLS and proxy configuration. Crabbox compatibility

  [#182123](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182123).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [node worker dispatch](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/dispatching-a-session) failing or starting from the wrong Git state when the selected commit isn’t available from the remote. The worker gets the Gateway’s workspace snapshot, including the local commit it was based on. It also fixes [cloud worker turns](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle) missing new files staged with `git add` on the Gateway after dispatch. The next turn sees those files in local workspaces dispatched from the Gateway and preserves independent worker edits. New unstaged files need a fresh dispatch.
  [#185420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185420), [#185424](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185424).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes retired Crabbox warm images staying billable after Crabbox confirms their worker lease has ended. Cleanup retries pending deletions while protecting active work and leases Crabbox cannot confirm are gone.
  Warm-image cleanup

  [#185485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185485).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Warm-image recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/warm-images) also clears the hold left by an interrupted capture’s source lease when recovery is acknowledged or Crabbox confirms it has ended. Periodic cleanup recognizes the same compatible bundled Crabbox installations as Gateway startup.

#### Messaging

Telegram can show interactive message widgets, and channel delivery and recovery have received fixes. A2A peers can retrieve retained finished tasks after a Gateway restart.




##### Telegram message widgets


[Telegram message widgets](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/rich-messages) let your agent send interactive cards that update in place as you use them. Set `channels.telegram.widgets: true` to use them in compatible private bot chats, including private topics.
[Telegram interaction backport](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9afcc1b7b29a51535771a09747556970f6fbdfbd).

Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).




##### A2A task history


A2A peers can retrieve finished tasks after a Gateway restart for up to 24 hours. Retrying a message returns its retained task.
OpenClaw retains up to 500 finished tasks per account. A clean shutdown marks running tasks as failed. If storage rejects a result, the peer sees a failed task and can retrieve any completed artifact until expiry or the Gateway stops.

A2A task retention · [A2A channel](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/a2a.md).

[#183490](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183490).

Thanks [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley).




##### Messaging channels


##### Nextcloud Talk

- Adds file sharing and supported native voice messages to [Nextcloud Talk](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/nextcloud-talk.md). With OpenClaw and the Nextcloud Talk plugin at 2026.11.5 and a configured API account, opt in to receive files and voice from allowed senders, and send files as downloadable attachments. Sent files remain in that account’s Nextcloud Files until removed.
  Bot-only accounts send web links. See [outbound attachment requirements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk#outbound-attachments). Incoming shares and voice · Outgoing attachments.

  [#135895](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/135895), [#174306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174306).

  Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds native voice notes in Nextcloud Talk for explicitly requested MP3 and WAV replies, including replies read aloud by OpenClaw. Voice notes require [Nextcloud Talk API credentials](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk); other audio formats remain attachments.
  [#178521](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178521).

  Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [quoted reply context](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/channels/nextcloud-talk.md) in Nextcloud Talk 21 and later, so the agent can see the text and author you are replying to when Talk sends the quote and your visibility settings allow it.
  Quoted replies

  [#178077](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178077).

  Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) for the report.

- Changes the order of relays tried for outgoing Nostr messages. OpenClaw tries the last relay that accepted a send first, then falls back to the other configured relays.
  [#177931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177931).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Twilio SMS

- Allows SMS status to show a partial result when a Twilio check finishes near its deadline.
  [#177422](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177422).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Channel delivery and recovery

- Changes channel stall reporting so an exceptional failure while reporting a stall can interrupt the Gateway and require a restart.
  [#178250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178250).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces idle channel recovery checks to every five minutes by default. Normal incoming messages and scheduled retries do not wait for that check, and delivery can resume when a slot opens. Messages queued by another process, including manual resubmissions, and deliveries left by a stopped process may wait for the next recovery check. A custom interval can take longer. See the [durable ingress guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound#durable-ingress-monitors) and [channel commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/channels).
  Idle delivery checks · Recovery timing · [Channel recovery timing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound.md)

  [#182237](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182237), [#183233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183233).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts the queue work needed to start processing eligible single messages when a channel’s inbox is idle. Keeps an eligible Telegram message on the route chosen when it was accepted, even if OpenClaw recognizes the chat as a forum while saving the message. If your durable ingress queue wraps `enqueue`, wrap `enqueueAndClaim` too or omit it to keep your wrapper in the admission path.
  [Durable ingress for channel plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/durable-ingress)

  [#175459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175459).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database and processing work for queued incoming channel messages, including pickup and retries, and reduces the work of filtering duplicate deliveries.
  [#174393](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174393), [#174555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174555), [openclaw/openclaw@3e3ee173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3e3ee173e2e5bd87331388b83e5fcf08dc2ae2e8), [#183941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183941), [#183945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183945).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Channel status and indicators

- Stops recorded channel status from waiting on extra sign-in checks for channels that are already loaded or excluded by plugin policy.
  [#184402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184402).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work OpenClaw does to keep channel typing indicators active while a reply streams or an agent uses tools.
  [#184962](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184962).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less temporary memory to check for repeat channel progress updates.
  [#183949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183949).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Messaging replies

- Clarifies which reply token to use for silence in direct or group chats on messaging channels. If your workspace instructions use `HEARTBEAT_OK` for silence, change them to use `NO_REPLY` on its own. [Message guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/messages#silent-replies)
  [#179485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179485).

  Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the documentation, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for testing.

##### Regional channel maturity

- Breaks out regional channel maturity by account type, connection method, and capability, so evidence for one setup doesn’t imply another was tested. [Maturity taxonomy](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/maturity/taxonomy.md)
  [#177116](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177116).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

##### Message delivery across channels

- Fixes outbound routing and policy checks reading destinations incorrectly when requests for the same channel use different plugin rules.
  [#178385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178385).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes queued outbound messages getting stuck after a Gateway restart when a send was already in progress. Recovery keeps checking and looks for evidence of prior delivery before resending an uncertain message.
  [#183712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183712).

  Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183711).
- Prevents the Gateway from sending a second copy when it retries a timed-out send that is already underway, such as a slow media upload. The retry waits for the original send’s result instead.
  [#187561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187561).

  Thanks yousan, obviyus and fonchaves.
- Fixes OpenClaw losing track of some final replies before they finished delivering when a Gateway API request reused an existing session. Replies stay tracked for delivery recovery, including across conversation compaction.
  [#197427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197427), [commit 7f4704ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f4704ecaf79dc747db8d7c73c614ccd08204acd).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes queued replies on healthy accounts getting held up by a slow account after a restart or reconnect. OpenClaw can recover replies for up to four account groups at once, while keeping retries in order within each group.
  Thanks [@HermanZeng](https://github.com/HermanZeng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182658) · [#182657](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182657) · [Durable outbound delivery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry#durable-outbound-delivery)
- Keeps queued incoming channel messages from being claimed as a restart pauses new work. If the restart is cancelled, waiting messages can be delivered.
  [Commit b3f5bdd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3f5bddc46c219bf14ab88c1a485aa51f970ca82).
- Prevents later incoming messages in the same queue from jumping ahead of a failed deferred message while OpenClaw schedules the retry.
  [#175964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175964).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Keeps a failed cleanup of old queue records from blocking incoming messages on Discord and other affected channels. A failure to save the incoming message itself can still prevent delivery.
  [issue #186428](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186428).

  [#186430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186430).

  Thanks [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a slow agent database check from holding up other channels, accounts, and Gateway services that are ready to start. Channels that [queue incoming messages](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/durable-ingress) can save them during the check, but the affected agent still waits before handling them.
  [#174558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174558).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes tool progress updates that could fail to post to Mattermost, including on a freshly started Gateway. Fixes affected ACP final replies that could fail to reach Matrix rooms. Prevents a channel plugin reload from dropping replies it has already accepted for delivery.
  [Commit 292ca7a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/292ca7a1ff7c726c6cc64aced7e2a2abdf141f7f).

  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@FtlC-ian](https://github.com/FtlC-ian), and [@josh-cornelius](https://github.com/josh-cornelius) for the report.
- Fixes Telegram DM topics splitting into separate sessions after a send through an explicitly bound account when DMs are scoped per channel and peer, and fixes messages sent through a Gateway channel plugin missing from the destination conversation’s history.
  Telegram topic sessions · Destination history.

  [#175589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175589), [#175590](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175590).

  Thanks [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint), obviyus and steipete.

##### Channel login and settings

- Fixes QR login pairing the wrong account or stopping other account listeners. For multi-account channels, pass the same explicit `accountId` to `web.login.start` and `web.login.wait`. Start a fresh login after configuration reload, plugin replacement or Gateway shutdown.
  The deferred credential-write guard is supported by WhatsApp and Zalo. Authors of other channel plugins that defer writes need to call the supplied guard before saving.

  [#142571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/142571).

  Thanks [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx) for the original fix, [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for completing it and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report.
- Prevents Doctor from copying your direct-message senders into a deliberately empty group allowlist during manual or update-time repair. It also leaves missing group allowlists alone when groups are disabled.
  [#174787](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174787).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lockhartheavyindustries](https://github.com/lockhartheavyindustries).
- Fixes channel login and logout saving unrelated plugin activations to your configuration.
  If a previous login or logout saved an unwanted entry, it will still be in your configuration.

  [#145575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145575).

  Thanks [@harjothkhara](https://github.com/harjothkhara) for the fix and [@dh-js](https://github.com/dh-js) for the report.
- Keeps recorded webhook setup decisions when Doctor has left a channel pending.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).

##### Channel startup and recovery

- Fixes inbound message processing failing with older plugins after a host upgrade.
  Restores compatibility with the inbound callback used by plugins built for v2026.7.x.

  [#118011](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118011).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes channels needing two start requests to recover from a timed-out stop. One start is enough after cleanup succeeds, including for automatic recovery. A stop that finishes late no longer triggers a restart on its own. Automatic recovery still respects manual stops and waits for the usual cooldown after a failed attempt.
  [#176514](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176514).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unnecessary restarts of channel accounts that have already recovered, either after the host resumes or while OpenClaw waits for another account to stop.
  [#186077](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186077), [#186471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186471).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the Gateway health monitor starting channel accounts before they’re ready during a slow startup. If you stop an account while it’s waiting to start, startup no longer turns it back on.
  [issue #186832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186832).

  [#186857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186857).

  Thanks [@moonbow0407](https://github.com/moonbow0407), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@kevinuy-collab](https://github.com/kevinuy-collab).
- Fixes channel status checks reporting a timeout for a healthy channel when the system clock jumps forward during the check. Turning the clock back no longer overstates the time left for channel plugins.
  [#177155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177155).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Logs why a bundled channel’s settings schema failed to load, even when OpenClaw can fall back to the settings information in the plugin manifest.
  [#177216](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177216).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Channel replies and progress

- Fixes a Gateway crash when a delayed progress update fails its visibility check. OpenClaw stops progress for that reply and cancels updates already in flight.
  [#198645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198645), [commit 7ee0280a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ee0280a05681b935544102112401cf6f7e27510), [#198653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198653), [commit fbac0e3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbac0e3a8b720c6e9e2cc4aa982644522f321a60).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Stops Codex from showing calls or results in channel progress for plugin tools marked to stay hidden, including when those calls fail or time out.
  [Issue #125623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/125623).

  [#176294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176294).

  Thanks [@xydt-juyaohui](https://github.com/xydt-juyaohui) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@mir-stream](https://github.com/mir-stream) for reporting it.
- Hides recognized tool calls and their arguments in streaming channel previews while keeping the surrounding reply and literal code examples visible.
  [Streaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming).

  [#186375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186375).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) (report).
- Stops Discord progress updates when a request ends without a final reply. Keeps failures while clearing [progress drafts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/progress-drafts), stopping typing indicators or removing acknowledgment reactions from interrupting other work.
  [#198653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198653), [commit fbac0e3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbac0e3a8b720c6e9e2cc4aa982644522f321a60).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes long standalone streamed tables showing raw Markdown in later messages by repeating their headers where the table can split at a complete row. A header or row that is too large to fit, or a table that depends on surrounding Markdown, can still break mid-table.
  [issue #160668](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160668) · [Streaming tables](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/streaming.md)

  [#173220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173220).

  Thanks [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and issue reporter [@giodl73-repo](https://github.com/giodl73-repo).
- Stops ordinary channel replies from sending an extra notice when your model uses a different [thinking level](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/thinking) than the one you saved. Verbose mode or authorized tracing can still show the notice.
  [#174102](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174102).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

##### Channel commands and settings

- Fixes channel `/models` pickers showing duplicate choices when a provider and CLI alias use the same runtime. Distinct or policy-required choices remain available.
  [#172268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172268).

  Thanks [@zengwen-dt](https://github.com/ZengWen-DT), [@adam-researchh](https://github.com/Adam-Researchh).
- Keeps local `openclaw message` cleanup warnings from appearing too early or too late when the system clock jumps.
  [#187640](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187640).

  Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Refresh becoming available too soon in Agent Channels while a follow-up refresh is still running. Channel rows stay in place during refreshes and retries, even if a refresh fails. A successful retry clears the error, and late errors from an old connection no longer show up after the panel switches connections.
  [#179777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179777).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Search and conversation history across channels

- Fixes Slack and Feishu directory searches and cached Telegram sticker searches missing equivalent accented text, and Mattermost channel and joined Matrix room searches missing names written in equivalent Unicode forms.
  [#187148](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187148), [#187199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187199), [#187881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187881).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666), [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee).
- Stops recent Discord and Slack history from quoting unchanged requests again when OpenClaw can confirm it already answered them. Edited messages and unseen discussion remain eligible for context.
  [Issue #185844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185844).

  [#186081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186081).

  Thanks [@BilalIrfanContact](https://github.com/BilalIrfanContact), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@lastguru-net](https://github.com/lastguru-net).

##### Slack and Telegram introductions

- Fixes join introductions being requested in Slack group DMs or ignoring Telegram forum topic settings. Slack Enterprise Grid introductions stay with the right workspace. Failed Telegram introductions remain retryable, and long introduction context preserves emoji.
  After an OpenClaw upgrade, a new or replayed Slack Enterprise Grid membership event can produce one extra introduction per workspace and room.

  [#130699](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/130699).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Attachment limits across channels

- Fixes attachments being rejected even though they fit a fractional size limit in channels including Nextcloud Talk and QA Channel.
  [Nextcloud Talk media settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk) · [QA Channel media settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/qa-channel).

  [#178195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178195).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Interactive questions across channels

- Stops agents from using the built-in interactive question tool on channels such as Mattermost and LINE, where a run could wait for an answer you had no way to submit. On iMessage, Signal and WhatsApp, reply in a regular message instead of using a numbered reaction to answer an agent’s question. Approval reactions are unchanged. Eligible conversations in WebChat, Discord, Slack and Telegram keep their question buttons. Third-party channel plugins must declare support for question buttons to offer the built-in tool.
  [Commit fe160eb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fe160eb18fb0e2dd6f80daa24c46720a53baa619).

  Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Slack fixes

- Fixes OpenClaw ignoring per-user DM history limits for Slack’s uppercase user IDs and sending more of the conversation to the model than intended. The existing trimming cushion still applies, so the limit is not a strict message cap.
  [#186937](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186937).

  Thanks [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/yigtwxx), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack Socket Mode and relay accounts still showing as connected through prolonged outages. When retries fail to bring an account back, OpenClaw can mark it disconnected and restart it automatically.
  [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/transports)

  [#186757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186757).

  Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack channel ID migration changing the wrong account’s channels when the requested account has no channels of its own and another account differs only in capitalization.
  [#178464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178464).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes streamed Slack final replies missing the explicitly requested thread when reply threading is enabled and the preview uses a different thread. [Slack threads guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/slack/threads-and-sessions.md)
  [#168086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168086).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/patrick-erichsen).
- Reduces stalls and delayed replies in Slack during long reasoning streams when no reasoning preview is shown. Enabled previews and final replies still work as before.
  [#196250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196250).

  Thanks [@ptu-gh](https://github.com/ptu-gh), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and release backport co-authors [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) (2d8db65b3b).
- Stops delayed `sessions_send` replies from starting an unwanted Slack thread under a top-level request when `replyToMode` is off. Replies to requests made in a thread still go to that thread.
  [#187065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187065).

  Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack Home and Assistant prompts staying missing after temporary errors for events saved for retry. Fixes malformed rate-limit responses causing thread replies to be temporarily hidden.
  [Slack event handling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/events)

  [#119395](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/119395).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes answered, canceled or expired Slack questions updating the wrong card or leaving answer buttons behind. Other controls on the card stay in place.
  [Slack messaging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/messaging)

  [#118081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118081).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Stop from cancelling the previous session when a Slack conversation switches sessions before the stop takes effect.
  [#177561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177561).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports Slack HTTP webhook path conflicts even when another plugin owns the path. If you hit a conflict, give the Slack account a webhook path no other plugin route uses.
  [Slack troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/troubleshooting)

  [#173734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173734).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops repeated passive Slack failure notices for queued follow-ups after the same failure, while preserving notices for explicit requests and separate threads, workspaces, or direct messages.
  [#173515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173515).

  Thanks [@Kimiyu-186](https://github.com/Kimiyu-186).
- Fixes Slack messages repeating text already shown in rich blocks without dropping distinct text or changing code spacing. Edits retain full text when rich presentation falls back to plain text, and structured replies respect the selected account’s Markdown table setting.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6636e22fb5f578c176b6a9da032443ff012239a6).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
