  [#197191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197191), [commit 50d263c2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50d263c22be5a60f05504ada9e420ac9b86e4e8d).

  Thanks [@bach205](https://github.com/bach205) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Telegram replies getting stuck after a missing topic is rejected, and fixes custom emoji lookups being rejected as inactive during a reply in the same chat.
  OpenClaw stops the remaining reply and can retry on the original topic; a missing chat is a permanent failure.

  [#176910](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176910).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  Custom emoji.

  [#176985](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176985).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops certain failed Telegram button presses from repeating the same error and holding up later messages in the same chat. Temporary failures still retry, and an expired Telegram acknowledgment alone leaves an otherwise authorized button action eligible to finish.
  [#176679](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176679).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@hvhoon](https://github.com/hvhoon).
- Fixes `/new` and `/reset` silently failing in idle Telegram group topics, so the reset can finish, acknowledge the command and run its configured hooks.
  [#178649](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178649).

  Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Fixes Telegram final replies attaching to an earlier message instead of the message you just sent or the quote you selected. This applies in `first` and `all` reply modes when you have not set an explicit reply target.
  [#175561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175561).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Telegram replies passing a downloaded image to the agent as an unsupported document when the image was originally sent as a file. Downloaded photos and documents also keep their file types in replies. See [Telegram messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/telegram/messaging.md).
  [#174884](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174884).

  Thanks [@amittell](https://github.com/amittell), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores missing tagged voice notes during Telegram block streaming in both `final` and `all` speech modes, including when a separate final reply follows. The streamed text still arrives as usual, and audio already sent isn’t replayed.
  [#179072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179072).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@mrmillers](https://github.com/mrmillers), [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web).

  [Tagged speech output](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tts/output)
- Stops Telegram from showing automatic commentary or a “Working” card when the send policy blocks automatic replies. It also suppresses typing indicators when the policy rules out a reply. Explicit sends through the message tool remain available.
  [#178518](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178518), [#178524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178524).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Telegram custom emoji reactions failing to reach the agent when reaction notifications are enabled. Paid reactions are excluded.
  [Telegram reaction events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/events)

  [#83611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83611).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes private Telegram topic titles becoming stale in connected chat after a rename or reply. Your manual session label still takes precedence.
  [#166011](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166011).

  Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Telegram’s partial-album warning telling the agent that missing items were images even when they were videos or other media. It names the media type, or says attachments for mixed albums. The download log also names the type of item that failed.
  [#187497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187497).

  Thanks xialonglee and obviyus.
- Fixes Telegram direct-message replies that left out the footer even with usage reporting on, including queued replies. The usage footer comes through without sending the answer twice.
  [#178437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178437).

  Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@Michel-Settembrino](https://github.com/Michel-Settembrino).
- Fixes OpenClaw reporting a failed Telegram deletion when Telegram confirms the message is already gone. Permission errors and other refusals still report failure.
  Telegram deletion fix · [Issue #127534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127534)

  [#187327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187327).

  Thanks [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

<a id="feishu-1" />

##### Feishu fixes

- Fixed Feishu table cell contents being erased when replacement Markdown fails to convert.
  [#173047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173047).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Feishu tool calls for account names containing punctuation so they use the selected account’s credentials and permissions and respect disabled accounts and tools.
  [#174809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174809).

  Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Fixes [Feishu](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/feishu) controls such as `/status`, `/new`, and `/stop` waiting behind an active reply or queued chat messages. `/stop` also gets through while a slower command is running, without sending your queued messages early or changing their order.
  [#182423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182423).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@Chowei11](https://github.com/Chowei11) for the report.
- Fixes Feishu messages losing the mention that tells the receiving bot you addressed it, including in chats with several bots. The bot still recognizes commands prefixed by its mention, and an addressed `/stop` or `/btw` can get through while it is answering. For app-scoped messages from other bots, OpenClaw passes along only the receiving bot’s verified mention.
  [#182441](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182441).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@AxelHu](https://github.com/AxelHu) for the report.
- Fixes Feishu quick-action, approval and confirmation cards failing to show their buttons.
  [#79832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79832).

  Thanks [@xiabee](https://github.com/xiabee), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unlimited Feishu directory lookups stopping after the first result and Bitable metadata missing tables or fields beyond the first page. Discovery failures are reported, including failures on later pages.
  Live directory lookups retain their 100-page bound. Directory lookups · Bitable discovery.

  [#117427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117427), [#117455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117455).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Replaces silent denials of Feishu group commands such as `/new` and `/status` with a reply that tells you to ask an admin for [command access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/feishu/access-control).
  [#182439](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182439).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hjuyam](https://github.com/hjuyam) for the report.
- Fixes misleading Feishu button advice that could point you to an ineffective setting or suggest buttons that only appear as labels. OpenClaw guides agents to use command and link buttons and ask questions in plain text.
  [related issue #111470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/111470)

  [#179467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179467).

  Thanks [@shoaibulhaque](https://github.com/shoaibulhaque), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman) for co-authoring, [@njuboy11](https://github.com/njuboy11) for the report.

<a id="discord-1" />

##### Discord fixes

- Restores per-account thread binding settings for accounts with mixed-case names, including whether to enable bindings, when to start runs in a thread and how long bindings last. For those Discord accounts, OpenClaw also applies the configured server mention rules and tool restrictions. [Discord channel settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord)
  [#180715](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180715).

  Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b).
- Preserves [Discord tool restrictions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/access-control) and sender overrides in threads and forum posts admitted through a parent channel. Tool policies configured by guild name also apply after the guild is resolved.
  [#172865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172865).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord sends and retries continuing after you cancel a turn, including polls and webhook messages. Cancellation applies to pending sends. Discord keeps messages it already accepted, and voice attachment uploads keep their own timeouts.
  Original PR · [Issue #184060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184060).

  [#184915](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184915), [#184130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184130).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@licheer-zte](https://github.com/licheer-zte), [@novachem-ah](https://github.com/novachem-ah).
- Keeps archived Discord sessions closed if slash-command access is revoked before they can be restored. If a session must stay archived, OpenClaw stops the command before it makes changes and shows recovery guidance when replies are allowed.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/526b2d651b81ddd303af66117f2dea1e0fc653e1).

  Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes initial replies to Discord auto-threads going to the parent channel, and keeps an explicit parent send from suppressing the thread’s final reply.
  [#167974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167974).

  Thanks [@montrellcruse](https://github.com/montrellcruse), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes replies in bound Discord threads losing their link to the original message when a webhook persona is configured. Native replies are sent as the bot, which needs permission to send in the thread. Messages without a native reply still use the configured persona.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/305b0d7f7bce84995a815b7f02e050ee2ce2354c).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Unblocks Discord message retries when an earlier attempt times out but stays stuck. If retries run out, OpenClaw logs why and tries to reply asking you to send the message again, when current permissions and reply settings allow it.
  [Discord troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/troubleshooting).

  [#186289](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186289).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes background Discord reads being dropped solely because they waited more than 20 seconds in the queue.
  [#178427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178427).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord voice joins and reconnects being disrupted by other members changing voice state.
  [#172660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172660).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and reporter [@yousan (#172648)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172648).

  [Discord voice documentation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/discord/voice-channels.md#L167-L169).
- Fixes Discord’s `/model` command sending a valid quoted model ID to the agent as a chat message. The command switches the session’s model.
  [Reported in #179242](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179242)

  [#179280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179280).

  Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@NeoGeoSNK](https://github.com/NeoGeoSNK).
- Removes tool activity and delegated-task status from default [Discord progress drafts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/messaging) while keeping work updates, plans, and approval requests. Enable `channels.discord.streaming.progress.toolProgress` if you want the detailed activity log.
  [#176470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176470).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord pin lists silently stopping after the first 50 messages.
  [#117464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117464).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Retries transient Discord cleanup failures that could leave a Working preview beside a completed reply.
  Previews are kept when the final reply fails. [Streaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming)

  [#138692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138692).

  Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@WG-Mojo](https://github.com/WG-Mojo).
- Fixes known Discord mentions being sent as plain text when followed by sentence-ending periods or placed after a Markdown link. [Discord messaging](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/messaging)
  [#172191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172191).

  Thanks [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes blank Discord modal role selections when role details are missing, showing the selected IDs instead.
  [#173128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173128).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves authored emphasis when converting it to Discord formatting would cut into a bare URL.
  [#173420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173420).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops reporting a two-minute timeout for Discord event handlers that are still running. Slow completions and failures still appear in the logs.
  [#177294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177294).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord voice holding on to outdated speaker details or roles after OpenClaw refreshes the member’s information.
  [#178018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178018).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Discord slash-command deployment error details tied to the deployment, even while other Discord requests are running.
  [#182302](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182302).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Preserves the warning and attachment record when Discord cannot download a sticker, even when the failure has no error details.
  [#174476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174476).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps old heartbeat records from piling up in memory on idle Discord connections, without delaying heartbeat sends.
  [#178427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178427).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Matrix

- Fixes Matrix messages going missing when the Gateway restarts before an agent starts handling them. Pending messages can resume in the order they arrived in each room, without bringing in excluded first-login history or repeating messages OpenClaw recently handled. Encrypted messages can retry when their keys become available, and delivery can retry when a configured ACP route is temporarily unavailable. Existing accounts carry over their record of recently handled messages without changing any settings. Retries are bounded and persistent failures can eventually stop retrying.
  [Matrix messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/matrix/messaging.md).

  [#176491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176491).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes encrypted Matrix setup and repair mistaking an unreadable recovery key for a missing one. OpenClaw stops before replacing secret storage and shows the storage error. Resolve that error before retrying. [Matrix encryption](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/encryption)
  [#174892](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174892).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw confusing Matrix direct-message threads whose IDs differ only in letter case when looking up saved sessions. Older sessions saved with lowercase IDs are reused only when OpenClaw can confirm they belong to the same thread.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ecdad29ca7d6a3e3aa3959bef4018d64f5204a1).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes replies being wrongly rejected in some Matrix direct-message threads.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d241291dbd7f52ca444ffa1a995e999c4e07f43e).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Matrix subagents started through the Gateway’s `chat.send` API losing their thread. Replies go to the intended thread, follow-ups reach the same subagent after a Gateway restart, and a failed attempt to link a thread no longer blocks later attempts.
  [#177372](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177372).

  Thanks [@MarMarLabs](https://github.com/MarMarLabs), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Keeps new Matrix thread sessions from inheriting the room transcript while preserving allowed root context and room model inheritance.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes `openclaw matrix profile set` updating the wrong bot when you omit `--account` in a multi-account setup. It uses your configured default and checks agent-requested changes against that bot’s permissions.
  Matrix profile fix

  [#184687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184687).

  Thanks [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184654).
- Fixes stalled background work delaying Matrix account shutdown or reload. Work from the stopped account can no longer start new sends or room joins.
  [Matrix setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/setup)

  [#133862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133862).

  Thanks [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Waits for Matrix startup maintenance before reporting readiness, lets stopped Matrix CLI clients exit, and reports late in-room verification failures.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Fixed Matrix startup verification failing when given an invalid clock value.
  [#172900](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172900).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Matrix setup showing an empty lookup when the user resolver fails unexpectedly. Ordinary unresolved inputs are still reported individually.
  [#173420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173420).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes misleading Matrix [message-read pagination](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/message) guidance and rejects requests that set both `before` and `after`. Use a `nextBatch` or `prevBatch` token from a previous read to page through history, or `messageId` to read one event.
  [Issue #173252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173252).

  [#173362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173362).

  Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@seriouslysean](https://github.com/seriouslysean) (report).
- Fixes Matrix command exceptions using a different `--json` error format from the rest of the CLI. If your script reads the old Matrix error payload, check for `ok` set to `false` and read `error.type` and `error.message` instead.
  [#187173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187173).

  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Restores Matrix decryption-failure notices when the same event fails again after Matrix has stopped tracking the earlier failure.
  [#173443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173443).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes agents seeing an old room name after a Matrix room is renamed. The new name reaches the agent after OpenClaw sees the rename, without restarting the Gateway. Clearing the name uses the room ID as the conversation label. [Matrix accounts and homeservers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/accounts-and-homeservers)
  [Reported in #177782](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177782).

  [#177783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177783).

  Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Lets Doctor move old Matrix duplicate-message records even when it can’t save the migration as complete. Doctor may scan for those records again on a later run.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops idle encrypted Matrix accounts from repeatedly writing unchanged encryption state to disk.
  [#185991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185991).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lagomCat](https://github.com/lagomCat).
- Fixes an extra deleted-message placeholder that could appear after a Matrix reply finished when streaming previews and block streaming were both enabled.
  [issue #186191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186191).

  [#186275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186275).

  Thanks [@brianmcguire](https://github.com/brianmcguire), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) (co-author), [@mrmillers](https://github.com/mrmillers) (report).

<a id="whatsapp-1" />

##### WhatsApp fixes

- Fixes WhatsApp pairing failing to show a refreshed QR code when WhatsApp replaces the old one, and prevents rendering from giving up when the code keeps changing. If the code changes during rendering, the returned image can still show the previous code.
  [#174509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174509), [#178519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178519).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes WhatsApp plugin loading from the source workspace when Baileys cannot resolve `long`. [WhatsApp installation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/whatsapp)
  [#177936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177936).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes a WhatsApp failure notice that could appear even after an attachment reached the chat under a known alternate address for the same contact. The same fix recognizes text replies and records the right poll recipient when WhatsApp uses that alternate address.
  [#182517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182517).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@mulderp82](https://github.com/mulderp82) for the report.
- Fixes queued WhatsApp messages showing an error reaction even when their reply is delivered successfully. With lifecycle reactions enabled, the acknowledgment stays while delivery is pending, and success appears when the reply is delivered.
  If delivery can’t be confirmed and the transport keeps the reply to retry, the reaction clears and stays neutral. Channel plugins can use reply settlement hooks to follow queue disposition and delivery.

  [report #172708](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172708).

  [#172771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172771).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@aleps001](https://github.com/aleps001).
- Adds an explanation to normal Gateway logs when WhatsApp access rules block a direct or group message. Repeat notices are rate-limited and omit sender details and message text. [WhatsApp troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/whatsapp)
  [#93408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93408).

  [#182408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182408).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@rushindrasinha](https://github.com/rushindrasinha) (reporter).
- Fixes WhatsApp settings showing an old refresh error after a newer refresh succeeds, and keeps status rows in place when settings refresh or the display language changes, including when the phone-number row appears or disappears. Current failures still show, and retrying clears the old error.
  Refresh errors · Status rows.

  [#180620](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180620), [#182364](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182364).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Dismisses the WhatsApp logout prompt in the Control UI when its settings view closes or the Gateway reconnects.
  [#176129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176129).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

##### Google Chat

- Fixes Google Chat delivering only the first attachment to your agent and accepting incoming attachments above a configured limit below 1 MiB. Supported files arrive in order, and the message includes a notice for files that could not be delivered.
  [Google Chat media guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) · Multiple attachments · Attachment size limits.

  [#129612](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129612), [#177572](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177572).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a confirmed missing attachment from holding up later messages in Google Chat. The caption still reaches the agent, along with a note to upload the file directly.
  [Google Chat attachments](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat).

  [#178195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178195).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes agent replies in [Google Chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) dropping remote attachments. They come through as web links, even without a caption. The links support remote HTTP(S) attachments only.
  [#182416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182416).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jailbirt](https://github.com/jailbirt) for the report and [@pbreault](https://github.com/pbreault) for corroborating it.
- Stops OpenClaw from starting new Google Chat destination lookups after permission to send expires. Messages Google Chat already accepted still retain their delivery receipts and any permitted local history.
  [#185972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185972).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [Google Chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) leaving a typing message behind after a turn ends without a reply. Queued replies keep their typing message while pending, and an unconfirmed edit is left alone when it might already be the reply.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04be301c3b77474a203e56cf1d56bdc93198ba7b).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@MumuTW](https://github.com/MumuTW).

<a id="microsoft-teams-1" />

##### Microsoft Teams fixes

- Fixes Microsoft Teams agent replies dropping supported interactive cards, including card-only replies. Stopping a streamed reply also prevents its pending cards from being sent.
  Select menus use the existing fallback.

  [#129720](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129720).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@edenfunf](https://github.com/edenfunf) for the related report.
- Fixes SharePoint-backed Teams file sends failing when a successful upload returns an item ID without a file name or link, or when successful sharing returns no link. [Sending files in Teams](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/msteams/messaging#sending-files-in-group-chats)
  [#177645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177645).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Microsoft Teams messages losing the names of other people you mention before your agent reads the message.
  See issue [#102376](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102376).

  [#184361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184361).

  Thanks [@wyf027](https://github.com/wyf027) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix, [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) for the report and [@devinkuhn](https://github.com/devinkuhn) for the example.
- Fixes Microsoft Teams emoji showing up as unavailable attachments. OpenClaw keeps the emoji text Teams supplies in HTML-only messages without dropping real image attachments.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/LiuwqGit">@LiuwqGit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/devinkuhn">@devinkuhn</a>. [#177373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177373) · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177341">Issue #177341</a>

##### iMessage

- Keeps the app-managed Bun Gateway at a stable path across updates so Messages Automation approval can persist. Approve Automation the first time it moves; ad-hoc or source-built Bun replacements may also need Full Disk Access reapproval. Send diagnostics distinguish Automation denial from timeout, and recognized send and attachment warnings remain visible after healthy read checks. If a send times out, check delivery before retrying.
  [Automation approval and send diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a20c18dd0f1be13d939ea6ee3f2ff085607d1b17), [Account status warnings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3288a4e963cfb4ce2849137d15d94eb6e4b9c5db).
- Requires explicit approvers for iMessage execution approvals from chat selectors. Configure approvers if those chats should receive approval prompts. [iMessage access control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/access-control)
  [#173493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173493).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes iMessage accounts silently skipping messages received during downtime when OpenClaw can’t read their saved recovery progress. The account now reports the error and halts startup. Resolve the reported storage error and restart the account to resume recovery. Compatibility catchup uses its own saved progress and isn’t blocked by that read failure.
  [iMessage messaging and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/messaging)

  [#175442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175442).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes one-to-one iMessage replies and sends creating a separate group history when addressed by chat ID, GUID, or identifier. Resolved chats stay in their direct session, and unresolved targets create no guessed history. Older duplicate history stays in place. [iMessage access control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/access-control)
  [Issue #173367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173367)

  [#173493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173493).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lockhartheavyindustries](https://github.com/lockhartheavyindustries).

<a id="mattermost-1" />

##### Mattermost fixes

- Fixes a Mattermost bug that sent native slash command replies to the channel instead of the thread and ran the command in the wrong conversation. Model pickers and typing indicators stay in the thread too, and model-picker exchanges are recorded in its history.
  [issue #173828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173828).

  [#173829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173829).

  Thanks [@rodricksz4h5](https://github.com/rodricksz4h5) and obviyus.
- Fixes Mattermost sends silently dropping unsupported binary attachments by reporting an error before posting. Use a supported media URL or file path for these attachments.
  [Mattermost media guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/mattermost)

  [#129287](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129287).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes rapid Mattermost posts failing to combine when inbound batching is enabled, and preserves unhandled input for recovery if the monitor stops.
  [#166499](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166499).

  Thanks [@alkor2000](https://github.com/alkor2000), [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson), [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha), [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668).
- Retries creating a Mattermost DM channel after more kinds of temporary connection failures, including a network-down error.
  [#177891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177891).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Limits rapid back-and-forth replies between Mattermost bot accounts while keeping their messages allowed by default under the usual access and mention rules.
  [Bot loop protection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/bot-loop-protection), [Related report by josh-cornelius](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99279).

  [#183239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183239).

  Thanks [@hannnnn-l](https://github.com/hannnnn-l) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

<a id="nextcloud-talk-1" />

##### Nextcloud Talk fixes

- Fixes Nextcloud Talk rejecting allowed messages, media and approvals when the allowlist uses a bare user ID. Bare and prefixed user IDs match regardless of case, while guest identities remain separate. [Nextcloud Talk guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk)
  [Issue #176242](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176242).

  [#176297](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176297).

  Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for reporting it.
- Prevents Nextcloud Talk from mistaking direct chats for group chats or vice versa after the server or credentials change. Room lookups also stop reusing refusals from an old network policy or returning old room types after credentials are removed.
  [#178227](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178227).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Nextcloud Talk ignoring requests to send messages and supported [native attachments](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk#silent-sends) quietly. Quiet messages remain visible in the room. Silent attachments need Talk 18 or later and server support; if support cannot be confirmed, the file is not sent.
  [#180202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180202).

  Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops OpenClaw from sending pairing prompts or creating pending pairing requests for its own file shares in Nextcloud Talk DMs.
  [Issue #183260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183260)

  [#183261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183261).

  Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Signal

- Fixes Signal container connections that could still look connected after a network drop even though incoming messages had stopped. OpenClaw reconnects automatically for future messages. Messages missed during the outage remain unrecovered.
  [issue #186339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186339) · [Signal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/signal).

  [#186340](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186340).

  Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) (co-author).
- Fixes Signal replies losing quoted media context after a restart when media type or kind is missing.
  [#173397](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173397).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes formatted Signal messages ignoring your paragraph-splitting setting. When a send or reply needs splitting, newline mode respects paragraph boundaries without losing blank lines inside code.
  [#176258](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176258).

  Thanks [@tianhaotian](https://github.com/tianhaotian), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval).
- Fixes Signal chats continuing to show OpenClaw as typing after it finishes a turn without sending a reply.
  [#187232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187232).

  Thanks yousan, obviyus and steipete.

<a id="x-1" />

##### X fixes

- Fixes authorized public X requests failing to start a child session with a plugin model provider, and keeps failed automatic replies to mentions out of public posts. An automatic reply may be withheld if the agent has not declared success.
  Explicit message-tool sends reject drafts marked as failed but do not require a success declaration. An optional non-X route can send failure notices. Plugin model requests · Reply outcomes and failure routing · [X guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x#reply-outcomes-and-failures).

  [#173667](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173667), [#173701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173701).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@Kimiyu-186](https://github.com/Kimiyu-186) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  @Patrick-Erichsen and @joshavant requested the failure route.
- Fixes a temporary spend-tracking error that could leave paid X requests blocked even after the channel restarted. Once storage recovers, an X channel restart can restore paid requests without restarting the Gateway. Unsettled requests can still count against your spend limit at their full reserved cost.
  [#187382](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187382).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes follow-up mentions from X maintainers arriving without references to earlier work in the same conversation. The agent can use those references to look up work it already has access to, and X replies still require approval. If your instructions always require a fresh session, change them to allow continuation.
  [X guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x).

  [#174305](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174305).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes X replies that split a gallery into one post per image. Up to four images stay together with the caption, on the first post if the caption runs across several posts. Rejects an invalid attachment set before posting, and records which posts went out if a later post in the reply fails.
  [#185060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185060).

  Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a paid username lookup when an administrator loses access before OpenClaw sends the lookup for an X allowlist addition.
  [#178861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178861).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a backward system clock change from extending the wait for X to process an attachment. If processing times out, OpenClaw reports that you can retry and leaves the post unsent.
  [#183742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183742).

  Thanks [@mikasa0818](https://github.com/mikasa0818), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing eligible Git co-author credit for requests from X after an administrator links the sender’s immutable ID to an existing profile on the configured X account. [Requester identity and credit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x#requester-identity-and-credit)
  Credit also depends on the profile’s eligible GitHub identity and credit preference.

  [#182213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182213).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Clears stale X replies account details and shows the administrator requirement if you lose access. Retrying a failed action clears its old alert, and a late failure from an earlier action no longer overrides a newer result.
  [#180656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180656).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Tlon

- Fixes automatic replies going undelivered in Tlon group threads. Replies go to the existing thread, while replies to top-level group messages stay in the channel instead of starting a new thread.
  Tlon group replies fix

  [#187820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187820).

  Thanks [@HootRock](https://github.com/HootRock) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@Somlus](https://github.com/Somlus) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187658).
- Restricts [Tlon citation expansion](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/tlon) to the current watch list when auto-discovery is off. Verified one-to-one messages from the owner are exempt from the watch-list limit.
  [#186092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186092).

  Thanks [@mmaps](https://github.com/mmaps).
- Fixes Tlon image uploads losing filenames and custom-S3 links breaking on special characters.
  [Tlon media guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/tlon)

  [#141326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/141326).

  Thanks [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the disconnect request Tlon sends so the server can close the channel and its subscriptions.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

<a id="nostr-1" />

##### Nostr fixes

- Protects delivery of approved Nostr DMs by filtering senders outside an explicit, nonempty DM allowlist made up entirely of valid literal public keys.
  Thanks to [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit). [#173321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173321) · [Nostr allowlists](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/nostr.md)
- Removes the cooldown that could stop the next Nostr send from trying a relay that had already recovered.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Nostr settings refreshes from replacing the channel details and profile rows that are still on screen when only their values change.
  [#182289](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182289).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.

##### ClickClack

- Preserves existing channel revocations when moving ClickClack state to PostgreSQL.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes silent network drops leaving [ClickClack](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/clickclack) bots looking connected but unable to receive messages. The bot reconnects automatically and picks up messages still in ClickClack’s backlog.
  [Issue #184852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184852).

  [#184853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184853).

  Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Fixes ClickClack dropping newer progress updates that arrive while it is posting or updating the current activity.
  [#173464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173464).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Buzz

- Prevents long-running Buzz accounts from accumulating leftover connection resources when they reconnect after a channel connection fails.
  [#178296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178296).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an unfinished Buzz member profile lookup from holding up a new member selection. A stalled profile lookup no longer reconnects the account, so fallback names may stay visible until the selection changes or Buzz reconnects.
  [Buzz guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/buzz)

  [#176987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Zalo and Zalo Personal

- Keeps each managed Zalo Personal registration’s sign-in and group information separate when the plugin reloads. A QR sign-in left over from before the reload no longer overwrites your saved sign-in.
  [#182619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182619).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reports Zalo provider rejections as send errors for message-tool callers.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Reef

- Fixes Reef commands returning a plain error string in `--json` mode instead of the standard structured error. If a script reads the old `error` string, switch it to `error.message`.
  [#183384](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183384).

  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes inconsistent ordering when several Reef messages are overdue. Reef sends the overdue notices in message ID order, even across different peers.
  [#181654](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181654).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### A2A

- Fixes A2A tasks getting stuck in Working after waiting for another turn in the same conversation. The original task receives the final status and any reply, so peers can keep using the same task ID.
  [#183803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183803).

  Thanks [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [A2A task polling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/a2a).

##### IMAP

- Fixes new IMAP watchers failing to pick up new mail when the server doesn’t provide a valid next message ID. The watcher starts from the end of the mailbox without replaying old mail. An invalid position saved by an earlier version isn’t automatically repaired.
  Mail arriving during initial baseline discovery may become part of that baseline. Valid saved positions resume without rebaselining. See [issue #162543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/162543) and the related open PR [#162548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162548).

  [commit 2f181d5f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f181d5f907f3a2c9e3f11ecf6408f248e430bda).

  Thanks [@linancn](https://github.com/linancn) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### IRC

- Fixes IRC messages triggering the bot in channels with an explicitly empty `allowFrom` list. Those channels accept no senders. Remove the empty override to inherit the wildcard channel’s settings, or list the senders you want to allow.
  [#196293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196293).

  Thanks [@mmaps](https://github.com/mmaps), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

- Fixes Twitch connection checks reporting success before Twitch accepts the bot’s sign-in.
  [#178354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178354).

##### Reef


- Reduces repeated database checks when Reef has nothing to reconcile in its SQLite delivery state, and cuts background work checking for peer changes when it has retained delivery history.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

#### Memory

Experimental Knowledge can save sourced facts and decisions when you select it as your memory provider. If moving from a separately installed copy, save its settings and store assignments before uninstalling, then restore them and the memory slot. PostgreSQL memory search rebuilds indexes, so retain a verified pre-upgrade backup and matching build for rollback. Stop all processes using a LanceDB table before compacting it.




##### Knowledge (experimental)


With experimental [Knowledge](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge), agents can save and find decisions, preferences and project facts along with their sources. Select Knowledge as your memory provider to turn it on. It replaces your previously active provider without deleting its data. You can browse records and their history in the Control UI, and agents can attach files already in their authorized workspace.

An administrator can give a specific group chat or channel read access to an agent’s private Knowledge, or allow it to read and save. Threads inherit access unless a more specific grant applies. Revoking access cannot take back information already retrieved by a conversation. [Stores and access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/stores-and-access)

If you are [moving from a separately installed copy](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge#moving-from-a-linked-or-path-install), save its settings, including store assignments, before uninstalling it. Restore them and the memory slot after enabling the bundled plugin.
Knowledge as a memory provider includes owner-approved recall and scheduled claim maintenance.

[#180139](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180139).

Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).

[#186455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186455).

Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).




##### Knowledge Scribes


[Knowledge Scribes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/scribes) can learn from conversations once or on a schedule, including archived conversations if you choose, or import selected Memory notes once without changing the originals. In the Control UI you can review and edit the prompt, check run history and manage scribes. Starting or controlling them requires Gateway write access, and they use your private access and the agent’s default model.

With Granola connected, a scribe can create Knowledge pages for meetings with transcripts and save their notes and transcripts. You choose the starting date, whether to include your own meetings or all meetings you can read, and a one-time or weekday schedule. Choosing all readable meetings includes their notes and transcripts in Knowledge. [Granola setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/scribes#the-granola-plugin)

You can also enable Knowledge Consolidation to review unlinked claims weekly or nightly. Nightly runs can use more tokens, and private claim review requires an owner-authorized session. Regular nightly maintenance relinks claims without starting an agent review. [Maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/maintenance)
[#185583](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185583).

[#185637](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185637), [#185974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185974), [#185836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185836).

[#185949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185949), [#187659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187659).

Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).




##### Learning with /learn


With a participating memory plugin selected, `/learn` can save facts, preferences and decisions to memory, even without Skill Workshop. When both are available, it directs repeatable procedures to skills and other lessons to memory. `/learn undo` applies only to skill changes. [Skill Workshop guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skill-workshop) · [Memory plugin SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/memory-and-context)
Adds opt-in `/learn` support for selected memory plugins in tool-capable, non-sandboxed sessions with permission to use the plugin’s learning tools.

[#181879](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181879).

Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).




##### PostgreSQL memory search


If your agent uses PostgreSQL, experimental [memory search](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory#postgresql-memory-search) can find indexed material by keyword, by meaning, or both. Semantic search needs the vector extension, while keyword-only search works without it. Memory and chat history searches also find words within dates, paths and filenames, with original punctuation in previews.

The search migration rebuilds text indexes once for existing PostgreSQL agent stores. Rolling it back requires the verified pre-upgrade backup and its matching build. [Storage changes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes) · [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
[#174374](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174374).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

For punctuation-aware memory and chat search, see the [reported issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183439).

[#183547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183547).

Thanks [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for reporting.

[#183560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183560), [#183667](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183667).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### LanceDB table compaction


Use [`openclaw ltm optimize`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/memory-lancedb#compact-a-local-table) to compact a whole local LanceDB memory table across agents while keeping its rows and version history. Stop every Gateway and other process using the table, including external scripts, before running it, then restart the Gateways. The command reports fragment and row counts before and after. Keeping old versions means compaction may leave disk use unchanged.
Offline compaction of a local shared table.

[#182530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182530).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the command and [@islandpreneur007](https://github.com/islandpreneur007) for the maintenance request.

##### LanceDB startup

- Removes LanceDB's automatic initialization retries, which previously allowed up to three attempts. If two processes initialize the same new table, an invocation can report the first error while the table is still becoming readable; retry the invocation once the table is ready.
  [#173064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173064).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Knowledge reloads opening stores before earlier storage and maintenance work has stopped. Interrupted requests explain that they can be retried, and weekday and month-day maintenance schedules catch the first matching midnight after clocks spring forward.
  Reload and shutdown · spring-forward schedules · [Maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/maintenance).

  [#184999](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184999), [#185003](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185003), [#2](https://github.com/openclaw/knowledge/pull/2).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif).
- Prevents malformed UTF-8 in ChatGPT exports, Wiki file imports and source sync from corrupting existing pages. These imports and OKF reimports also leave an existing page untouched if it contains malformed UTF-8. ChatGPT reimports preserve handwritten Notes containing a closing-marker example, and leave a page untouched if a Notes marker is missing. Restore the marker or use valid UTF-8 and retry the affected import.
  ChatGPT exports · bridge and unsafe-local sources · file imports and Notes · OKF imports · [Wiki import guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki) · [Memory Wiki](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/memory-wiki).

  [#171621](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171621), [#171675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171675), [#173931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173931), [#175707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175707).

<a id="local-memory-flushes"></a>

- Fixes memory flushes failing when the separate flush model was unavailable even though the session had a working fallback. Flushes now use the session model and its fallbacks. [Memory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory) · [Doctor migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#memory-flush-model-selection) · [Plugin SDK migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration#memory-flush-model-selection).
  Supported updates remove `agents.defaults.compaction.memoryFlush.model`. If your configuration still contains it, run `openclaw doctor --fix` before starting the Gateway. Plugin authors should remove `model` from custom flush plans.

  [#182208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182208).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@zijunl](https://github.com/zijunl) for the earlier proposal.
- Fixes memory search rejecting `google` as an unknown embedding provider. Both `google` and `gemini` use the same Gemini index, so you don’t need to rebuild it just to change the name. [Memory configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config)
  [#182250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182250).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/LiLan0125">@LiLan0125</a>, <a href="https://github.com/dwc1997">@dwc1997</a>, <a href="https://github.com/fenglanhua">@fenglanhua (report)</a>.
- Fixes Memory Overview updates taking keyboard focus off **Refresh status**. The embedding **Test** button also stays in place through updates that leave it available.
  [#182290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182290).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Reduces the work of making room in a full PostgreSQL memory embedding cache by letting the database find older entries using the timestamp index.
  Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the original cache-eviction fix. [#182821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182821) · [fdad53b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdad53b1bc1d66d98a11da12fb633a75f8285ecb)
- Fixes unnecessary re-embedding during memory rebuilds and after an [agent database port](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#port-existing-stores). Paused background rebuilds keep cached embeddings for reuse, and PostgreSQL full rebuilds can reuse them when caching is enabled. The cache can temporarily grow to twice its configured limit and is trimmed after the rebuild finishes or is discarded.
  Paused rebuild cache · PostgreSQL rebuilds · [issue #182886 reported by etzelm](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182886) · database ports and full rebuild reuse · [issue #183228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183228) · [Built-in memory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin).

  [#182968](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182968), [#183089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183089), [#183302](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183302).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), who also reported issue #183228.
- Fixes Codex turns reaching memory plugins without the original user message, which could make a plugin like Hindsight skip a completed turn.
  [#182977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182977).

  Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@PaulClawitzki](https://github.com/PaulClawitzki).

- Prevents cleanup of an excluded session archive from deleting newer entries for that session from the memory index. Cleanup also skips an extra lookup when it already knows the session is missing from the index.
  [#183132](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183132).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Memory settings plugin panels staying active after you leave or switch their tab.
  [#183367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183367).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `wiki apply synthesis --body-file` hanging on special files. The command rejects those inputs before changing the wiki and reports the error in JSON mode too. Use a regular UTF-8 file or pass the text with `--body`.
  [Wiki CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki).

  [#183435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183435).

  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes a shutdown error that could occur after an interrupted Memory Core index rebuild.
  [#184616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184616).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  The temporary rebuild cache can stay at up to twice its configured cap until a later write or completed rebuild trims it.
- Fixes compatible older memory indexes going stale or returning empty results after embedding credentials change. If you are upgrading an older index that uses the generic OpenAI-compatible provider, run a successful search with the original provider, URL, model and credentials before rotating credentials. Switching to the [named oMLX provider](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/omlx) still requires a rebuild.
  [#174851](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174851).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory search using the wrong text format with recognized Nemotron-3-Embed and Nemotron-3.5-Embed models and rebuilds affected indexes automatically. Gemini also honors an explicit document format, including unprefixed text and batch indexing. You can set [query and document prefixes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config) for aliases and other models. If you change the document prefix, reindex with `openclaw memory index --force`.
  Embedding formats

  [#184142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184142).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@ajmtrz](https://github.com/ajmtrz) for the report.
- Prevents native Ollama memory search from reusing old vectors when an alias is detected pointing to a different model. If the server does not report model digests, or you retargeted the alias before its first digest was recorded, follow the [reset and reindex guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config).
  Ollama alias handling

  [#184142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184142).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@ajmtrz](https://github.com/ajmtrz) for the report.
- Fixes Knowledge and other memory tools being denied in new sessions you create without an initial message when your DM scope is not `main` or your session scope is global. If you already have an affected session, create a new one to restore access.
  [#184751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184751).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes memory tools like Knowledge being denied access in new sessions started with `openclaw agent exec`. Those sessions use the local operator’s existing private memory access.
  [Memory and context](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/memory-and-context)

  [#185041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185041).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes agent database moves between SQLite and PostgreSQL leaving the first memory search to rebuild the index. The [database port](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) now attempts the rebuild before it finishes and reuses saved embeddings for unchanged content when available. The move can take longer, and if an index fails to rebuild, the move stays in place and the command tells you how to retry for that agent before restarting the Gateway.
  [#182008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182008).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the report.
- Adds a best-effort save of durable notes before OpenClaw shortens a conversation that the model rejected as too long. Recovery still proceeds if the notes cannot be saved.
  [issue #114081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/114081).

  [#186401](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186401), [#118681](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118681).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@XdotX78](https://github.com/XdotX78).
- Fixes Memory file watching silently stopping after a crash. OpenClaw warns when watching is unavailable, retries automatically and catches up on edits it missed. If repeated failures stop automatic recovery, resolve the problem and restart the Gateway to resume watching. See the [Memory guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin).
  [#175342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175342).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes interrupted session memory indexing treating unfinished work as up to date. OpenClaw keeps the changes pending and can resume without discarding what it already indexed.

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

#### Skills

Skill Workshop can save proposed skill changes as drafts for you to apply or discard.




##### Skill Workshop drafts


In **Propose** mode, Skill Workshop saves what your agent learns as drafts so you can review changes before they reach your live skills. Open **Drafts** in the Control UI to apply or discard a draft, or use `/learn drafts` in chat. Applied updates to existing skills can be undone. See the [Skill Workshop guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skill-workshop#drafts).

Doctor brings earlier exported proposals into Drafts and keeps existing Propose settings. If your setting was previously switched to **Off**, choose **Propose** again to resume draft review.
Draft review and confirmation

[#181747](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181747).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the change and [@nikosml](https://github.com/nikosml) and [@diskawrs](https://github.com/diskawrs) for workflow feedback.

#### Native Apps

Android offers a persistent sidebar in eligible wide windows, and desktop builds can use a bundled runtime. The macOS Tauri app requires macOS 26.2 or later, while Linux AOT remains experimental.




##### Android sidebar


The Android sidebar shows Gateway folders in their shared order, including empty folders, and lets you load more sessions. In wide, unobstructed flat windows, it stays beside the current page; compact windows use the drawer. Gateway folders are read-only in the Android sidebar.
The sidebar appears automatically in unobstructed flat windows at least 840 dp wide and 320 dp tall.

[#143466](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/143466).

Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@saariuslystoned](https://github.com/saariuslystoned).

Use **Show more** to expand an individual section or **Load more sessions** to fetch another page.

[#164857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164857).

Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Tauri desktop runtimes


The Tauri desktop app can include a runtime, so new local setups install the version bundled with the app. Existing local Gateways can switch to the bundled runtime from the tray. The macOS Tauri app now requires macOS 26.2 or later.

Experimental ahead-of-time runtimes can be bundled on glibc Linux x64 and arm64 and Apple silicon Macs. JIT remains the release default and the production choice on Linux, where quitting an AOT build can still require a forced stop. See [desktop build options](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone#desktop-app-artifacts).
To switch an existing local Gateway, start it and confirm **Use bundled runtime…** in the tray. On Windows, the switch supports JIT runtimes. After a successful switch, the app reloads the dashboard, updates its managed CLI and keeps the previous runtime for recovery.

The manual Linux App workflow can package a prebuilt Linux x64 artifact.

[#185885](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185885).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

#### Models and Providers

Connect more providers, configure utility-model fallbacks and inspect usage by provider. If you use a retired Daybreak Blue or Red alias, review your configuration, saved chats and scheduled jobs and choose a replacement model and Access program.




##### Models and Usage


Models brings your provider accounts and access together, while Usage shows your local session spending, activity and cost charts. Expand a provider in Models to see its accounts and available plan information, test its connection or manage access. When you remove a provider, OpenClaw asks before deleting saved accounts or eligible API keys, which may be shared.

Usage loads session totals and charts independently of provider plans. Its daily chart breaks down tokens and costs by provider, and the calendar stays visible when you select a day. If a provider does not report usage, totals can understate what you used or were charged. Usage with no known price is marked Unpriced.
Provider settings and external secrets stay in place when a provider is removed. Interrupted removals report what completed.

[#174904](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174904).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

Session and plan loading are independent. Plan reads can resume after reconnecting, and failed session reads can recover.

[#176358](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176358), [#176404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176404), [#187212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187212).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).




##### Requesty


OpenClaw now works with [Requesty](https://www.requesty.ai/) for AI inference. Requesty’s service offers 600+ models from 30+ providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, and teams can [set Requesty to mask personal information](https://www.requesty.ai/security), such as names and email addresses, in prompts before they reach a model provider.
Requesty setup and model selection.

[#180788](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180788).

Thanks [@lavicosa](https://github.com/lavicosa) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for contributing, and [@Thibaultjaigu](https://github.com/Thibaultjaigu) for filing the earlier [feature request #54444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54444).

Model discovery lists managed chat models available to your key and does not account for region-specific policies. If discovery fails, three built-in choices remain available. See [Using Requesty with OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/requesty).




##### Bifrost gateway


Connect an existing [Bifrost gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/bifrost) from OpenClaw setup and choose a model it lists or enter an ID. You can refresh its catalog later. Setup supports modern virtual keys and gateways that allow anonymous inference.
Provider and model discovery · [Issue #175543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175543). Legacy keys need custom request headers, which must be reapplied if setup runs again.

[#175509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175509).

Thanks [@midhunvnadh](https://github.com/midhunvnadh) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### oMLX


Use models served by your oMLX server for chat and choose a separate embedding model for memory search. After changing the embedding provider or model, run `openclaw memory index --force`. [oMLX setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/omlx.md) · [Memory search](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/memory-search.md)
Memory can use separate credentials, and saved oMLX credentials are scoped to their server. Compatible embedding indexes remain usable when a declared custom authentication header rotates.

oMLX chat and embeddings · [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74732).

[#173327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173327).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@mppyes-ai](https://github.com/mppyes-ai) for the report.




##### Utility model fallbacks


Utility tasks can use their own backup models, independently of the main chat model’s fallback list. Titles, progress narration, Activity recaps, composer predictions, Side chat and transcript summaries can try those models in order after a retryable failure. Backup providers can receive the task’s content, so choose providers you trust with that data. [Utility model settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents/models)
In Model Providers, you can edit the first utility backup while keeping later entries. For independent fallback chains and Model Providers controls, see the [Feature request](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/159070) and [Model Providers guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-providers/control-ui-and-keys).

[#173906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173906).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization).

Auto uses the provider’s declared small-model default when available. See the corrected [Model selection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/models).

[#173999](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173999).

Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).




##### Daybreak Access


You can choose an available Daybreak Access level in chat or a new session without changing your model or Speed. OpenClaw keeps an available choice when you reopen a chat, start a new one or reset a session. Daybreak is also available with eligible OpenAI API keys, including in native Codex.

Admins need to [grant Blue and Red Access separately](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/operator-scopes#access-program-grants) for named Gateway roles. Model permission and provider eligibility also apply.

If you use a retired Daybreak Blue or Red model alias, check your configuration, saved chats and scheduled jobs, then [choose a replacement model and Access program](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/models#daybreak-alias-retirement).
When no Access choice is saved, eligible requests can recover on the selected model and account instead of switching to a retiring alias. Unavailable saved choices are rejected rather than silently changed.

[#177812](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177812).

Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).

An explicit Standard choice is kept during retries, and removing a grant requires fresh authorization for queued and recovered work.

[#184930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184930).

Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

Turning Daybreak off selects Standard; turning it on restores the last available Blue or Red choice for that agent. If access cannot be checked, the saved choice is kept without offering unconfirmed options. The displayed Access default matches the requested default on supported OpenAI routes, and reopening a chat no longer loads New Session setup to restore it.

[#185039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185039).

Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

Eligible API-key access fixes missing options and rejected requests. Native Codex supports eligible ChatGPT and Platform API-key accounts. The same change prevents a pending share action for a replaced chat from affecting the new session.

[#184451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184451).

Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) for Daybreak and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the sharing fixture work.

[Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) can find retired selections with `openclaw doctor --lint --only openai/daybreak-alias-retirement`. `openclaw doctor --fix` removes the obsolete failover target, but does not choose a replacement. References it cannot safely replace remain for review and retry.

[#184519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184519).

Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).

##### ClawRouter media


Use ClawRouter to generate speech for Talk and phone calls, create images from text with eligible GPT Image 2.5 Flare or Sunburst models, and transcribe audio files including Talk uploads with gpt-4o-transcribe. Image generation and transcription require access on your ClawRouter deployment and key; speech needs a key with speech access. Requests can count against your ClawRouter budget.
- Speech synthesis and voice model discovery ([#178860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178860)) · [Speech setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/extensions/clawrouter/README.md#speech).
- Prompt-to-image generation and model discovery ([#178876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178876)) · [Supported models and setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter#image-generation).
- Audio transcription ([#178920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178920)) · [Audio setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/extensions/clawrouter/README.md). Uploads are capped at 25 MB and can be limited further in settings. After an upload to ClawRouter is attempted, a failure ends automatic provider selection.

Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).




##### Jev and TypeSafe decisions


Jev can answer Boolean, choice and score questions about text or structured data through OpenRouter or a compatible TypeSafe plugin. Hosted TypeSafe Jev also supports experimental questions about a single PNG or JPEG image. TypeSafe can connect to a System One server on another machine, so you can run inference separately from the Gateway. Evaluations send their evidence to the selected provider or server. See [TypeSafe setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/typesafe) and its [image formats and limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/typesafe#experimental-image-decisions).
Select `openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.13` to pin the model or `openrouter/~typesafe/jev-latest` to follow updates. V1 can reject results it cannot represent without losing billing or metadata. TypeSafe exposes route-specific pricing and limits for the pinned hosted model.
