  [#199042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199042), [commit 867f3eb4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/867f3eb43f1f808cf7476b4215e02821f397cee5).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen) for the original change, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport, and [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott) for the report.
- Fixes a TypeScript error that could prevent the Slack extension from generating its type declarations.
  [commit 01ee4896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01ee48969b72dd033a01cec0e5f8bc09afa80e55).
- Fixes plugins using the wrong sandbox policy when the Plugin SDK is configured to use a different session store from the running OpenClaw instance.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/addb353acb4cdd16600112be857ca2a1fa62b0f3).

  Also carried by [the integration commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f50415ef21515fba2bb23114ab573abd5068b92).
- Corrects the GPT-6 Luna Decisions entry so it is identified as supporting Code Mode.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5199713a8ebf1bbcebc168f19f72e49464701156).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the [decision tool](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models) discarding valid responses with details such as an explicit yes or no, an abstention, an error on one question, or reported usage and cost. The tool also tells agents which question types and limits the selected model declares.
  [#174161](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174161).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops optional tool filtering from taking the last available spot from requested [decision evaluations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models). When the provider is too busy for optional filtering, the agent keeps its tools.
  [#174266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174266).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Skips the extra model request from automatic Decision assistance when there are no tools for it to restrict.
  [#174269](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174269).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [Decision SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities) evaluations getting a fresh timeout after preparation. If preparation uses all the time you requested, OpenClaw skips the provider call. Preparation or cleanup can still take longer than the requested timeout.
  [#174283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174283).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Avoids loading unrelated parts of OpenClaw just to look up model helpers during plugin or provider setup.
  [#174516](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174516).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Strengthens isolation for plugin hooks that run before tool calls by rejecting inputs that would let them share memory with the host.
  [#175276](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175276).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes session-binding capabilities disappearing or operations failing after a plugin registers a class-based adapter.
  [#175769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175769).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes configured static model discovery losing the credential ownership declared by provider plugins. Conflicting credential owners are rejected rather than silently accepted.
  [#175896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175896).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Corrects the TypeBox version in the [plugin publishing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/building-plugins.md) and [SDK setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-setup.md) examples to the recommended `1.3.37` pin.
  [#172942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172942), [openclaw/openclaw@8c9a6969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c9a6969e27bde70f9e7b38b5bdc80605f1c05be).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a pending V1 decision from being sent after its credentials or selected model change, for providers that honor OpenClaw’s request checks.
  [#175995](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175995).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes gaps in [Decision usage reporting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities) for accepted evaluations from the core APIs, the Decision tool, automatic tool screening, and V1 plugins. Token counts and costs are recorded when that information is available.
  [#176050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176050).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Gives plugins a distinct `LLM_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE` error when OpenClaw refuses a model request during a reload or after retiring the plugin. Plugin authors can distinguish these refusals from provider failures and decide whether to retry from a fresh operation after the reload.
  [#178543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178543).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes [`openclaw plugins init`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/authoring) generating package names npm rejects for scoped tool and provider plugins. A scaffold for `@scope/pkg` now uses `@scope/openclaw-plugin-pkg`.
  [#186901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186901).

  Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).




##### Plugins, skills and templates


- Adds light and dark backgrounds to plugin themes. Select the plugin theme and **Theme artwork** in the Control UI to see the matching image. A mode without a usable image falls back to neutral artwork, and older Gateways reject the new manifest field.
  [#172627](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172627), [#173673](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173673).

  Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/patrick-erichsen).
- Uses ClawHub by default when installing a plugin by package name from the CLI, chat or an agent. Add `npm:` to commands or scripts that should use npm, including scoped package names. Bare, unversioned IDs for bundled and official plugins remain shortcuts. See the [plugin install guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/install).
  A missing ClawHub package does not trigger a fallback to another registry.

  [#173669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173669).

  Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Adds automatic shortening of one eligible oversized learned skill per agent during daily maintenance when Skill Workshop is in auto mode. The rewrite sends the skill text to the agent’s primary model provider and can be undone from version history. See [Skill Workshop](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skill-workshop#skill-diet).
  Explicitly denying an agent access to Skill Workshop also skips its daily maintenance, including unused-skill archiving.

  [#186861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186861).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Adds [diagnostics for references delaying a plugin reload](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update.md) in `plugins.inspect`. Look for `runtimeRetention`. [Retention inspection](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update#inspect-retained-references) also shows the run ID and Gateway service for holds created while preparing an agent run.
  [#167456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167456).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).

  [#183885](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183885).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps skill discovery and sync working with the inputs they started with, and avoids restarting agent preparation when a skill changes while it is being read. A turn may use the earlier version, with edits or newly eligible skills picked up on a later scan, sync or turn.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173009) · [#178250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178250). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets eligible plugin-state lookups proceed alongside unrelated Gateway writes and reduces background work on state changes in installations with many sessions.
  [#173534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173534), [#173647](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173647).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a warning when ClawHub cannot clean up a temporary install archive and an install logger is available. The warning preserves the install’s original result.
  [#173523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173523).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports an unwritable managed plugin directory before cloning. Installs from a local Git path now copy the Git objects into independent storage.
  [#173597](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173597).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts database work when you share or unshare skills, change their ownership or availability, remove them, or roll back an edit.
  [#174603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174603).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes the Skill Workshop’s 30-second idle wait best effort. A queued review can start sooner if a new turn finishes while OpenClaw is checking whether the agent is idle. [When a review runs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/self-learning#when-a-review-runs)
  [#174608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174608).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops rescanning unchanged skill folders every minute. With skill watching enabled, OpenClaw watches for edits and runs a safety scan every 30 minutes for changes it misses. On Windows, skill watching picks up edits and avoids the watch handles that could block workspace renames, removals or replacements.
  [Skill watching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills-config)

  [#176905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176905), [#177018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177018).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated data-migration checks during routine plugin preparation when unrelated state changes.
  [#178323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178323).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Makes the plugin install progress popover more compact, with smaller text and status icons and tighter spacing between steps.
  [#178738](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178738).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Shows the workspace files supplied by a Template, including first-run files, and shows fixed-interval schedules and planned owner delivery when you review a Template before adding it. See the [Template CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates).
  [#174984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174984).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

  [#178764](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178764).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds published artwork to Template cards and details in the Agents catalog. Older versions show their own artwork, and the catalog uses the default box icon when artwork is missing or won’t load.
  [#178857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178857), [#4007](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/4007), [#4008](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/4008).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Cuts repeated filesystem checks when reloading plugins whose folders have already been resolved.
  [#179220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179220).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies how private skills work on a single-user Gateway. CLI connections authenticated by token or password share the Gateway’s owner profile and can see that owner’s private skills. [Skills CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/skills)
  [#179138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179138).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the default selection and a Saving indicator as soon as you reset an agent’s Skills settings. It also shows **Off** or **Auto** as soon as you choose a [Skill Workshop learning mode](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skill-workshop#how-the-agent-learns). If a save fails, the previous setting returns; you can retry the reset or see the learning-mode error.
  [#179918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179918), [#180535](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180535).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rounds the hover highlight on the plugin security audit score and adds space around its label and score bars.
  [#180150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180150).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Keeps plugin skill previews open and the loaded file list visible when a selected file is loading, fails to load, or is retried. A reply for a different file leaves the file you’re reading in place. Template previews let you close a slow preview and open another without waiting for the first one to finish.
  [#180480](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180480).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the requested setting as soon as you enable or disable a plugin, and restores the previous setting with an error if the change fails. The consent dialog shows when it is saving, and a plugin stays listed until its removal succeeds.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows requested enabled or sharing settings while personal and team skill changes save, and updates workspace skill toggles immediately. A failed change restores the previous setting, and personal or team changes show the error. Switching views does not let an older save replace a newer draft of the same skill. Personal and team saves and imports stay busy until finished. Workspace controls remain locked through the list refresh after a toggle, API key replacement, dependency install or ClawHub install.
  Personal and team skill changes — Thanks to steipete. [#180566](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180566) · Workspace skill changes — Thanks to steipete. [#180592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180592)
- Keeps the cached skill list and search field visible while the agent’s Skills panel loads, and makes the Agents page filter more responsive for large lists.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

- Shows the problem with the skill itself first when a local or Git install also has an invalid inferred install name. An invalid name supplied with `--as` still comes first. See [skills installation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/skills).

  [#175804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175804).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory and background work when discovering skills from plugins whose skill information OpenClaw already has, and when finding duplicate skill names in folders. Idle discovery workers can also retire under critical memory pressure without losing the current list, and an explicit refresh can pick up edits.

  [#184089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184089), [#184614](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184614).

  See the separate [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/76acafef851a9fdb8f9e45bdb1526a34bec76d73) for idle discovery workers.
- Reduces repeated work when identifying which skill a file read belongs to and searching installed skill files. Searches pick up detected edits and removals, and inline skill text searches use less CPU and temporary memory.

  [#183971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183971), [#184093](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184093), [#184208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184208).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#185396](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185396).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#182802](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182802), [#185006](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185006), [#185217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185217).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds **Sign in** to the ClawHub chat card and plugin page when an installed plugin needs account authorization and you have permission to sign in. The card opens the plugin page to start sign-in. Links to known plugin documentation sections open on the public docs site. Large catalogs scroll and load more results with less work, and multiple ClawHub cards need fewer repeated status checks. Use catalog search to find plugins outside displayed rows, which browser Find can miss. See [Managing plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/manage-plugins).

  [#185247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185247).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

- Fixes failed Template Adds leaving newly added MCP servers behind. OpenClaw can remove an unchanged entry it can verify belongs to the failed Add, including before the workspace is available or after a save commits but reports failure.
  [#185866](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185866).

  Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

  [#185854](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185854).

  Thanks [@Yuaneen](https://github.com/Yuaneen) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Clears stale plugin data and settings upgrade warnings at startup when no migration remains and settings are valid, and stops repeated repair warnings for deferred data upgrades while a plugin is inactive. After you install or enable an affected plugin, Doctor must finish the upgrade or confirm its data is ready before it starts.
  [#186648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186648).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and cryptoninja1stat.

  [#187641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187641).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes update checks rejecting saved experimental Claws settings after the rename to Templates. The repair keeps your preference unless Templates is already set. If you still have the old setting and your deployment only runs `openclaw config validate`, run the candidate version’s `openclaw doctor --fix` before validating.
  [#186730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186730).

  Thanks steipete.
- Fixes native plugin pages reloading and losing their place when you switch views within the same page.
  [#186994](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186994).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Replaces the misleading unknown result on the Control UI Plugins page with a clear message when an OpenClaw upgrade blocks an install before it starts. You can retry after the upgrade finishes.
  [#187110](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187110).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Prevents OpenClaw from loading hooks from the wrong folder when a configured hook path starts or ends with a space. If the configured folder is missing, OpenClaw reports it instead of loading hooks from another folder.
  [#187554](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187554).

  Thanks Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Prevents text from templates and file paths from disrupting the display of human-readable Templates CLI reports. JSON output is unchanged.
  [#187666](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187666).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes missing-file errors when importing affected bundled plugins.
  [#188639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188639), [source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0b084c6aabe75c24c914b7a8f6fec329b83c381f).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport `d949ac4e22`).
- Adds the missing icon and activity artwork for the bundled Liquid AI plugin.
  [#189436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189436).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Gives ClawHub package lookups one more chance to recover from a temporary service error before failing. If the error persists, the extra retry can add a 30-second wait before the final attempt.
  [#190452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190452).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Prevents [marketplace plugin installs and updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/install) from silently choosing the first source when multiple entries have the same name. Remove or rename the duplicates to continue.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fb666f2338801247fde9c1445c50ac02288a439).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes fallback to the built-in context engine when an approved plugin declares a [context engine](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/context-engine#plugin-and-engine-ids) under a different ID. Installation can select its only declared engine, and [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations) can correct an unambiguous old plugin-ID setting. If a plugin declares several engines or drops your selected engine, choose an engine it still provides. A broken link to a local plugin must be corrected before CLI uninstall.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/53fb615aafeba689d6442ac535fd2af3b9ce9b1c).

  Thanks [@pollybot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Prevents a native chat command from running the same continuing plugin command more than once.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes workspace memory and skills imports racing on the first turn when OpenClaw runs from source.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Keeps empty validation-generated plugin settings from widening a restrictive allowlist.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Stops [automatic Skill Workshop reviews](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/self-learning) from repeatedly retrying when your model provider rate-limits requests, and gives active conversations priority. Reviews use a recent conversation excerpt and no longer look through other sources, so they can miss lessons that need more context. Failed or interrupted reviews are discarded rather than replayed.
  [#173889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173889).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes plugins loading incompletely when more than one request loads the same plugin at once.
  [#174060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174060).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes remote workspace skills failing to load on Node source installs when several requests arrive while the skills are first loading.
  [#174252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174252).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes installed plugins disappearing when the Gateway starts from another copy of the same standalone build. If your plugins still point to a missing copy or a different build, run `openclaw doctor --fix` from the selected runtime and restart the Gateway. See the [standalone repair instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  [#174273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174273).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores Cloudflare R2 as a bundled plugin in the default package and stops suggesting a separate install to repair a bundled copy. Standalone builds that leave it out can still offer it as a separate install.
  [#174287](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174287).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Auto Review](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/autoreview) remaining unavailable in sandboxed sessions after its protected personal skill is copied in and the tool is enabled. Personal installs work with the default Gateway state directory; with a custom state directory, use a managed install or skill library. Auto Review and other installed helpers are withheld from sandboxes that can write to their installation. If affected, move the installation to a host-only or read-only location.
  [#174403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174403), [#174467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174467).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Skill Workshop silently leaving skills out of the list when an existing skill file is too large or cannot be read safely. The list reports the read error instead.
  [#174520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174520).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes paired-node agents failing to find or read skills whose instructions were already delivered. It also extends remote-exec skill discovery to eligible skills left out of the prompt, within the [skill delivery limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills).
  [#175906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175906).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Fixes unexpected errors being hidden when OpenClaw looks for bundled plugins. Normal fallback still applies when a plugin directory is missing or unreadable.
  [#176004](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176004).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Frees memory left behind after plugin recovery cleanup without stopping the running plugin. Keeps native cleanup errors visible if a later cleanup attempt would otherwise report success.
  [#176034](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176034).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes OpenClaw overlooking installed plugins that declare a transcript source when looking up which plugin provides it.
  [#176467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176467).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes stale status dots and Ready, Needs Setup and Disabled counts after you enable or disable a skill in Settings → Skills. The page updates without a manual refresh, even when the change comes from another client.
  [#186760](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186760).

  Thanks [@jondihaynes](https://github.com/jondihaynes), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).




##### Developer tools and APIs


- Fixes ACP turns that could look like empty successes when the Gateway sent a failure explanation. ACP clients receive that explanation during the turn and when replaying the session. Partial replies that hit the output limit keep their text and are reported as cut short. [ACP CLI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/acp.md)
  [#178032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178032).

  [#178057](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178057).

  Thanks [@huyengiang101086-spec](https://github.com/huyengiang101086-spec) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@YiWang24](https://github.com/YiWang24) for the report.
- Returns a retryable 503 instead of a generic 500 when a Gateway HTTP request reaches an agent whose database is still starting. Clients should retry after the indicated delay.
  [#175133](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175133).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY` error detail so Gateway clients can distinguish a blocked write to externally managed settings directly. Nix mode keeps its own guidance.
  [Gateway configuration RPCs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-talk-config-and-agents#secrets-config-update-and-wizard).

  [#185299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185299).

  Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Stops `openclaw infer model run --file` from silently discarding images when you run it locally with a text-only model. Use an image-capable model, run `openclaw infer image describe`, or add `--gateway` to have the image described for the text-only model.
  [Inference CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/infer)

  [#176921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176921).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw infer embedding create` silently requesting the wrong model when `--provider` and the provider in `--model` disagree. The command now tells you which providers conflict. If the model ID itself contains a slash, include its provider prefix.
  [Inference CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/infer)

  [#176959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176959).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [MCP connection checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/json-output) reporting success when OpenClaw cannot confirm that the local connection closed. `mcp probe` exits with an error, `mcp doctor --probe` flags the failure, and `mcp add` and `mcp configure --probe` do not save settings after failed local cleanup. A Streamable HTTP server that does not confirm its session ended only triggers a warning if the local connection closed. If local cleanup fails, rerun the command and restart the process owning the connection if it still fails.
  [#173830](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173830), [cleanup policy](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/791621be9e050bb12ad221d74905cee7e11bfd71).

  Thanks [@montrellcruse](https://github.com/montrellcruse).

  See the [MCP CLI cleanup guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/json-output).

  [#182584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182584).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Enforces the existing limit of four simultaneous resource requests on the same MCP form. New requests can proceed once a slot frees up.
  [#178017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178017).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a repeated SDK connection close reporting success after the original close failed.
  [#177606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177606).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes late resource errors being reported as cleanup failures before OpenClaw knows whether cleanup succeeded. OpenClaw still reports the original error separately.
  [#177526](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177526).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents untrusted names, paths and other text from changing terminal formatting in session and node reports, `status --all`, marketplace plugin listings, [Policy CLI reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/policy/running-checks), and affected plugin, secrets, memory, wiki, Workboard, backup, pairing, path, configuration and setup reports. JSON output in session and node reports and JSON and raw exports in the affected CLI reports retain their original values. If a session ID looks different in a terminal report, its suggested memory cleanup command may require the original ID.
  [#176638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176638).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  See the [Status report](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status).

  [#178248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178248).

- Corrects the [system CLI reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/system) to explain valid session targets and how to address a configured agent’s session. ##### GitHub lookups in chat


Read GitHub items and continue, review or publish work from supported conversations. Finish any pending managed sandbox base refresh and conflict resolution before downgrading. Review screenshots and recordings before uploading them to GitHub.

With the [GitHub tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github), permitted agents can find issues or pull requests in a named public repository, read public issue, pull request or commit links, and inspect the end of a completed public Actions job log. Sandboxed agents can use the tools through the Gateway without GitHub credentials or outbound GitHub access inside the sandbox. Results can be incomplete or truncated.

With [GitHub Enterprise previews](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github#session-bound-enterprise-previews) configured, you can open issue, pull request and commit links from the current session’s authorized repository in the Control UI, including private repositories. A configured [GitHub App](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) can provide short-lived, repository-scoped credentials for authorized foreground reads, with access checked for the signed-in operator.

With [GitHub inspection](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/config-tools/github-identity.md) enabled, paste a link to a pull request you opened and ask your agent to check its status and which branches and commits it compares. This includes pull requests created outside OpenClaw, from a session you can access. Inspection is read-only on the configured GitHub host and uses your verified linked author account’s access to private repositories. Links from Files changed, Commits and Checks work too.
Read public links and search public issues and pull requests. See the [GitHub plugin guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/github.md) for access and search details.

You can also read completed public Actions job logs. Long logs return up to 64 KiB from the end and mark earlier output as omitted. The selected identity needs Actions read access and the log must be available.

##### GitHub pull requests in chat


Continue work on your own open or draft GitHub pull request in a Team conversation or an ordinary sandboxed chat. OpenClaw prepares an editable workspace. In a Team conversation, you can see the original PR and its checks, and eligible guests can publish back to it when shared publishing is configured. Prepare the PR again to bring in new commits while keeping your local work. [GitHub identity and shared publishing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity)

In an ordinary sandboxed chat, earlier file links continue to open the original files read-only. Reopen a file from the new workspace before saving it.
Team PR preparation, actions, refresh, status and shared publication. [GitHub identity and shared publishing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity)

##### GitHub pull request actions


Ask your agent to edit the title or description of a pull request shared from your session without publishing code. If you opened a managed PR, you can request another ClawSweeper review and upload screenshots or recordings from an eligible sandbox workspace. Review files before uploading them to GitHub. Eligible guests can edit their own session PR and mark their own existing draft ready for review without merging it. With full operator write access, you can inspect, close or merge a session-published PR. GitHub permissions, reviews and checks govern merges. [GitHub publishing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity)

After a later publication fails, authorized users can edit, inspect or mark ready the last successfully published PR. Inspect the PR again if its head or publication changes.
Inspect, mark ready, merge or close a session-published PR. [GitHub identity and session publication](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/config-tools/github-identity.md)

##### GitHub publication from local chats


In a local chat that hasn’t been tied to a workspace, you can ask your agent to publish committed work from a local checkout to GitHub. Commit any pending changes first. OpenClaw works from a separate worktree, leaves your original checkout intact and brings the result back to the same conversation. [GitHub publication guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model)
Adds publication from a local checkout through an authorized handoff. Queued follow-up messages wait while OpenClaw prepares the worktree.

[#184531](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184531).

Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).




##### Sandbox Auto Review


Auto Review can inspect staged, unstaged and untracked Git changes in the sandbox where your agent is working. A restricted reviewer runs on the host, where provider credentials stay, and returns a validated report or a size error. See the [Auto Review guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/autoreview) for setup.
Sandbox Git review, setup and full report delivery.

[#173455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173455).

Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).




##### Optional GitHub PR attribution


You can add a “Made with OpenClaw” footer to new GitHub pull requests. The setting starts off. Turn on **Add OpenClaw attribution to pull requests** under **Settings → Profile → Identity**, and skip the footer for individual PRs when you like. OpenClaw applies the footer when creating PRs for you, and agent-created PRs through the GitHub CLI or shell use it on a best-effort basis. Incognito conversations skip automatic attribution. See the [attribution guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model#optional-openclaw-pull-request-attribution).
Adds a default-off footer preference for new GitHub pull requests.

[#176647](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176647).

Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Git co-author credit


Verified GitHub Enterprise participants can receive co-author credit on eligible shared-session commits published to the configured host. Credit is on by default for verified accounts and can be changed in **Settings → Profile**. When credit applies, the verified email is visible in Git history. [GitHub credit and profile settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model#gateway-profile-and-github-credit)

For channel requests routed through shared main chat, delegated work credits the verified requester when they have enabled Git credit. Publishing directly from main does not add automatic human credit. A different person’s request to steer waits for its own turn rather than using the permissions of work already underway.
- GitHub Enterprise co-author credit. [GitHub credit and profile settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model#gateway-profile-and-github-credit) · [#173513](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173513) · [Issue #173512](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173512)
- Credit for delegated channel requests. [Git co-author credit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model) · [#176513](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176513) · [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

  [#182033](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182033).

  [#182033](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182033).

  [#183788](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183788).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#184051](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184051).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Loads the pull request Checks and Monitoring panels only when they’re first shown in desktop or mobile chat. The check summary stays available before the panels load, and reopening a panel keeps expanded jobs and automation changes still being saved.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory churn when the Control UI calculates pull request branch statistics for repositories with many untracked files.
  [#184520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184520).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeat downloads for unchanged results in the Control UI’s GitHub views, including session pull requests, searches, checks and Actions widgets. When GitHub confirms an authenticated response hasn’t changed, that check doesn’t count against its primary REST rate limit.

  [#185019](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185019).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [#185783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185783).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces delays when recovering pending GitHub publications after a Gateway restart. A slow GitHub response for one worktree no longer holds up recovery in other worktrees being recovered alongside it. Requests within the same worktree still recover in order. [GitHub publishing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model)
  [#185853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185853).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a [read-only GitHub readiness check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model#inspect-publication-readiness) for authorized agents and clients to inspect a session’s source, supported target and an existing shared publication request. If a receipt is unavailable, keep the original request ID and check it rather than submitting again. The check does not verify permission to publish or whether a PR is ready to merge.
  [#187152](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187152).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Changes new managed pull requests, including those from eligible guests, to open ready for review by default instead of as drafts. If you’re not ready for review, ask your agent to publish a draft. OpenClaw keeps that choice if publishing is delayed or resumes after a restart. Updating an existing pull request leaves its review state alone, and requests already accepted under the old default still create drafts if they need to create a PR. Operators rolling upgraded shared state back to a build that cannot read it must restore a verified pre-upgrade backup and use its matching older build.
  [#176105](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176105).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Lets the person who started a conversation use [`prepare_pr`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) to update its bot-published pull request after someone else pushes to it. Resolve any conflicts and publish again without losing saved work.

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Omits instructions to add the OpenClaw footer to new pull requests when PR attribution is off or the conversation is Incognito. When attribution is on, those instructions apply only to the verified requester’s current request, not to later requests or other people in the conversation.

  Thanks [@lastguru-net](https://github.com/lastguru-net), [@beru-ant-king](https://github.com/beru-ant-king).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

Later pushes, description edits and reopens do not start another review. If you need another hosted review, update the branch, PR description and evidence, then comment `@clawsweeper re-review`.

##### Meetings


<a id="meeting-state-rollback"></a>

- Fixes meeting transcripts changing order when the reader’s timezone changes. If the meeting used as a paging cursor has been deleted, restart paging.
  Existing start times without a timezone use the migration timezone; new ones use the writer’s timezone. To roll back across the schema 23 migration to an incompatible version, restore the matching pre-upgrade backup and use the older binary.

  [#172755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172755).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes live meeting summaries being blocked by a temporary read error. The next scheduled update can retry the read.
  [#177635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177635).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes meeting summaries falling back to basic notes when the system clock jumps forward, even when the model is available. A clock change in either direction no longer alters the model’s time to summarize.
  [#185146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185146).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### Workboard


Workboard loads large boards in pages and fixes several cases where cards or linked sessions could get stuck or show stale results.

- Loads [Workboard](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) cards and sessions in pages of up to 100. Boards and dashboard widgets show how much has loaded and offer **Load more cards** or **Load more sessions** where applicable. Card search and filters cover loaded cards, dependencies outside that set are marked **Not loaded**, and reordering waits until all cards are loaded. The Sessions agent filter also covers loaded rows, while the people filter applies across the board. Refresh if live movement causes entries to be skipped or repeated. Workboard CLI listings and session controls follow pages for you. Custom Gateway clients must pass `nextCursor` as `after` to retrieve the rest; a Sessions move returns only the first page.
  [#175349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175349).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces browser work on large Workboards when opening boards, sizing labels, using menus and status popovers, selecting and dragging linked cards, loading columns, and applying live card updates. Keyboard navigation, card details and reordering remain available.
  [#183763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183763), [#183922](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183922), [#183999](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183999), [#184721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184721).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the CPU work Workboard does to display card dates and durations, including when you clear a search on a large board. If your system time zone changes while Workboard is open, reload the page to refresh the card timestamps.
  [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard)

  [#184286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184286).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when saving [Workboard cards](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) with long histories or lots of related data, and when successful saves check for duplicate cards or newer revisions.
  [#174174](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174174), [#183038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183038).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated work when several tabs refresh Workboard board and card lists, while keeping committed edits visible on the next refresh.
  [#179090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179090).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard).
- Removes an extra SQLite lookup when moving a session on the Workboard Sessions board, while still rejecting moves based on outdated placement.
  [#182943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182943).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets Board widgets load while an already-open SQLite session is only saving ordinary transcript entries, such as messages and tool results.
  [#173763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173763).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less CPU and memory when loading session dashboards with widgets, and cuts extra work when switching Board tabs or updating native report widgets on large dashboards.
  [#184391](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184391), [#184570](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184570).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts CPU and memory overhead when preparing Workboard tools for each agent turn.
  [#186394](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186394).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Workboard](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) cards staying out of date after a missed completion when their linked conversation is beyond the session search limit. Recovery checks the linked conversation directly when the card identifies it, stops checking cards with no updates pending, and reduces session scans during card updates. Workboard also avoids marking a launch as failed when session lookup is incomplete or cannot identify which session belongs to the card.
  [#173740](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173740), [#173793](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173793).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Workboard workers in newly created sessions finishing without updating their cards or notifying eligible linked automations. Restores cleanup of clean managed worktrees while keeping worktrees with local changes. [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard)
  [#179255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179255).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Workboard dispatch using up a card’s retries when its worker session is already archived. The refusal names the session so you can restore it to continue or run `openclaw sessions delete <worker key>` to start fresh on the next dispatch.
  [Report #176889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176889) · [Workboard CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/workboard)

  [#176939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176939).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@mightyx](https://github.com/mightyx).
- Keeps a requeued Workboard card ready for another run even if its old worker finishes late. The old worker can no longer move the card to Review or erase the previous failure.
  [Issue #174899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174899)

  [#174979](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174979).

  Thanks [@chelsealong](https://github.com/chelsealong), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RyanTJoy](https://github.com/RyanTJoy).
- Fixes ready Workboard cards getting stuck, even on other boards, when a completed card for the same owner still shows an old run as active.
  [#187880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187880).

  Thanks [@atomicdjt](https://github.com/atomicdjt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@alfredjbclaw](https://github.com/alfredjbclaw).
- Fixes Workboard dispatch and card updates failing because an existing comment exceeds the current limit, while preserving its full text. New and edited comments still have a 2,000-character limit.
  [Workboard comments](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/workboard.md)

  [#154958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154958).

  Thanks [@gokay-ai](https://github.com/gokay-ai) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Workboard from silently dropping unsupported card metadata. When an integration creates a card, captures a session as a card or updates a card, Workboard names the unsupported keys and rejects the request without changing any cards. If your integration sends those keys, remove them before retrying. See the [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) for supported metadata.
  [#187098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187098).

  Thanks [@yy19971996](https://github.com/yy19971996), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@SquareXRay](https://github.com/SquareXRay).
- Fixes Workboard search missing cards even when the accented word you typed matches a word in a card’s title, labels or notes.
  [#187322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187322).

  Thanks SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Fixes the Workboard session summary showing the old error when you retry loading progress. The summary shows that the retry is underway without hiding recent messages that already loaded.
  [#180528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180528).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes collapsed Workboard list groups failing to reopen on a second click. Keyboard focus returns to Workboard’s search button or open search field when the board takes focus. Workboard pages and dashboard widgets receive updates as board data loads or changes.
  [#182293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182293).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores the bottom fade that shows there are more cards below when a live update makes a Workboard column scrollable or a compact board widget loads another page.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Board reads and writes from blocking the Gateway while looking up a custom session store.

#### Security and Privacy

Manage guest access, approvals and deployment controls. Update older native apps that still read client identities and credentials from the shared Gateway database. Review remembered native runtime permissions carefully because eligible chats use Full access with the optional sandbox off.




##### Guest welcome conversations


Invited guests using [Visitor Access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/reference/visitor-access) can land in a welcome conversation when they open Home, once per browser. It brings together their access expiry, available agents, any invitation note and guidance for getting started. A link to a specific conversation still opens that conversation.

Renewing an active invitation keeps the welcome conversation or unfinished setup and its note unless the note is replaced. Ending access leaves existing chats and transcripts in place, while a completed welcome conversation that is deleted stays deleted.
Setup progress appears beside the chat box with a retry option. A new invitation after expiry or revocation starts a fresh conversation. Staff can check whether a welcome is pending, ready or failed in [visitor_list](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/extensions/visitor-access/README.md). When a recorded inviter can read the conversation, the welcome mention reaches their Inbox and **Involving me**.

Guests start on **Involving me** when they have no saved sidebar filter. See the [sessions and sidebar guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).

[#182337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182337), [#182352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182352), [#182044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182044), [#182045](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182045), [#182040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182040), [#182528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182528).

Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).




##### Accounts, credentials and approvals


- Moves client identities, pairing tokens and local socket credentials out of the shared Gateway database while keeping existing credentials. Update older native apps that still read them from that database. A client issued new credentials between an upgrade and automatic rollback needs to pair again. If you are moving a legacy native credential database to PostgreSQL, start the Gateway on SQLite and run `openclaw doctor --fix` before porting. See [credential migration and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning#local-client-credentials).
  [#174599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174599).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
