  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes the default execution permission easier to spot and shows when Full Access is active or requires an administrator to select. The picker shows which choice is saving and lets you close it during the save. Number shortcuts work with the new layout, and approval shortcut hints are easier to read.
  [#184777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184777).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds the existing SubQ API key setting to the [SecretRef credential reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/secretref-user-supplied-credentials-matrix.json).
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8ff48313fcb39d8c377ae3b1f5c944879acf833).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an Approval scopes column to `openclaw nodes pending` and the pending section of `openclaw nodes list`, so you can see which permissions you need before approving a node. See the [node pairing commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/nodes).
  [#178455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178455).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new approval cards using old links or forwarding accounts after configuration reload. Approvals already in progress keep their original delivery settings.
  [#138553](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138553).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents malformed UTF-8 approval imports from corrupting and replacing the saved allowlist. [Approvals CLI reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/approvals.md)
  [#167273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167273).

  Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes local Pi, Codex and opted-in container commands using the wrong GitHub account or host. With a managed GitHub identity selected, Codex uses OpenClaw’s execution tools and disables native shell and Code Mode. If the selected profile is unavailable, reconnect or select another identity before retrying. Agents that borrow tool policy use their own selected identity. Paired nodes use their own GitHub sign-in.
  [#171168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171168), [#171218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171218).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes GitHub commands losing authentication during long repository-bound cloud-worker turns. Later commands can use the renewed credential while the turn remains authorized. Commands already running keep the credential they started with. Older workers may need a rebuild and retry.
  [#171212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171212).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes pairing QR images disappearing from Control UI chat when history refreshes. Run [`/pair qr`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/pairing) again after a reload, reconnect or authentication change.
  [#172806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172806).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ixxyjixxy](https://github.com/Ixxyjixxy).
- Requests native permissions when enabling an [installed ACP agent](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/acp-agents-setup) in Models. Consented chats start with **Full access** and optional sandboxing off. The native app controls its own permissions.
  [#172815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172815).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes cooldown replies revealing the operator’s saved-login label to conversation participants. Affected replies give generic retry guidance.
  [#173255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173255).

  Thanks [@pgondhi987](https://github.com/pgondhi987).
- Fixes quoted OAuth callback URLs and URLs with escaped ampersands being rejected before node execution approval on `sh`. Quote the full callback URL so it reaches the usual approval checks.
  Thanks to [@fionn77](https://github.com/fionn77), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt). [#173273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173273) · [#173240](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173240) · [Node execution guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/node-exec.md)
- Fixes pairing allowlist checks hanging when the state database is replaced while the check is waiting. The check reports that the database changed.
  [#175628](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175628).

  Thanks steipete.
- Prevents new native Codex work from using a session’s old permissions after access is revoked or its parent session changes. This includes starting or resuming threads, sending turns and opening `/btw` side questions. [Codex runtime guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness/runtime-behavior)
  [#176352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176352).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat showing an old approval again when it is no longer pending for that conversation.
  [#176367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176367).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Helps prevent an unrecognized session owner from cutting short work the agent already has permission to do in a prepared workspace. Owner-authorized agents can look up registered profiles. If an assignment fails because the owner is unknown, select a registered person or use **Assign to me**.
  [#176401](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176401).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an approval button left on screen from acting on the previous item after you switch approvals. Avoids loading intermediate items when the approval or question changes in quick succession.
  [#176634](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176634).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Blocks new input from OpenClaw’s built-in Mac automation while an OpenClaw approval is waiting for you. Its screen snapshots leave out OpenClaw during the prompt or are skipped if the app can’t be hidden. Adds Escape to cancel the fallback command approval prompt. The safeguards cover OpenClaw’s own prompts, and some input already in progress can continue. Keep unrestricted computer use off for untrusted models when command approvals are set to ask.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and contributor [@mtbba8-afk](https://github.com/mtbba8-afk). [#176751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176751) · [Mac computer use](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/computer-use.md) · [Command approvals](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/exec-approvals.md)
- Prevents an installed Gateway or node service from inheriting temporary secret-egress proxy trust. On an affected managed Gateway, run `openclaw doctor --fix` to repair the service and preserve your own certificate settings. Doctor can bring the service back up if it was running before the repair.
  [Report #176479](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176479) · [Secret store and egress](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/secrets/secret-store-and-egress)

  [#177007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177007).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) and [@hehuang139](https://github.com/hehuang139).
- Prevents Gateway disconnects and interruptions to accepted work when an identity permission edit leaves effective access unchanged. Role changes also leave unaffected work running. Revocations stop affected work, while widening or restoring a role does not give existing work more access or restart revoked work. [Gateway configuration reloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload)
  For role reloads, see the [Role reload commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b0777e11ffb6e2bcaa468654a4518e8cb6abff57).

  [#177254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177254).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the identity permission reloads.
- Fixes trusted-proxy read-only limits that could deny read access to operators whose write permission already included it, including on automatically approved devices. Read-only limits admit only read access, and Gateway audit logs reflect the identity permissions actually granted. [Trusted-proxy authentication](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/trusted-proxy-auth)
  [#177254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177254).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor asking you to sign in to Claude CLI again when it couldn’t tell whether you were signed in. It reports that it couldn’t check and suggests `claude auth status --json` instead.
  [#177283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177283).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents repeated or conflicting clicks from sending another device or node pairing decision while the first is pending. Screen readers now hear the device name on each pending device’s Approve and Reject buttons.
  [Issue #127580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127580).

  [#177571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177571).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes silent cancellations when a pending secret-input prompt can’t be delivered. The warning identifies failed delivery and keeps the prompt and private error details out of the log.
  [#177688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177688).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Mac app failing to read or save command approval rules when OpenClaw uses PostgreSQL, so native commands use the policy you configured. On PostgreSQL and SQLite, the app rejects saves based on outdated rules and checks current permissions when authorizing a command. The final check blocks commands whose permission was revoked and allows commands that current rules still permit. Use a compatible Mac app and CLI with access to the configured database. [Native command approvals](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec-approvals)
  [#177795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177795).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes client credential migration failing after restoring a newly created backup of older execution-approval settings. The backup preserves the approval policy and leaves out the socket token.
  [#177848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177848).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes migrations and rebuilds of large client credential stores failing with a SQLite size error. Fixes the Gateway rejecting intact client credentials at startup after a verified Btrfs database repair, so existing clients can reconnect without pairing again. If an older build stopped with `too many SQL variables`, install the fixed build and rerun `openclaw doctor --fix`. [Database versioning guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning)
  [#177925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177925).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Checks current session access before committing fresh input and keeps tool effects, child tasks and replies tied to the session that authorized them.
  [#177939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177939).

  Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes recorded approvals being reported as expired when later delivery fails. When a command cannot run, the result distinguishes a decline, timeout, missing approval or other failure where the reason is known. [Exec guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec)
  [#177940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177940).

  Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) (co-author).
- Fixes 502 errors in protected commands when the destination is only reachable through the Gateway’s proxy. Protected requests follow the Gateway’s proxy settings and exclusions. Restart the Gateway if you change those settings. [Secret egress proxy settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/secrets/secret-store-and-egress.md)
  [#170145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170145).

  [#178080](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178080).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@mogol](https://github.com/mogol) for the report.
- Stops the standalone approval page from piling up duplicate checks when you switch back to its tab while it’s still waiting. Retry can use the check already in progress and still shows that it’s working.
  [issue #127579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127579).

  [#178217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178217).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the report.
- Prevents safely retryable OAuth refresh failures from forcing another sign-in. This includes temporary failures for managed Google Meet, Vertex authorized-user ADC and delegated Microsoft Teams accounts, and readable rate-limit or server-error responses from xAI unless the provider explicitly rejects the sign-in. Calls already waiting for the same refresh share its failure. If OpenClaw can’t confirm whether a one-time refresh credential was used, reconnect the affected account when prompted. [OAuth recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/auth-credential-semantics#recovering-an-interrupted-rotating-refresh)
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646).

  Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes MCP sign-in appearing to succeed with credentials it can no longer use. It opens a fresh sign-in when an earlier refresh left the credential unusable and reports failures from the current sign-in.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646).

  Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps completed refreshes for GitHub, X and Twitch from leaving OpenClaw without the updated sign-in. Vertex leaves externally managed ADC credentials under their existing owner.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646).

  Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps provider response bodies out of Anthropic OAuth refresh errors.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646).

  Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents Claude CLI from automatically replaying saved conversations under the wrong sign-in when OpenClaw detects that readable local administrator settings switch Claude Code away from your native login. The check covers local policy files when you opt in to native-login history recovery. [History account boundaries](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#history-account-boundaries)
  [#178929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178929).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Mac app, Gateway and nodes getting stuck after an update because client credentials or approvals still needed migration. Supported upgrades prepare them automatically and keep existing device identities, pairing tokens and approvals, including credentials for profiles that were offline during the update.
  [#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).

  [Mac app and bundled Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/mac/bundled-gateway) · [Node startup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)
- Fixes startup refusing a database after a remount when OpenClaw can verify it is still the same database. Missing or conflicting credentials and a different database generation require explicit recovery.
  [#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).

  [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running)
- Fixes two controls that could respond to an earlier screen state after an update. **Refresh** during login recovery and **Open session** on approval cards use the current action. **Close** and cancel also act on the current loading dialog.
  [#179069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179069).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a paired Mac also appearing under **Connected without pairing** in **Settings → Devices**. An old duplicate can remain until it expires, normally after five minutes.
  [#179067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179067).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@edosulai](https://github.com/edosulai).

  [Device presence guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/presence)
- Fixes unnecessary pairing prompts when the CLI or a connection check uses the Mac app’s already-approved identity and the device family still matches.
  [#179081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179081).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@josephbergvinson](https://github.com/josephbergvinson), [@ProActive2023](https://github.com/ProActive2023), [@dprev](https://github.com/dprev).

  [Pairing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/pairing#metadata-upgrade-auto-approval)
- Fixes Doctor mislabeling unchanged environment-backed credentials as plaintext when previewing or repairing configuration. Doctor also warns about literal credentials that were being missed, including escaped environment placeholders. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  [#171022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171022)

  [#179896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179896), [#171039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171039).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii), and [@exgeni](https://github.com/exGeni) for the related report.
- Fixes read-only and session-only members being blocked from changing their own display name, avatar or Git co-author credit preference in Settings → Profile. Session-only members can see their own avatar, with access tied to the currently signed-in identity.
  [#179924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179924).

  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes MCP sign-in messages that pointed you to a terminal command that couldn’t work. Use Settings for servers you configured, **Connect** on the plugin’s Settings page for servers it supplies, or the channel’s connect flow for an account connected there. If you use terminal sign-in for a server you configured, stop the Gateway first and restart it when you’re done. [MCP sign-in and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/control-ui)
  [#180222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180222).

  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Disables the relevant pairing, cleanup, removal and token controls while a Devices action is running, and keeps expanded details open during the refresh. Leaving the page or reconnecting clears the old progress display without canceling the action or hiding a one-time replacement token that OpenClaw receives.
  [#180346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180346).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clears the old save indicator for device bindings and execution approvals when the page, target or Gateway changes. A rejected execution approval save shows the error and keeps your edits available.
  [#180375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180375).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Reload leaving the old device pairing error on screen without showing that a new check is running. The dialog shows progress and blocks repeat pairing actions while it checks. Closing and reopening it does not leave the new dialog waiting on the old check.
  [#180560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180560).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor sending local-only installations to channel setup for administrator access. If you need local admin access, run `openclaw dashboard` on the Gateway host, or choose **Inbox → System → Limited access → Request admin** in a limited-access browser and approve the request on the host. [Control UI connection and pairing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/connect-and-pair)
  Thanks to steipete and issue reporter pawelbbdrozd. [#180598](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180598) · [Issue #180530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180530)
- Fixes agents getting a generic error when a secure credential request can’t open from chat because the Control UI is disabled or its public address isn’t configured. Your agent gets the same guidance you do on retrying in a trusted Control UI or native app, or asking an operator to configure the address. [Secure credential requests](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/secrets)
  [#180663](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180663).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the plugin credential editor showing the old discard error while you retry Cancel. If a credential check fails after saving, a successful Retry clears the error without saving the credential again.
  [#180804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180804).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL Gateways exiting during startup when the agent that supplies shared credentials is still preparing. Agents that have finished preparing can start with their own credentials, and inherited credentials become available automatically once their owner is ready.
  [#181198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181198).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert).

  Reported by [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) ([#180631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180631)).
- Restores a recovery path when a Gateway host loses its local credentials but still has its PostgreSQL state. If a matching backup is unavailable, run [`openclaw doctor --fix`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) and confirm the repair. Clients on that host must pair again, while already-paired remote devices that kept their credentials can reconnect.
  [#181201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181201).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert).
- Fixes cloud-worker shell commands failing to get automatic review or a one-time human approval from the Gateway under the configured exec policy. Update the Gateway and installed worker bundles together. [Cloud-worker security model](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/security-model)
  earlier transport draft, [#178560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178560).

  [#182356](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182356), [#167183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167183).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author), [@ferrine](https://github.com/ferrine) (earlier transport work), and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) (reporter).
- Stores environment-backed provider credentials from Linux Gateway auth profiles in an owner-only systemd environment file. Reinstall an affected Gateway service to move its credentials out of the unit and scrub the unit backup. Reinstall can preserve credentials already installed even if your shell no longer exports them.
  [#95895](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95895).

  [#182413](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182413).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author), [@615Works](https://github.com/615Works) (reporter), and [@mattgodbolt-molty](https://github.com/mattgodbolt-molty) (corroborating reporter).
- Removes misleading limited-access Inbox warnings for intentionally restricted guests and keeps access guidance in **Settings → Profile → Your access**, even after dismissal. Hides **Request admin** when your role cannot grant it. If you need more access, ask a Gateway administrator to change your role, then reconnect and request separate approval for this browser.
  [#183018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183018).

  Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13).

  [Connect and pair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/connect-and-pair) · Related guest access work

  [#185005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185005).
- Fixes [`openclaw security audit`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/security/audit-checks) overlooking effective host command access. The audit flags full access with approvals turned off and reports a critical finding when an open channel can reach an agent with full host command access.
  Thanks [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), with [@nik-greek](https://github.com/nik-greek) reporting the issue. [#183559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183559) · [#183541](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183541)
- Fixes model setup, provider sign-in, runtime setup, and hosted onboarding hitting a permission error after they start. Model setup and hosted onboarding can finish after reconnecting where the flow supports it. Removing or reducing the starting device’s access stops an activation that hasn’t been saved. Browser-based provider and MCP sign-in still stop on disconnect.
  The merge commit credits the original report.

  [#183777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183777).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and thanks [@Sedrak-Hovhannisyan](https://github.com/Sedrak-Hovhannisyan) for the original report.
- Fixes native Claude Code tools being denied without an approval prompt under `on-miss` or `always` when an approval route is available. A failed approval request leaves the tool blocked, and the Gateway logs errors other than aborts.
  [Native tool approvals](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends).

  [#183984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183984).

  Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).

##### Remembered native runtime permissions


Administrators can remember permission for a native runtime on a specific agent, so supported new chats using that agent and runtime can start without asking again. Chats using remembered permission run with **Full access** and OpenClaw’s optional sandbox off. Mandatory sandbox and workspace policies still apply.

Remove the runtime from **Remembered native runtime permissions** in the agent’s settings to revoke remembered approval for later use. Approval given to an individual chat is managed separately. See the [agent configuration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents/entries-and-multi-agent).
[#172607](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172607).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

OpenClaw uses the chat’s agent when recovering consent. See [Native runtime and sandbox settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/sandboxing/modes-scope-and-backend.md#L59-L65).

[#172719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172719).

Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and co-author Ayaan Zaidi.




##### Gateway tool and automation policy


Gateway operators can set a [deployment-wide allowlist](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/tool-policy#toolsgatewaypolicy) for model-directed tools and actions, including plugin tools and work started by an administrator. Tool Search, Code Mode and dedicated workers follow the same limit. It also limits the Gateway tools offered to [Codex](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-reference/dynamic-tools) and enforces those limits when called. A restored conversation may still list an older tool, but the policy can deny its use.

GitHub publishing can be allowed as the explicit `publish` action, and an eligible child session can publish from its own workspace even when its parent cannot. Separate [automation controls](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/tool-policy) can limit agents to jobs owned by their caller and restrict agent management of command jobs and watchers. Direct human administration, Codex-native tools and subagents, and local harness programs remain outside the tool allowlist. Restart or replace the Gateway after affected work finishes to apply policy changes.
Codex Gateway tool policy enforcement includes a [catalog adaptation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba2c7cec93c578913bff4e13c7f38a753f65d3a2). The optional automation controls are a separate change.

[#174547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174547), [#174565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174565), [#174580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174580).

Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).




##### Gateway host-execution controls


Gateway operators can independently turn off terminals on the Gateway host and automations that execute there. Blocked jobs remain visible so you can disable or remove them. Authorized node terminals, sandbox-backed streams and scheduled agent turns remain available under their own policies.

Set `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_GATEWAY_LOCAL_TERMINALS=1` or `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_CRON_HOST_EXECUTION=1` in the Gateway launch environment and restart it. Both restrictions are off by default. The automation restriction covers saved jobs and manual runs. [Terminal settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/control-ui/panels.md) · [Automation settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/automation/cron-jobs/managing-jobs.md)
[#177855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177855).

Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).




##### OpenShell workers


Run work in supported cloud and OpenShell workers, grant team members access to selected cloud profiles and recover worker commits when a safe fast-forward is possible.

Run an agent in a dedicated [OpenShell sandbox](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/openshell-workers.md) with brokered model access, and give it a private directory for documents shared across its sessions. A required worker profile applies to all Gateway sessions. Turns are blocked while the worker is unavailable, and bound documents are available while its node is connected.
Setup requires OpenShell 0.1.3 or newer, a qualified Linux environment, matching Gateway and node builds, and a prepared provider policy and image. Worker mode initially supports one configured model through OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages. Exiting the foreground worker command stops the dedicated sandbox.

[#168458](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168458).

Thanks [@sallyom](https://github.com/sallyom).




##### Cloud worker access for teams


Teams using cloud workers can let operators send sessions they created to specific cloud profiles without administrator access. Administrators grant profiles to a role, and operators with write access can choose a granted profile in New Session or eligible session placement controls. Profile setup, setup scripts and moves to the cloud still require an administrator. See [cloud worker dispatch](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/dispatching-a-session).
Role-based cloud profile dispatch

[#186560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186560).

Thanks galiniliev.

#### Other QOL Improvements

These improvements cover delegated work, terminal status and finding support across apps.




##### Blind subagent evaluations


You can run blind evaluations with hidden native subagents in an isolated context. Set `blind: true` to omit model and session identities and the workspace path from prompts OpenClaw writes, including later turns and prompts for hidden native descendants. Tools and external harness instructions can still reveal those details. [Subagent tool reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md)
[#182272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182272).

Thanks <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>.




##### Help and documentation


- Adds [official OpenClaw support](https://community.openclaw.ai/) links in the Control UI, Android, iOS and Mac apps, and CLI help and status. Use **Get support** on the Mac update-recovery screen. Agent guidance, the GitHub issue chooser and the [help guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/support) point to the same place.
  [#178816](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178816).

  Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Adds an official support link to installer help and handled errors on macOS, Linux and Windows, and to completion messages from the shell and rootless CLI installers. See the [installer guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer).
  [#178855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178855).

  Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Makes the [docs release index](https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases) easier to scan with consistent cards and short summaries before you open a release.

  [#184421](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184421).

  Thanks [@wyf027](https://github.com/wyf027).

  [#179009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179009), [#183785](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183785), [#187858](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187858).

##### Configuration and settings

  [#175692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175692).

##### Agents, tools and delegated work


- Adds Goal controls to existing idle Codex cloud-worker sessions with remote execution. Automatic Goal turns count once when they finish, including the turn that completes the Goal; starting or resuming it yourself does not add to that count. Custom tool policies still apply. See the [Goal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/goal) and [sandbox allowlist](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing).
  [#175918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175918).

  Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Adds a mobile Goal details view for the full objective, elapsed time and available controls, even after a run ends. Failed edits stay in the editor, and any available recovery action remains in the details view.
  [#176519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176519).

  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds active-run guidance to experimental [Advisor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/reference/advisor), so an agent repeating a failed step or straying from your request can receive a short correction while it works. Advisor is off by default and uses the session model. Advice that cannot reach the active run is dropped, and unfinished reviews are cancelled when you stop a run or send a new message.
  The first change covers active-run Advisor reviews.

  [#174568](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174568), [#173459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173459).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Combines rapid tool activity into fewer progress draft updates, so the next update can still reflect the latest activity even if the tools go quiet. The first update and failure updates don’t have to wait for that schedule.
  [#174007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174007).

  Thanks vincentkoc.
- Adds an automatic per-command memory limit for foreground, background and PTY `exec` commands on Linux Gateway hosts. A large command can stop with a `memory-limit` message that shows its usage and limit. The sampled limit scales with host or cgroup capacity and the Gateway’s own memory use. [Exec memory protection](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182111) · [#182163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182163)
- Sets a default limit of 1,024 PIDs for new Docker and Podman sandbox containers, including browser containers. You can set `docker.pidsLimit` for workloads that need a different budget. [Sandbox settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents/sandbox)
  [#38604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38604).

  [#182381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182381).

  Child process memory sampling · [Child process memory sampling — 11.5 memory sampler](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/src/process/child-memory.ts) · Host command monitoring.

  [#185077](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185077), [#186373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186373).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU work and temporary memory used to monitor native worker control messages.
  [#185283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185283).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts CPU and memory use when starting background tasks that check session disk usage, read saved plugin model lists or prepare attachments.
  [#186042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186042).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated checks of unchanged tool-result sizes before model calls and when saving history. It also reduces temporary memory used to check large, nested results for loops.
  [#186133](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186133), [#186931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186931).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes repeated session checks when ACP prepares a runtime.
  [#175306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175306).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when saving small batches of agent run events in SQLite without pruning older events, and avoids replaying a saved batch if its confirmation is lost.
  [#176459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176459).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds settings to choose which eligible tools are available through Tool Search by source or name, so frequently used tools can stay directly available.
  [#170071](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170071).

  Thanks [@ificator](https://github.com/ificator), [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Lets Codex use your JSON schema to shape the result of an [LLM Task](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/llm-task) before OpenClaw validates it. This applies to eligible object schemas up to 1 KiB. If Codex rejects the schema format, the task may make one extra request on the same route within its original deadline. Plugin authors can also supply a schema for [isolated completions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/models) in supporting harnesses and should leave it unchanged after handing it off.
  [Commit 98b7887](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98b78873c8b0308a9b14f3b8885c93b7988ed4df).

  Thanks [@cavit99](https://github.com/cavit99).
- Reduces the processing and temporary memory needed to add large, table-shaped results from Tool Search and Code Mode to the conversation transcript.
  [#186935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186935).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway processing and temporary memory allocations when deeply nested subagents send bursts of updates to multiple connected clients.
  [#186939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186939).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts the work of refreshing large Codex catalogs repeatedly, though it can keep some memory in use longer between refreshes. If cleanup fails between refreshes, waiting refreshes receive an error promptly. See the [Codex harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness).
  [#186950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186950).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Host file edits

- Changes host `apply_patch` to allow edits outside the workspace by default. [Configure workspace restrictions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/apply-patch) if you need them; sandbox and other containment policies still apply.
  [#186381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186381).

  Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).




##### Additional other qol improvements updates


- Bounds summary payload memory during session compaction and releases background worker tasks before waiting on model responses.
  [`87508f05b7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87508f05b72bc8f74cb197621e2c2df107ce5a3d).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Stops agents from repeatedly retrying tools that require setup, such as unconfigured web search or an unpaired node, by telling the model the failure is persistent and suggesting a working alternative.
  [#176306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176306).

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Reports CLI resource cleanup failures on stderr without replacing the command result, and continues tracking cleanup that exceeds its initial reporting deadline.
  [#173566](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173566).
- Stops the agent system prompt from recommending `/reasoning` and `/status` on channels where both text and native commands are disabled.
  [#181997](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181997).

  Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit).
- Stops the agent system prompt from recommending `/update` and `/restart` when `commands.restart` is disabled.
  [#182001](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182001).

  Thanks [@MonkeyLeeT](https://github.com/MonkeyLeeT).
- Returns empty `agents.list` responses immediately for roles with no permitted agents instead of waiting for every agent's model catalog to load.
  [#182159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182159).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes PowerShell shell completion failing to handle quoted option values.
  [#167421](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167421).
- Defers loading the PostgreSQL runtime during SQLite state heartbeats, reducing startup and memory overhead for SQLite installations.
  [`1762a33479`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1762a334791068f03b434aac437828f2697b79aa).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#176697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176697).

  Thanks co-author [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex dashboard turns that could stop before reaching the model when the Gateway resumed a conversation with hosted web search enabled.
  [#176707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176707).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes accepted agent requests losing their final result when the submitting turn ends normally.
  [#176913](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176913).

  Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Lets a permitted message from a person or another agent wake the built-in agent while it’s waiting on a subagent, so it can respond while the child keeps working. [Subagent tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference)
  [#177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Keeps accepted subagent follow-ups tied to the original run and requester, and prevents a completion from being attributed to a later session when the requesting session is missing. It also skips obsolete child completions that could hold up new messages while including cancellations that belong in a waiting group’s result.
  [#177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698), [#179222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179222).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a queued subagent delivery warning from starting another reply after the result has already arrived. You can inspect unresolved delivery failures on the child session.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Oldrich333">@Oldrich333</a>. [#177385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177385) · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168339">Issue #168339</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9344233e7a66fe36479d55b7f7ae8e10eb886586">Final queue change</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/slash-command">Subagent delivery</a>
- Prevents a group of subagents from sending already-delivered results back to the parent agent a second time. If only some results have arrived, the follow-up carries the missing ones. A parent that explicitly yielded can still resume, and partial findings from work interrupted by a Gateway restart can still reach it. [Subagent handoff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff.md)
  [#178104](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178104).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops repeat failure notices and extra agent turns when recovery permanently fails to produce a visible reply to a subagent’s result. You can inspect the saved result and delivery failure, then continue the conversation yourself once the original problem is resolved.
  [Related issue #168339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168339) · [Subagent operations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/operations.md)

  [#179675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179675).

  Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) for preparing the fix, [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for the related report.
- Fixes follow-up agent requests timing out too soon or running after their wait limit has passed if the system clock changes while they’re queued behind another run in the same session.
  [#177179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177179).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes native subagent replies losing their original line breaks when passed back to the parent agent. The parent receives the full reply even when the preview is shorter, with media references kept and delivery instructions left out of the reply text. Replies already shown to the user keep the text that was displayed. [Subagent completion guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/tools/subagents/announce.md)
  [Issue #180379](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180379).

  [#180451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180451).

  Thanks [@matthematics1137](https://github.com/matthematics1137).
- Prevents host clock changes from cutting the wait for child agents short or making it last longer than intended.
  [#180554](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180554).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) for the original fix and regression, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the elapsed-time implementation.
- Fixes Stop getting delayed or failing for queued subagents when the session list is slow to refresh or cannot refresh. The list can update after Stop finishes and shows the current run if another has taken its place.
  [#177787](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177787).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an assistant losing the ability to send follow-up instructions to an already-running native child agent after a Control UI refresh or network interruption. The repair applies when the same verified device reconnects with the same access.
  [#176972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176972).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Restores messaging from a parent or permitted peers to an existing child after the parent gets a new session ID, provided OpenClaw can still connect the old and new parent sessions. A send waiting for approval is cancelled if the link it relied on unexpectedly changes. If OpenClaw can no longer connect the sessions, re-spawn the child. [Session messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session-tool.md)
  [#169828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169828).

  [#178082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178082).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for the report.
- Fixes the Subagents panel leaving out running Codex-native subagents. It shows live status, retries failed refreshes while visible, and leaves native rows read-only. Authorized Gateway clients can request the same live observations with `includeNativeSubagents` on `sessions.describe`.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/enki">@enki</a>. [#177414](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177414) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/sessions-and-results">Agent harness sessions and results</a>
- Fixes Claude CLI replying when it yields to wait for subagents and recording a successful child handoff as a stopped conversation. Child results can wake the same conversation without a false interruption in its history. Other CLI backend plugins can opt into ending turns on yield.
  [CLI backend plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/cli-backend-plugins) · Yield handling · Handoff history · [Issue #179486](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179486).

  [#176893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176893), [#180198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180198).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes mid-run guidance being rejected when a coordinator tries to steer its own running Claude CLI child. [Steering guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/steer)
  [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178822).

  [#178865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178865).

  Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops image-capable CLI backends from reattaching old images to later text-only messages. Images attached to the current turn or supplied by the channel with a reply go through.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nunyabiz765](https://github.com/nunyabiz765) for the report. [#176837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176837) · [CLI backend guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) · [Issue #176629](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176629)
- Fixes CLI-backed sessions losing their usual agent instructions, profile, or memory when they run in a separate project folder. The agent keeps its own workspace context and still follows the project's `AGENTS.md`.
  Thanks to sunlit-deng and steipete, to nikolay-bratanov for the report, and to wr-web for checking an equivalent branch. [#180559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180559) · [Issue #180510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180510)
- Fixes a case where Claude CLI didn’t follow up after a background command finished. If session storage is unavailable, you can retrieve the command result with `process poll`.

  [#177063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177063).

Disabling a configured server named `openclaw` leaves Claude’s other allowed MCP tools available. An affected chat may start a fresh Claude session, with its OpenClaw history preserved. [CLI backends guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)
  [#178723](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178723).

Uses that session’s web search rules and keeps hosted search off while a supervised session has no model selected. If the model changes before the question starts, retry with the current model.

  [#177114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177114).

  [#178108](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178108).

- Fixes a Mac app crash when Peekaboo lists windows with OpenClaw chat open. Peekaboo skips windows in the OpenClaw instance running it, so use CUA for those windows. Inspection and focus stay on the selected external window. Desktop control is still an option when a window action has no effect.
  [#179061](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179061).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@septembermartin](https://github.com/septembermartin).

  [Computer use guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/computer-use)
- Prevents first-use ACP sessions from failing just because ACPX is still starting. If the readiness check fails, the sessions still fail to start. Use `/acp doctor` to diagnose the backend.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. [#177499](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177499) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/acp-agents/quickstart">ACP agents quickstart</a>
- Retries Crabbox worker profile setup without protected secrets when a temporary conflict over its lease would otherwise stop it before setup begins. If the conflict persists, setup stops and reports it.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. [#177497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177497) · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting">Cloud-worker troubleshooting</a>
- Prevents Crabbox from allocating workers for OS overrides that are incompatible with the profile’s setup script and hides those OS and machine choices. If you use a Linux, macOS or WSL2 profile with setup, use a [separate profile with PowerShell setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation#native-windows-prerequisites) for native Windows. Profiles without setup keep their supported choices.
  [#180073](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180073).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes worker setup having to wait to retry a failed machine or operating-system lookup while the other lookup is still running.
  [#177635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177635).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes later worker placement lookups showing edits a plugin made to a freshly loaded result.
  [#177489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177489).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes worker inference cancellations that could go unconfirmed when a result with invalid provider usage data was being saved.
  [#177348](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177348).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes cloud session dispatches failing with a workspace-changed error when another session registers its own empty workspace at the same time. Starting a child session gets the same scoped check, and a change to the selected workspace still blocks stale preparation. [Cloud dispatch guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/dispatching-a-session)
  [Issue #179229](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179229).

  [#179240](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179240).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a Gateway restart from giving overdue cloud worker cleanup for a stopped conversation a new retry window when its Stop request was recorded. If the cleanup attempt on restart fails, OpenClaw leaves the failure visible. After resolving the problem with the provider, use **Stop** to retry. [Cloud worker troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting)
  [#179132](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179132).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway worker startup failure that could occur while preparing a newly assigned workspace.
  [#179383](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179383).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes worker recovery using outdated session assignments when a session moves as the Gateway forcibly abandons a worker. Recovery checks the current owner before acting on the session or its pending results.
  [#179448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179448).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen">@Patrick-Erichsen</a>.
- Fixes a delayed loading error in MCP settings making a successful server change look like it failed. If the confirmation for removing a server fails to open, MCP settings now show the error and let you try again.
  [#180712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180712).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes MCP app context disappearing from the chat composer when a background refresh fails. Late refreshes can no longer bring back cleared context or replace newer context.
  [#180770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180770).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a rejected resource connection during native worker startup from taking the shared worker service down. The affected worker reports the error and exits while other workers can still run.
  [#180773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180773).

  Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an expanded MCP server’s tool list in the chat composer’s Plugins menu staying empty after the current direct session run discovers tools. The list refreshes when the run finishes, without having to collapse and reopen it. [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  [#180865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180865).

  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes worker delegation failing to start a child session when its required setup is already underway. The worker waits for the child to be ready before sending its first task.
  [#181019](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181019).

  Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Fixes parent agents losing access to a retained native child session under tree visibility after its finished run ages out of the recent list. Parents can find the child, read or search its history, check its status, and send notifications or follow-ups within their existing permissions. If another session already controls the child’s work, it keeps control.
  [#181117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181117).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Stops Codex from trying another model when active work blocks a manual resume of a native thread with changed settings. Wait for the active work to finish or stop it before retrying.
  [#181204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181204).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics).

  Reported by [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal) ([#181046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181046)).
- Fixes workers being denied when sending messages to their own live parent or siblings under a non-default agent in global session mode.
  [#181207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181207).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a restart bug that could send the same subagent interruption notice twice and make the parent agent run an extra turn. Recovery also retries undelivered interruption notices and finishes any needed browser cleanup before announcing the interruption.
  [#181482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181482).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex starting a new conversation thread after a subagent with restricted tools finishes. Your next turn resumes the original thread and picks up the subagent’s result, which is marked as seen after a successful turn. The subagent’s tool restrictions still apply.
  [Report #181580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181580)

  [#181591](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181591).

  Thanks [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) for reporting and co-authoring the fix, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for contributing.
- Fixes Swarm collectors returning just a short preview of a child’s answer. Collection can recover up to 100 KB of the recorded answer and flags results it can’t return in full. Collector children accept a single request. If a follow-up is refused, collect the result or start a new child. [Swarm guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/swarm)
  [#181622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181622).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes agent creation failing with an unavailable error on Gateways that store their state in PostgreSQL, including when the CLI sends the request to the Gateway.
  [#181676](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181676).

  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@etzelm for independent verification](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181676#issuecomment-6371657515).
- Fixes the dead end when you submit another objective for an existing Goal in the Control UI. The Goal composer and `/goal` ask you to confirm the replacement, and canceling keeps your draft and leaves running work alone. Confirming keeps the same Goal’s history and budget. Idle and paused Goals keep their status, and a running Goal stops its current turn before resuming on the new objective if it can safely continue and has budget left. If the UI warns it couldn’t save interrupted output, copy any visible text you want to keep. [Goal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/goal)
  [#181688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181688).

  Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson).
- Fixes Codex losing the final answer after a tool action finishes when an earlier tool exchange was left unfinished. Recovery can leave out earlier conversation details and reuses the completed action’s result. [Codex reply recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/replies)
  Thanks [@indra622](https://github.com/indra622) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@scoootscooob](https://github.com/scoootscooob) for the related report. [#181718](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181718) · [Related issue #128916](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/128916)
- Fixes a case where Stop ended the selected run but left its native Codex subagents running.
  [#181766](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181766).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unnecessary context-overflow retries during tool use that could happen even when a context engine stayed within its allotted history limit. The fix applies to engines that manage their own compaction.
  [#181800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181800).

  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Rejects malformed Codex errors in known formats while continuing to accept unfamiliar error types.
  [#181823](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181823).

  Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes the off-center **Create new agent** form in the Control UI. The form fills the dialog on desktop and mobile.
  [#182014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182014).

  Thanks [@AmelioMansour](https://github.com/AmelioMansour) and obviyus.
- Clarifies for a resuming Codex agent that it paused intentionally to wait for a follow-up, even if the transcript shows an interruption. [Codex harness](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness).
  [#182122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182122).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops private subagent completions from asking the parent to send a message when there is nowhere to send it. The parent is directed to leave the reviewed result in the requesting session. [Subagent announcements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce).
  [#182124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182124).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps permission changes during worker setup inside its Corepack copy by skipping linked files and folders.
  [#182185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182185).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes tools dropping out of the same session’s tool list on background or recovery turns, including screen tools, session creation and plugin tools. Tool calls still require current permission and a connected client wherever the tool needs one. [Prompt caching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching).
  [#182191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182191).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes altered characters and lost tab indentation when an agent quotes a subagent’s finished work, so code and other formatted text can come through as written.
  [#182223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182223).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>.
- Fixes Linux managed commands being refused because a loader-free or compiled helper has a TypeScript filename. Node helpers with startup hooks can be refused even if they’re already built. [Managed process guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process)
  [#182306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182306).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Updates `sessions_spawn` target guidance to distinguish which agents a request can use from which agents are configured, and leaves out generic ACP examples when requester-specific guidance is present.
  [#182327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182327).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Recovers interrupted Crabbox warm-image captures automatically when the source worker can no longer capture and Crabbox finds no matching checkpoint or one safe to remove. If recovery still needs your help, Doctor and warm-image inspection show any candidate checkpoint IDs they found. [Recover a paused capture](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/warm-images#recover-a-paused-capture)
  [#182353](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182353).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a warning when a sandboxed command requests a terminal that the sandbox can’t provide. The command runs without a terminal, and the warning suggests using a noninteractive command. [Exec tool](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec)
  [#38601](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38601).

  [#182380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182380).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@imhaojie](https://github.com/imhaojie) (reporter).
- Fixes `openclaw sandbox explain` rejecting channel-prefixed session aliases or inspecting the wrong session when `main` points to a custom session key. [Sandbox CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox)
  [related report #51245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51245).

  [#182406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182406).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@Tin55FoilDev](https://github.com/Tin55FoilDev) (related issue reporter).
- Fixes repository-backed cloud sessions losing unpushed Git commits when you reclaim a worker. Eligible commits can be restored when you restart or fork the session, replace the worker, or move the session to the Gateway. If OpenClaw can only recover the file changes, it keeps them for review and tells you the commits weren’t restored. Restoration requires access to the pinned base. [Cloud session lifecycle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle)
  Commit restoration requires compatible installations and a managed branch still at the pinned base. [#110498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110498).

  [#182387](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182387).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a credential error that blocked shell commands on native Windows cloud workers even with a valid managed GitHub identity. Profiles that fail the existing security checks are still rejected.
  [#182435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182435).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@mick-lu-lingyue](https://github.com/mick-lu-lingyue) for the report and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for reproducing the launcher failure.
- Restores the original error when a worker fails to start. If the worker node is lost during launch, OpenClaw can use its existing recovery path again.
  [#182504](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182504).
- Fixes restored group chat history making different participants look like the same user to a CLI agent, even when their sender information was saved.
  [#182455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182455).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@roshke](https://github.com/Roshke).
- Fixes Lobster workflows failing to ask for input, check answers or resume with a valid answer on standalone AOT builds. Fixes model-output validation on those builds too.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182928) · [Lobster](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/lobster)
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed node workers failing to record how a turn ended. Recovering the recorded outcome of a worker run that has already ended also takes one fewer database query.
  [#183172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183172).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes agents silently skipping work such as loading a skill when a model returns an available Tool Search call as text. OpenClaw retries when safe and reports a failure if the model repeats the call as text.
  [Issue #183085 reported by lyrakat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183085).

  [#183165](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183165).

  Thanks [@Linux2010](https://github.com/Linux2010) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a finished background command from being announced again after your agent has already collected its output from the process log. Adds the command’s exit result to finished logs, including paged output in Code Mode.
  [#183113](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183113).

  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/turian">@turian</a> and <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.
- Fixes misleading access errors in the Gateway logs when the Control UI looks up MCP apps while restoring or switching conversations. Keeps app launches on the conversation’s agent even if a different agent is selected.
  [Issue #182555 reported by nik-greek](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182555).

  [#183168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183168).

  Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes command launches reporting a cleanup error when permission expires just after the command is accepted for launch. OpenClaw reports the permission rejection and continues cleaning up the command and any processes it started.
  [#183247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183247).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes results going missing from large or nested subagent batches when execution identity collection is enabled.
  [Subagent announcements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce).

  [#183454](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183454).

  Thanks [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Reported by @travellingsoldier85 in [#183416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183416).
- Fixes stalled worker cleanup holding up Gateway shutdown or suspension when using Crabbox or another provider that supports cancellation. OpenClaw retries cleanup after restart or resume if it could not confirm the worker had stopped.
  [#183579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183579).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unfinished [Goals](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/goal.md) in built-in chat getting stuck after delegated work finishes in the same process. Eligible Goals can continue in the original conversation without another prompt, and Stop still prevents that follow-up.
  See the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183705).

  [#183706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183706).

  Thanks [@HermanZeng](https://github.com/HermanZeng) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).

  [#174211](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174211).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes agent turns ending without an answer when an invalid tool call is rejected before it runs, after a progress update. The agent can try once more to finish the reply.
  [#183807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183807).

  Thanks [@Mirr0ch1](https://github.com/Mirr0ch1), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Avoids holding up unrelated Gateway requests while subagent cleanup loads plugins.
  [#183996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183996).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes subagent handoffs getting stuck when a cancellation is recorded after the subagent has already finished. Recovery clears the stuck handoff without restarting the cancelled work.
  [Subagent handoffs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff).

  [#184063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184063).

  Thanks [@kintaro001-oss](https://github.com/kintaro001-oss) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes MCP Relay connected-app controls losing focus during unrelated updates and keeps the app rows visible but disabled while an action is pending.
  [#184126](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184126).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes cloud worker setup failing when a required launcher helper was left out of the worker bundle. Requests for the same bundle can reuse it after a successful build. If you ship a custom distribution, include its launcher helpers in the package file list. [Cloud worker setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation)
  [#184181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184181).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes background commands continuing to run and hold a worker slot after you stop an active turn on a paired node or node-backed cloud worker.
  [Background processes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/background-process.md)

  [#184313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184313).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes false requests to continue from a subagent that is already waiting for work it delegated. The yield tool explains when it skips a requested message wait so that the delegated work can finish.
  [Subagent tool reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md)

  [#184265](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184265).

  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes Stop waiting on a native subagent that is trying to create a worktree from a repository another operation is using.
  [#184320](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184320).

  [#184345](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184345).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents failed native subagent starts from leaving an extra session behind when worktree setup fails after the session is created.
  [#184380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184380).

  [#184420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184420).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the [Claude CLI backend](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) losing the main reply when discarded messages from native subagents used up the turn’s output limit.

  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the shipped fix and [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott) for the original work.
- Fixes the [background process panel](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) asking you to reconnect or update a node after its work is done and its idle worker has shut down. If the node is still connected, the panel shows an empty list instead.
  [#184355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184355).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex subagent replies and already accepted follow-up work getting lost when the parent session’s details are updated without changing its owner.
  [#184604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184604).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for co-authoring it.

  [#184901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184901).

  Replaced results and queued messages.

  [#180704](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180704).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).

  Accepted child runs.

  [#180728](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180728).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).

  Recovered batches.

Older forwarded messages without a matching OpenClaw transcript entry may still appear as yours.
