- Fixes authorized background command follow-ups, subagent handoffs and Goals being refused permission to continue. Follow-ups use the initiating person’s [current permissions and review rules](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session-tool), so guest work does not inherit the session owner’s access. Owner-only access returns for a tracked background command if its requester is still an owner. After a restart, work without an original caller uses the session’s current authorized user if available; otherwise a person must resume it. Delayed node command results return to the intended session and agent.
  Owner access after commands · Continued work permissions.

  [#185476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185476), [#187346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187346).

- Fixes embedded agents receiving MCP tools without the server’s [instructions for using them](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp). The guidance also appears in Tool Search and Code Mode for tools discovered there. Long instructions are shortened for embedded agents, while native Claude CLI still receives the full text.
  [Issue #174336](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174336). Embedded agents receive up to 2,000 UTF-16 units per server; the omitted tail cannot be retrieved through discovery.

  [#174342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174342).

  Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint).
- Fixes supported [Docker-backed MCP servers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/transports) leaving containers running after disconnects or initialization timeouts, including containers started by connection checks. After a Gateway crash, a restart can reclaim tracked containers on Docker daemons still used by an enabled MCP server. Keep the affected server enabled until recovery has reclaimed its containers. Containers left behind before this fix still need manual cleanup.
  Cleanup uses the Docker context that started the server, and the transport guide describes supported commands.

  [#175107](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175107).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@shing1211](https://github.com/shing1211) for the report.
- Reduces unnecessary cleanup work when a cancelled Linux command has no children left, and when many stopped commands need to be [cleaned up](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) at once.
  Cancellation cleanup · Concurrent cleanup.

  [#174495](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174495), [#174762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174762).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for co-authoring #174495 and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #174762.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes sessions repeatedly failing with restart recovery errors on every new message when an interrupted turn retains an operator source from an older session identity.
  [#180853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180853).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes false subagent failures and stuck parent batches after a Gateway crash when a child session has been reused, so interrupted spawns settle against their own run without affecting newer turns.
  [#185106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185106).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes follow-up corrections queuing behind older work instead of steering the active run when a reused child session is executing a new task.
  [#180228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180228).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Fixes stopping a queued restart-recovery run before provider execution begins reporting the run as failed instead of durably stopped.
  [#184761](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184761).

  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Gateway stalls during long streamed replies when a model outputs or quotes tool-call XML outside code blocks.
  [#181397](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181397).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes long streamed replies that mention tools or functions stalling the Gateway event loop by checking only line heads for trace output.
  [#172631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172631).
- Reports that a collector subagent's `structured_output` retry budget is exhausted instead of returning the previous attempt's validation error for a valid payload.
  [#181515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181515).

  Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar).
- Fixes completed subagent runs staying stuck in a running state and never delivering results to the parent session, including across Gateway restarts.
  [#184030](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184030).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes private subagent completions repeatedly failing and expiring after a Gateway restart instead of delivering to the parent session.
  [#184041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184041).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes subagent completion notices failing to route back to parent sessions created without a lifecycle revision, such as sessions started through the agent RPC.
  [#175278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175278).
- Fixes a finished subagent session holding its own completion indefinitely when one of its own child runs has suspended delivery.
  [#197323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197323).

  Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web).
- Fixes Gateway crashes and missing turn errors when continuing a completed subagent conflicts with a concurrent ownership change, returning a visible error while keeping the user's message in history.
  [#185386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185386).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes subagent results getting stuck when a child finishes while its parent is compacting during timeout recovery, delivering the result on the parent's recovered retry.
  [#176380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176380).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes main-session restart recovery trying to resume a parent conversation before subagent Gateway bindings and completion authority finish restoring.
  [#174134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174134).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes in-process `agent.wait` calls issued while the Gateway is closing for restart failing permanently instead of retrying and recovering the child session.
  [#172852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172852).
- Fixes restarted subagents failing with a stale ownership error instead of continuing their retained work.
  [#182275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182275).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes private subagent completion turns getting stuck after a Gateway restart so interrupted completions resume under their existing owner.
  [#184145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184145).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completed child sessions blocking an interrupted parent from running Resume by saving the child result and delivering it once after the parent resumes.
  [#182587](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182587).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completed subagent runs retaining session callbacks after teardown so finished sessions can be released from memory.
  [#183884](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183884).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves live continuation authority for subagents relaunched by restart recovery so they can spawn or retry child tasks instead of failing with an inactive recovery run error.
  [#181363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181363).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing subagent completion replies in announcements, wait previews, and scheduled follow-ups when a finished run is compacted in memory before its result is read.
  [#185051](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185051).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rejects invalid managed worktree names containing branch prefixes before spawning a subagent so you can fix the name and retry without leaving behind a failed child session.
  [#182184](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182184).

  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes remote access staying unavailable after a Tailscale daemon restart ends the Gateway's foreground Serve or Funnel process.
  [#180081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180081).

  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Fixes `terminal.open` 30-second timeouts stretching or failing early during wall-clock jumps by using a monotonic clock.
  [#170665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170665).
- Fixes tool failure warnings misreporting invalid tool arguments as blocked calls, showing a clear invalid-arguments message instead.
  [#176104](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176104).
- Preserves command exit codes, timeouts, and signal diagnostics when truncating large tool outputs for the model context.
  [#174030](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174030).
- Fixes assistant replies that resemble malformed tool calls stalling the Gateway while the reply is classified.
  [#183252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183252).

  Thanks [@LeizhenZhang](https://github.com/LeizhenZhang).
- Fixes interrupted publishing and plugin-reload tool-result continuations failing automatic recovery after a Gateway restart with a missing operator authority error.
  [#185252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185252).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway transcript auto-start shutdown waiting past its five-second pending-start cleanup budget when the system wall clock steps backward during shutdown or restart.
  [#187156](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187156).

  Thanks [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee).
- Fixes recovered conversations losing the completed turn when tool-result truncation happens while the transcript projection is rebuilding.
  [#182666](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182666).

  Thanks [@MSNexploder](https://github.com/MSNexploder).
- Fixes timed-out tool executions being masked by warnings or silent exits when no reply or completion-owning child remains.
  [#172983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172983).
- Fixes unreadable configuration roots being treated as missing files and silently loading fresh-install defaults, surfacing an I/O error instead.
  [#174609](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174609).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Settles interrupted parent turns with a single transcript notice when the original subagent cohort or operator authority can no longer be restored, so later restarts stop retrying them.
  [#174177](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174177).
- Fixes background session usage and estimated cost totals going stale when the system wall clock jumps backward.
  [#184212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184212).

  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes malformed `usage.cost` scope selectors silently falling back to the default agent instead of returning an invalid request error.
  [#158696](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158696).

  Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007).
- Fixes web_fetch in text mode stripping or distorting Markdown syntax inside inline code spans instead of keeping the literal code example intact.
  [#184411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184411).

  Thanks [@yy19971996](https://github.com/yy19971996).
- Fixes `web_fetch` stripping code indentation, repeated spaces, and blank lines when extracting Markdown responses as plain text.
  [#172389](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172389).

  Thanks [@ly85206559](https://github.com/ly85206559).
- Fixes directory watchers failing to match Windows 8.3 short paths by resolving and watching their long path form.
  [#172768](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172768).
- Fixes local agent commands failing with spawn EPERM under a Windows S4U Scheduled Task when shell discovery picks an inaccessible Microsoft Store PowerShell alias, falling back to Windows PowerShell 5.1.
  [#182898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182898).

  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes spawning processes with secret stdin input hanging on Windows when the child process never reads from the pipe.
  [#174571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174571).
- Fixes cloud and node workers getting rate-limited out of the Gateway when reconnecting while the Gateway is starting or their environment is not ready yet.
  [#174735](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174735).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway SIGBUS crash during session-start checkout diff capture when a workspace contains a live SQLite database or shared-memory file.
  [#174017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174017).

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
